name: node-1.0.400
body:
# node 1.0.400

## Metadata

- **Release type**: patch
  - Version delta 1.0.300 -> 1.0.400 leaves major and minor unchanged (commit 8081e4b27).
- **Date**: 2026-10-05 (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05)
- **Ships in bundle**: — this release is not part of a bundle (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05)
- **Sister-line note**: — (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05)
- **Environment**: Preview, Preprod and Mainnet - the fix is already running on all three (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05)
- **Released artifact(s)**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-1.0.400> - seven artifacts publish at this tag; see **Artifacts** below.
- **Component class**: core/infra
- **Upgrade scope**: binary only (detail under **Deployment information**)
- **Reset required**: No (detail under **Deployment information**)
- **Governance action required**: No - there is no runtime to enact (commit 8081e4b27)

## High-level summary

This is the public release of a security patch already deployed on Preview, Preprod and Mainnet (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05). It moves
the node's ledger 8 host functions to ledger 8.1.3, which fixes the critical advisory
[GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/security/advisories/GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8)
and also rejects `noop 0` in contract call transcripts (commit 8081e4b27). It also fixes the mainnet fresh-sync halt at
block #1788979 that 1.0.300 listed as a known issue (commit 5defaf5de, issue #2229). The upgrade is binary-only: the
on-chain runtime is untouched and `spec_version` stays 1_000_300 (commit 8081e4b27).

## Audience

These notes are for:

- Validators and block producers on every network, who should move to this binary together.
- Full Node Operators, in particular anyone syncing mainnet from genesis.
- External integrators and dApp developers whose contract calls reach the ledger through the node.
- The Midnight Foundation and Shielded Technologies engineering and SRE teams.

## Dependencies

Component-local hard requirements:

- Block producers should run the same ledger version. A node on ledger 8.1.3 rejects contract calls that a node on 8.1.2 accepts (commit 8081e4b27).
- Runs against the already-enacted 1.0.300 runtime (`spec_version` 1_000_300). The statically linked runtime is not used on mainnet, at all times the on chain runtime will be used. In this release no new on-chain runtime ships.

For every other interop question, see the bundle dependency matrix.

**Downstream impact (cascading effects).**

- A contract call whose transcript carries a non-canonical `field` value, or `noop 0`, is rejected by 1.0.400 nodes as malformed, where earlier nodes accepted it (commit 8081e4b27). Supported compactc and midnight-js output never produces these encodings, so dApp developers have nothing to change (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05).
- The toolkit at this tag is built on the same ledger 8.1.3 crates, so it applies the same stricter rules when building or replaying transactions (commit 8081e4b27).

## Tested-with versions

Build pins read from the workspace manifest and `Cargo.lock` at the release commit: build pins — not QA-verified.

| Component                  | Tested-with version                                |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `midnight-ledger` (v8)     | `8.1.3` (commit 3acfd2ede)                         |
| `midnight-ledger` (v7)     | `7.0.3` (commit 3acfd2ede)                         |
| `midnight-zswap` (v8 / v7) | `8.1.3` / `7.0.3` (commit 3acfd2ede)               |
| `midnight-onchain-runtime` | `3.1.2` (v8) / `2.0.1` (v7) (commit 3acfd2ede)     |
| `midnight-onchain-state`   | `3.0.2` (v8) / `2.0.1` (v7) (commit 3acfd2ede)     |
| `midnight-onchain-vm`      | `3.1.2` (v8) / `1.0.2` (v7) (commit 3acfd2ede)     |
| `midnight-base-crypto`     | `1.0.2` (commit 3acfd2ede)                         |
| `midnight-storage`         | `2.0.3` (v8) / `1.1.1` (v7) (commit 3acfd2ede)     |
| `polkadot-sdk`             | `polkadot-stable2603` (commit 3acfd2ede)           |
| `compactc`                 | `0.30.0` (commit 3acfd2ede)                        |
| `partner-chains`           | vendored in-tree, no released version pin (commit 3acfd2ede) |

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary only - a new node binary or image. `spec_version` stays 1_000_300 and the enacted runtime is unchanged (commit 8081e4b27).
- **Reset required**: No - no runtime, chain-spec or genesis file changed between 1.0.300 and this release (commit 3acfd2ede). A node halted at #1788979 resumes importing once restarted on 1.0.400, with no resync (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05).
- **Governance action required**: No - nothing to enact on chain (commit 8081e4b27).
- **Downtime / coordination**: Per-node binary swap with no runtime step, but block producers should switch together because 8.1.3 and 8.1.2 nodes disagree on which contract calls are well-formed (commit 8081e4b27). On Preview, Preprod and Mainnet this has already happened (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05).

## Artifacts

Binaries (`sha256` from the release assets, cross-checked against `SHA256SUMS`):

- `midnight-node-1.0.400-linux-amd64.tar.gz` - node binary, x86-64 (`sha256:8098481824fa511d0a37554e44eaca524f5c74bced1885e5224cd90c0761914c`, release body).
- `midnight-node-1.0.400-linux-arm64.tar.gz` - node binary, arm64 (`sha256:4724691ed0204b1b3ccb0541da9d72b6e35ae7f6f5db0435048744a7ff85447f`, release body).
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.400-linux-amd64.tar.gz` - toolkit binary, x86-64 (`sha256:b3a320218e68b9544a30f3670fee884686728fce036318385656476772236f74`, release body).
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.400-linux-arm64.tar.gz` - toolkit binary, arm64 (`sha256:dbdc8ce90bbb80c90c7590dcb228dd35f4115c107aadfe2f2b474025c240f3d6`, release body).

Verification:

- `SHA256SUMS` - checksum manifest for the four tarballs (`sha256:3e4367b93a2ecbf7ba23b7ca4eb76e37dfd7901495ec3a08e40bb1cb44d86605`, release body).

No runtime wasm or `srtool-digest.json` ships: the runtime is the 1.0.300 one already on chain (commit 8081e4b27).

Images (Docker Hub digests):

- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:1.0.400` - node image, multi-arch index `sha256:915b117f955859a0ab7f34230ca12b43ef7474c84e29463256efcfc7b757040f`; linux/amd64 `sha256:cbb4dcfbf8bc628f6c246532a60496c55c9684237da15152dc5984a95b337b55`, linux/arm64 `sha256:eeaf8e3c5b6bb4a6eb53daa3d15c66e68e751014890fb76f42f3c021da7cebf5`. Per-arch tags `1.0.400-amd64` and `1.0.400-arm64` carry the same digests.
- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:1.0.400` - toolkit image, multi-arch index `sha256:b2d26c6759e9fba2402b362fa0180740178b0e41d8ab8a90b12619786dd561e3`; linux/amd64 `sha256:52ba1c3006e556a5ae7622446becdc52cf15fba944d12cc5c61f14cd0c71bf8b`, linux/arm64 `sha256:fb9a7fb008a03918dd17a11038a2b7c589afc97e36a7ad02562fd51470f67a3c`. Per-arch tags `1.0.400-amd64` and `1.0.400-arm64` carry the same digests.

## What changed

- *Node upgrade.* Bump ledger 8 to 8.1.3: contract call transcripts must embed canonical field values, so a `field` atom encoding `x + p` is rejected in `push`, `pushs` and `idx`-style path keys - the fix for critical advisory [GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/security/advisories/GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8) (PR #2238, commit 8081e4b27).
- *Node upgrade.* Through the same bump, `noop 0` in a contract call transcript is rejected as not normalized (commit 8081e4b27).
- *Node upgrade.* Crate versions after the bump: `midnight-ledger` and `midnight-zswap` 8.1.3, `midnight-onchain-runtime` 3.1.2, `midnight-onchain-state` 3.0.2, `midnight-onchain-vm` 3.1.2, `midnight-base-crypto` 1.0.2. The `midnight-base-crypto` change is additive only, so ledger 7, which shares it, is unaffected (commit 8081e4b27).
- *Node upgrade.* When a historical block's first ledger transaction fails `well_formed` at the corrected `tblock` (parent block time + 12 s), retry it at the block's own `tblock`. This unblocks a fresh mainnet sync that halted at #1788979 with `Intent TTL has expired`; the retry is only reachable under host-function v1, so it never applies to blocks after the v2 runtime upgrade at mainnet #2738210 (commit 5defaf5de).
- *Node upgrade.* Regression tests for that retry, including a fixture of mainnet block #1788980's first transaction (commit e913d449a, commit 28edf6a9d).
- Housekeeping: version bumps across the workspace and `docs/openrpc.json` (commit 8081e4b27), `axios` and `brace-expansion` lockfile bumps in the local test environment (commit 568b6f0ad), and a CI workflow permissions fix (PR #2243).
- *Toolkit.* Drop the `shx` dev dependency from the toolkit's JS harness, which was raising audit issues (commit 568b6f0ad).

## New features

None.

## New features requiring configuration updates

None - no config preset, chain spec or node-config key changed between 1.0.300 and this release (commit 3acfd2ede).

## Improvements

None.

## Deprecations

None.

## Breaking changes

### Breaking change `stricter contract call well-formedness`

**What changed**: Ledger 8.1.3 narrows what counts as a well-formed contract call. A `field` atom encoding `x + p` (where `p` is the field modulus) in `push`, `pushs` or `idx`-style path keys, and `noop 0`, are now rejected (commit 8081e4b27).

**What breaks**: A contract call carrying either is rejected as malformed by a 1.0.400 node, where a 1.0.300 node accepted it. Block producers on mixed versions would disagree on such calls (commit 8081e4b27).

**Required actions**: operators and developers have separate steps.

- Operators: move every block producer onto 1.0.400 together (commit 8081e4b27).
- Developers: nothing to do - supported compactc and midnight-js output never produces these encodings (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05).

**Code example**: — none applies; this is a validity rule, not an API migration.

## Known issues

None (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05).

## Links and references

- **QA test coverage / test evidence**: — (owner-confirmed 2026-10-05)
- **PRs**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/compare/node-1.0.300...node-1.0.400> - PR #2238, PR #2243
- **Engineering docs**: —
- **Migration guides**: —
- **SDK docs**: —
- **Known issues board**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues>
- **Public schema**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/node-1.0.400/docs/openrpc.json>
- **API documentation**: the node serves the same document at runtime through the `rpc.discover` JSON-RPC method.

## Fixed defect list

| Defect number | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8 | Critical [GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/security/advisories/GHSA-wr7g-rr4v-jmj8): non-canonical `field` encodings (`x + p`) in contract call transcripts were accepted; fixed by ledger 8.1.3 (commit 8081e4b27). |
| ledger 8.1.3  | `noop 0` in a contract call transcript was accepted although not normalized (commit 8081e4b27).            |
| issue #2229   | A fresh mainnet sync halted at #1788979 with `Intent TTL has expired` (commit 5defaf5de); follows up the v1 `tblock` correction from issue #1924. |
| commit 568b6f0ad | Audit issues raised by the `shx` dev dependency in the toolkit's JS harness.                             |

name: node-1.0.300
body:
# node 1.0.300

NOTE: This is a re-issue of 1.0.300 including an update to `Cargo.lock` so that the runtime hash matches exactly as on chain ( https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/commit/01fa20a52f897933f13fb71e400b43075c4a5cc8 ).
(Credit to Justin Bons for pointing out the discrepancy.)

## Metadata

- **Release type**: patch
  - Derived from the version delta 1.0.2 -> 1.0.300: major and minor are unchanged (commit 31f4c365). Note the payload is not patch-shaped — it carries an on-chain runtime upgrade, see Deployment information.
- **Date**: 2026-09-22
- **Ships in bundle**: — this release is not part of a bundle (owner-confirmed 2026-09-22). A code search of the release-hub repo for "1.0.300" returned a single incidental hit in `dashboard/pnpm-lock.yaml`, consistent with that.
- **Sister-line note**: "This release is on the `1.0.x` maintenance line. Operators tracking the development line should follow `node-2.1.0-rc.2` instead." (release body; tag list at the target tag)
- **Environment**: Preview, Preprod and Mainnet — and devnet (owner-confirmed 2026-09-22)
  - The binary and runtime ship to every environment. Only devnet's chain spec and genesis are rebuilt in-tree (`res/devnet/*`, `res/genesis/genesis_*_devnet.mn` — commit a1aa9ff4, commit 25023606), because devnet's spec still embedded the 0.22.0 runtime; the live networks take the new runtime through `set_code`, not through a new chain spec.
- **Released artifact(s)**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-1.0.300> — eleven artifacts publish at this tag, so they are itemised in the **Artifacts** section below.
- **Component class**: core/infra
- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime (expanded under **Deployment information** below)
- **Reset required**: Yes on devnet only — its genesis was regenerated and the hash changed (commit 25023606). No on preview, preprod or mainnet.
- **Governance action required**: Yes — the new runtime must be enacted on chain with `set_code` (commit aee7bb4a).

## High-level summary

A security patch release on the 1.0.x line, for every environment including mainnet. It clears a critical `tar`
advisory, GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw, reached through the npm CLI bundled in the toolkit image (PR #1919), and removes
`gdb` from the node, toolkit and hardfork-test-upgrader images, which had been handing anyone with exec access
ptrace-based memory inspection of a running validator, key material included (commit e6eb5464). Riding with it are
the `tblock` correction that lets historical blocks whose transactions came from a producing node's warm strict
cache import cleanly, now gated on the on-chain runtime rather than a hardcoded date (commit c0252640,
commit b09b64b3, commit aee7bb4a), and a rebuilt devnet chain spec and genesis (commit a1aa9ff4, commit 25023606).
Upgrading is a coordinated binary-plus-runtime operation: every validator must be on this binary before `set_code`
is enacted.

## Audience

These notes are for:

- Full Node Operators running a Midnight node on any network.
- Stake Pool Operators preparing for public network operation.
- The Midnight Foundation, coordinating the runtime upgrade across environments.
- Shielded Technologies engineering and SRE teams.
- External integrators pinning a node version, and toolkit users replaying chain history.

Operators tracking the development line should read the sister-line note in Metadata before upgrading.

## Dependencies

Component-local hard requirements:

- Every validator on the chain must already be running node 1.0.300 when the runtime upgrade is enacted. The new runtime imports the host function `ext_ledger_8_bridge_apply_transaction_version_2`, which an older binary cannot instantiate; a validator left behind stops importing blocks at the `set_code` (commit aee7bb4a).
- Devnet nodes, and only devnet nodes, must be re-initialised from the regenerated genesis; its hash changed to `0xe50ea0ab2997fab2ea6fce3c198f4ff34e6c4f3e7747c133746053a0e82b60e5` (commit a1aa9ff4). Preview, preprod and mainnet keep their existing genesis.

For every other interop question, see the bundle dependency matrix.

**Downstream impact (cascading effects).**

- The toolkit at this tag learns `spec_version` 1000300 and its metadata, so it can replay blocks produced by this runtime on any network; earlier toolkits abort with `UnsupportedBlockVersion(1000300)` (commit 40643af0).
- Indexers and any other consumer that pins devnet's genesis hash must be pointed at the regenerated genesis; consumers on other networks are unaffected (commit a1aa9ff4).

## Tested-with versions

Build pins read from the workspace manifest at the release tag — not QA-verified.

| Component                  | Tested-with version                    |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| `midnight-ledger` (v8)     | `8.1.2` (commit 31f4c365)              |
| `midnight-ledger` (v7)     | `7.0.3` (commit 31f4c365)              |
| `midnight-zswap` (v8 / v7) | `8.1.2` / `7.0.3` (commit 31f4c365)    |
| `midnight-storage`         | `2.0.3` (v8) / `1.1.1` (v7) (commit 31f4c365) |
| `midnight-onchain-runtime` | `3.1.1` (v8) / `2.0.1` (v7) (commit 31f4c365) |
| `polkadot-sdk`             | `polkadot-stable2603` (commit 31f4c365) |
| `compactc`                 | `0.30.0` (commit 31f4c365)             |
| `partner-chains`           | vendored in-tree subtree, no released version pin (commit 31f4c365) |

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime — a new node binary or image plus a coordinated on-chain runtime upgrade. `spec_version` moves 1_000_000 -> 1_000_300 and `system_version` 1 -> 3; `transaction_version` is unchanged at 3 (commit 31f4c365).
- **Reset required**: Yes on devnet, No elsewhere. Devnet must be reset onto the regenerated genesis: the rebuilt chain spec embeds the 1.0.300 runtime instead of the stale 0.22.0 one, and the reserve and ICS pools are now populated, which changes the genesis hash (commit a1aa9ff4, commit 25023606). Preview, preprod and mainnet upgrade in place with no state wipe or re-sync.
- **Governance action required**: Yes — enact `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.300.compact.compressed.wasm` on chain with `set_code`, once per network; proposal hash `0x9dc5d53940d569d0e50d3895bfca19e6aae7d7e8cca0b230d14efbcfd53e6d7e` (commit aee7bb4a, release body). The procedure is set out below.
- **Downtime / coordination**: Coordinated, but hot — the binary roll is a rolling restart and the runtime upgrade takes effect at the block that enacts it. There is no maintenance window as such; the ordering below is what matters (commit aee7bb4a).

### Upgrade procedure

Per network. The ordering is not advisory: step 3 before step 1 is complete strands every validator that has not moved.

1. **Verify the blob.** Check `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.300.compact.compressed.wasm` against `srtool-digest.json` from the same release — blake2-256 `0xc137030dadb39492cf68ab4bd8c564fe75fcc432a421fca091aea54966ee09d3`, sha256 `0x21b3ea7ea82aa46f6a3d6f088527b7422f16ed1af44fa7caad00e21ae89d9616`. The build is reproducible under `paritytech/srtool:1.93.0`, so rebuilding must yield the same hashes (release body).
2. **Roll every validator onto node 1.0.300**, as a rolling restart. The new binary keeps importing blocks under the old on-chain runtime, so there is no rush between this step and the next (commit aee7bb4a).
3. **Confirm nothing is left behind.** Every validator on the network must report the 1.0.300 binary before the upgrade is enacted. A validator on an older binary cannot instantiate the new runtime and stops importing blocks at the `set_code` (commit aee7bb4a).
4. **Enact the runtime.** `set_code` with the compressed blob, proposal hash `0x9dc5d53940d569d0e50d3895bfca19e6aae7d7e8cca0b230d14efbcfd53e6d7e`. The two-step path is also available from the same attestation: `authorize_upgrade` with `0xf9f33e445ee09ec3c5a96807c04f40b318be259e3470e8d37fad4ba3bf951257`, then `apply_authorized_upgrade` with the blob (release body).
5. **Verify enactment.** Nodes should report `spec_version` 1000300 and `transactionVersion` 3; the `tblock` correction stops being applied to blocks from the enacting block onward, while earlier blocks still replay against the pre-upgrade runtime and still correct (commit aee7bb4a, release body).

Devnet only, and separately from the above: regenerate the genesis, reset the chain onto it, and wipe node state first — see Breaking changes (commit a1aa9ff4, commit 25023606).

## Artifacts

Binaries:

- `midnight-node-1.0.300-linux-amd64.tar.gz` — node binary, x86-64 (`sha256:9366de4ba2b93ee7a9e1b570bc76739a6be9f22f084f212b0f190f468b2c64f0`, release body).
- `midnight-node-1.0.300-linux-arm64.tar.gz` — node binary, arm64 (`sha256:01026e732da93bd1070c121dc846016727998eeaf377644966e157d4b8c3721d`, release body).
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.300-linux-amd64.tar.gz` — toolkit binary, x86-64 (`sha256:314a71c0f313c561263abdcb1c02a79b8dbdf32ffe32bf8176febb9a5e7d9b77`, release body).
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.300-linux-arm64.tar.gz` — toolkit binary, arm64 (`sha256:acb4e8f31de8fb6e6899410a7b7d21846b0fc44da2a290e7ebf9f612edd56572`, release body).

Runtime, built reproducibly with srtool v0.18.4 under `paritytech/srtool:1.93.0`, rustc 1.93.0, at 2026-09-22T12:48:25Z. All three report `specVersion` 1000300 and `transactionVersion` 3 (release body, `srtool-digest.json`):

- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.300.compact.compressed.wasm` — **the blob to enact.** 538,767 bytes, blake2-256 `0xc137030dadb39492cf68ab4bd8c564fe75fcc432a421fca091aea54966ee09d3`, sha256 `0x21b3ea7ea82aa46f6a3d6f088527b7422f16ed1af44fa7caad00e21ae89d9616`. `set_code` proposal hash `0x9dc5d53940d569d0e50d3895bfca19e6aae7d7e8cca0b230d14efbcfd53e6d7e`; `authorize_upgrade` hash `0xf9f33e445ee09ec3c5a96807c04f40b318be259e3470e8d37fad4ba3bf951257`. IPFS `QmYm5XEf22SQHJdznnqCBnYpncB69nEcGZK3LN1ZrUpZPE` (release body).
- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.300.compact.wasm` — uncompressed compact build, for inspection and `subwasm diff`. 2,922,378 bytes, blake2-256 `0xac349008e2fbc4ec30bcc71329b8e3541d562ca41caea5861079a01970dc4540`, sha256 `0x4da87bdde096b53e2973cd41e1fe01386972d94b3acc183624c2e89ffa6b21a0` (release body).
- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.300.wasm` — full unoptimised build, for debugging. 23,285,002 bytes, `sha256:9b12467f8fbc333e63ad6e7e82649d69ac468636f52bee91df7a9a9079a02196` (release body).

Verification:

- `SHA256SUMS` — checksum manifest covering the tarballs and wasm blobs (`sha256:d140a174f16ac73eac442c11d396d49bd3673a9e27dfee3bb7a6e0db028a32d1`, release body).
- `srtool-digest.json` — deterministic-build attestation; rebuild under the same srtool image and the hashes above must match (`sha256:90999d6d104e111fa02cf1bb80cc9a62f994b55b78d4de3d15386a4c4f4693cf`, release body).

Images:

- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:1.0.300` — node image, multi-arch index `sha256:22d917342fd7535cb5baf6b54d5926920abe323e0e336b33846a8160a5cbadc4`; linux/amd64 `sha256:1b15517e63a888c5d320939bae504e8370c5224bd46e37aa6f136d79a0a7c8d1`, linux/arm64 `sha256:56d881394c2a222d029cadb8bfaee314ee15ac29f575dcd859c7c784ca0e90ed`. Per-arch tags `1.0.300-amd64` and `1.0.300-arm64` carry the same digests (commit 31f4c365).
- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:1.0.300` — toolkit image, multi-arch index `sha256:664600a376047569cbad47ab2ea8c88479fb47610e8a2bc6a192e667d08d9fbd`; linux/amd64 `sha256:2c30751a9f5928632c373ab4adb08f1d25b84a6e7161ebff6378c75e0e2e765c`, linux/arm64 `sha256:f497d07cb97f0b7c21d2a2ba75f2e9ab41c0e8db422e61ac67abefb6a72e3d8d`. Per-arch tags `1.0.300-amd64` and `1.0.300-arm64` carry the same digests (commit 31f4c365).

## What changed

- Verify a block's first ledger transaction against the parent block's timestamp plus twelve seconds, so historical blocks whose transactions were served from the producing node's warm strict cache still import (PR #1932, commit b09b64b3).
- Gate that correction on the on-chain runtime rather than a hardcoded cut-off date, by adding version 2 of the `Ledger8Bridge` `apply_transaction` and `validate_guaranteed_execution` host functions, which does not apply it (PR #2002).
- Raise `RuntimeVersion::system_version` from 1 to 3 so the runtime uses the FRAME pending-code upgrade path (PR #1900).
- Rebuild the devnet chain spec against the 1.0.300 runtime; devnet had been embedding the 0.22.0 runtime and reporting `spec_version` 22000 whatever binary was running. Other networks' chain specs are unchanged — they take the new runtime through `set_code` (commit a1aa9ff4).
- Populate devnet's reserve and ICS configs so the generated genesis has a non-empty Locked pool, unblocking Cardano-to-Midnight bridge user transfers (commit 25023606, issue #2159).
- Teach the toolkit devnet's `spec_version` 1000300 and its metadata, so it can replay blocks from this runtime (commit 40643af0).
- Remove `gdb` from the node, toolkit and hardfork-test-upgrader images (PR #2187).
- Bump the npm CLI bundled in the toolkit image from 11.11.0 to 11.18.0, clearing a critical `tar` advisory and several other image scan findings (PR #1919).
- Version bumps across the workspace crates, the static metadata blob and `docs/openrpc.json` (commit 40643af0).

## New features

None.

## New features requiring configuration updates

None. The `tblock_correction_offset` and `tblock_correction_disable_after` node-config keys introduced mid-line by commit c0252640 were removed again by commit aee7bb4a before this tag, so an operator moving from 1.0.2 to 1.0.300 has no config key to add or remove (commit 31f4c365 — neither key is present in the tree at either tag).

## Improvements

**Improvement**: `tblock` correction is now consensus-safe

**Description**: The correction's offset and cut-off date used to be read from node config, so a validator with a different `default.toml` would verify historical blocks differently from its peers. The offset is now hardcoded at twelve seconds — `slot_duration_secs * (1 + MaxSkippedSlots)` — and activation is decided by the on-chain runtime, so every node replays a given height identically (commit aee7bb4a).

**Improvement**: smaller, harder container images

**Description**: `gdb-16.3` is gone from the node, toolkit and hardfork-test-upgrader images. A debugger in a runtime image gives anyone with exec access ptrace-based memory inspection of a running validator, including key material, and drags in a sizeable dependency closure. `strace`, `procps-ng`, `vim`, `jq` and `tree` remain for routine triage (commit e6eb5464).

**Improvement**: toolkit replays 1.0.300 devnet history

**Description**: The toolkit's runtime table and metadata now include `spec_version` 1000300, so replaying devnet history produced by this runtime no longer aborts (commit 40643af0).

## Deprecations

None.

## Breaking changes

### Breaking change `runtime upgrade requires every validator on 1.0.300 first`

**What changed**: The runtime adds version 2 of the `Ledger8Bridge` `apply_transaction` and `validate_guaranteed_execution` host functions, and the enacted wasm imports them (PR #2002).

**What breaks**: A validator still running an older binary cannot instantiate the new runtime. It stops importing blocks at the `set_code` and falls off the chain (commit aee7bb4a).

**Required actions**: in this order, and only in this order.

- Roll every validator onto the node 1.0.300 binary or image (commit aee7bb4a).
- Confirm no validator is left on an older binary before enacting the upgrade (commit aee7bb4a).
- Enact the runtime upgrade with `set_code` only after that confirmation (commit aee7bb4a).

**Code example**: none applies — this is an operational sequencing requirement, not an API migration.

### Breaking change `devnet genesis regenerated (devnet only)`

**What changed**: The devnet chain spec was rebuilt on the 1.0.300 runtime, and devnet's reserve and ICS configs were populated (reserve 6,000,000,000.873988 NIGHT, ICS 1,200,000,000 NIGHT) so the generated genesis has a non-empty Locked pool. `Throttle` starts at storage version 1. The ledger genesis state file itself is unchanged (commit a1aa9ff4, commit 25023606).

**What breaks**: The devnet genesis hash changed to `0xe50ea0ab2997fab2ea6fce3c198f4ff34e6c4f3e7747c133746053a0e82b60e5`. A node or downstream service holding the previous devnet genesis cannot join or follow the regenerated chain (commit a1aa9ff4).

**Required actions**: devnet only; preview, preprod and mainnet need none of these steps.

- Regenerate the devnet genesis and reset devnet onto it (commit 25023606).
- Wipe chain state on every devnet node before restarting (commit 25023606).
- Repoint indexers and other consumers that pin the devnet genesis hash (commit a1aa9ff4).

## Known issues

v1.0.300 has a known sync issue with mainnet on a particular block, this will be resolved in v1.0.400.

## Links and references

- **QA test coverage / test evidence**: —
- **PRs**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/compare/node-1.0.2...node-1.0.300>
- **Engineering docs**: — the upgrade procedure is inline, under Deployment information (owner-confirmed 2026-09-22).
- **Migration guides**: —
- **SDK docs**: —
- **Known issues board**: —
- **Public schema**: <https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/node-1.0.300/docs/openrpc.json>
- **API documentation**: the node serves the same document at runtime through the `rpc.discover` JSON-RPC method.

## Fixed defect list

| Defect number | Description                                                                                                   |
| ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| PR #1932      | Warm transaction-validation caches produced different validation results for the same block (issue #1924).      |
| PR #1964      | The `tblock` correction was applied to every historical transaction, stalling Preview at block #128536.          |
| PR #1965      | Backport of PR #1964 onto this line.                                                                            |
| commit aee7bb4a | The correction's cut-off date and offset were consensus-critical values read from per-node config. |
| PR #1900      | Off-chain Runtime API calls could run new wasm against unmigrated storage after `set_code`.                      |
| commit c0252640 | Critical `tar` advisory GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw (`tar@7.5.9`, fixed in 7.5.19) in the npm CLI bundled in the toolkit image, plus flagged sigstore, @sigstore/core, @sigstore/verify, minimatch, brace-expansion, picomatch and ip-address packages. |
| PR #2187      | `gdb` shipped in the node, toolkit and hardfork-test-upgrader images.                                            |
| commit a1aa9ff4 | The devnet chain spec embedded the 0.22.0 runtime, so devnet reported `spec_version` 22000 regardless of binary. |
| commit 25023606 | Devnet genesis had an empty Locked pool, so the Cardano-to-Midnight bridge had no mNIGHT to credit (issue #2159). |

# node 2.1.0-rc.4

## Metadata

- **Release type**: minor
  - Semver delta 2.0.x to 2.1.0, from the release body component list (`node-2.1.0`, `toolkit-2.1.0`, `runtime-2.1.0`) (release body)
- **Date**: 2026-09-30 (release body, published 2026-09-30T15:36:10Z)
- **Ships in bundle**: `2026-q3-release-1` (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01)
- **Sister-line note**: This release is on the 2.1.0 pre-release line (ledger 9 hard fork) and supersedes 2.1.0-rc.3 (release body). Operators on the 1.0.x mainnet line stay on node 1.0.300, whose release note defers the mainnet sync-from-genesis fix to v1.0.400 (release body of node-1.0.300).
- **Environment**: none yet; this release has not been through release QA (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01)
- **Released artifact(s)**: see **Artifacts** below (GitHub release [node-2.1.0-rc.4](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-2.1.0-rc.4), tag tree [node-2.1.0-rc.4](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-2.1.0-rc.4), plus two Docker images) (release body)
- **Component class**: core/infra (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime, as a hard fork from 1.0.300 (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01) (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Reset required**: No. Nothing under `res/` changes between rc.3 and rc.4 (commit 1b2b31c71) (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Governance action required**: Yes, a federated-authority motion (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01) (see **Deployment information** below)

## High-level summary

2.1.0-rc.4 follows 2.1.0-rc.3 on the ledger 9 hard-fork line with two fixes (commit 1b2b31c71). A node syncing mainnet from genesis no longer halts at block #1788979 on `Intent TTL has expired` (commit 7955f18ec), and cNIGHT observation stops logging ordinary Cardano registration data as fatal errors (commit 0aa5479bd).

## Audience

- Full node operators and validators running the 2.1.0 pre-release line, and anyone syncing a new mainnet node from genesis.
- Shielded Technologies engineering, SRE and QA teams testing the ledger 9 hard fork.
- Operators who alert on node error logs, since cNIGHT observation log levels change.

## Dependencies

- Hard incompatibilities: —. `Cargo.lock` and `COMPACTC_VERSION` are unchanged from rc.3 (commit 1b2b31c71).

**Downstream impact (cascading effects).**

- Log-based alerting: the cNIGHT `Fatal:` and `fatal integrity error` lines for invalid DUST keys and for addresses gaining a third registration move to debug, so alerts keyed on those strings go quiet. A dropped observation for any other reason now logs a warning carrying the UTXO reference (commit 0aa5479bd).

## Tested-with versions

> Build pins — not QA-verified. Taken from `Cargo.lock` and `COMPACTC_VERSION` at the tag (commit 1b2b31c71); unchanged from rc.3.

| Component | Tested-with version |
| --- | --- |
| `midnight-ledger` (ledger 8) | `8.1.2`, crates.io (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| `midnight-ledger-v9` (ledger 9) | `1.0.0` from tag `crate-ledger-9.1.0.0-rc.5` (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| `midnight-onchain-runtime` (ledger 9) | `4.0.0` from tag `onchain-runtime-4.0.0-rc.4` (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| `midnight-zswap` (ledger 9) | `9.0.0` from tag `zswap-9.0.0-rc.5` (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| `polkadot-sdk` | shieldedtech fork, `stable2606` branch at commit 6b0ce4838600 (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| `partner-chains` | vendored in-tree, `sidechain-domain` `1.8.1` (commit 1b2b31c71) |
| Compact compiler | `0.33.0-rc.1` from `COMPACTC_VERSION` (commit 1b2b31c71) |

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime. The only supported route is the hard fork from 1.0.300; no public network runs this release line (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01). Between rc.3 and rc.4 the node binary changes (ledger host functions) and the runtime changes too: `pallet-cnight-observation` log levels, with no state, storage or consensus change (commit 0aa5479bd). `spec_version` stays at `002_001_000` and `transaction_version` at 4, although the runtime wasm hashes differ from rc.3 (commit 1b2b31c71). `subwasm diff` of the rc.3 and rc.4 compressed runtimes finds no metadata change and no `transaction_version` bump required; the wasm grows by 2,325 bytes (release body).
- **Reset required**: No. Nothing under `res/` (chain specs, genesis, config presets) changes between rc.3 and rc.4 (commit 1b2b31c71). The sync fix needs no re-sync for nodes already past block #1788980 (commit 7955f18ec).
- **Governance action required**: Yes. A federated-authority motion enacts the runtime upgrade (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).
- **Downtime / coordination**: Moving from rc.3 is node-binary only and can be a rolling restart (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01). For the hard fork from 1.0.300, upgrade node binaries first with a rolling restart and no downtime, then the federated-authority motion enacts the runtime (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).

## Artifacts

GitHub release assets (release body):

- `midnight-node-2.1.0-rc.4-linux-amd64.tar.gz`: node binary, linux/amd64, `sha256:141f29d9022c65851458dd6a90768d3f6a0b119033499554c3bb6f6dafa45f32`

- `midnight-node-toolkit-2.1.0-rc.4-linux-arm64.tar.gz`: toolkit binary, linux/arm64, `sha256:42adfb8f714d8aa4e076570acd1d22ffa716b5d84caca68808558542dab24d1a`
- `midnight_node_runtime-2.1.0-rc.4.compact.compressed.wasm`: runtime, compressed, `sha256:90f2a211cb776205399e59abd5202db9833f67b06b92393f90e274647cd8098b`
- `midnight_node_runtime-2.1.0-rc.4.compact.wasm`: runtime, compact, `sha256:e1afdf119c4bff47fe90a9de15d0605e1b8c8fd5983ac2e06f3f2c1765ab19c7`
- `midnight_node_runtime-2.1.0-rc.4.wasm`: runtime, full, `sha256:13bf224ff7d07656da34b56cd4438f66d00b683ad5e97cdc97aa0b212b2abbb5`
  - `subwasm info`: core version `midnight-2001000` (`midnight-0.tx4.au1`), metadata V14, Blake2-256 `0x275384e0c8873e611f6970469287279431f46aa43c59009ef11ce7561e09490d`, `authorizeUpgrade` call hash `0xfd0c3535897daf3301acb1efbe925f3e910ed71e0bdc0bb523da48e92cbb408c`
- `SHA256SUMS`: checksums for the assets above, `sha256:8893840b264ee2d03829baa1e20eafda477207f140aaf1e60034c776e8bcf724`
- `srtool-digest.json`: attestation of the deterministic runtime build, `sha256:5355925b0c49b2f2d58b31d6f6ba85c1cef3cefffc8b1b11f0b6a82f6a09fc1a`

Container images (Docker Hub registry digests):

- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:2.1.0-rc.4`: node image, index `sha256:9040c346c27f569b72dfbbad9420cf38fc7cc6a13b38adf814a925bbe9311678`
  - linux/amd64 (also tagged `2.1.0-rc.4-amd64`): `sha256:9ae2184a6540aea53976469e96c1c43295942e55321d6ae11016803448595e45`
  - linux/arm64 (also tagged `2.1.0-rc.4-arm64`): `sha256:b645efc934a490c8c6f5790a99f0c39b1014e608ecc763fd9baec98b279ba65c`
- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:2.1.0-rc.4`: toolkit image, index `sha256:b17370121f4e438eaf7d0b466cbe5f7df391b8b39418d5d5892b6a6a0b4737b6`
  - linux/amd64 (also tagged `2.1.0-rc.4-amd64`): `sha256:ba068caf976e608c97065df122759a50f63da3566a044fc3a62bffe330a7f7d5`
  - linux/arm64 (also tagged `2.1.0-rc.4-arm64`): `sha256:7965ff0982a0c1ec96b8993282fb41bfb641a869d5a3d35a8a326ef747624ebe`
- The release body also gives a GHCR pull reference, `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/midnight-node:2.1.0-rc.4` (release body).

## What changed

- *Node upgrade.* Syncing mainnet from genesis no longer halts at block #1788979. The v1 tblock correction verified a historical block's first ledger transaction only at `parent_block_time + 12s`, but the first transaction of block #1788980 has an intent TTL (`1784643562`) between the block timestamp (`1784643558`) and `parent + 12` (`1784643564`), so it was rejected with `Intent TTL has expired`. A first transaction that fails at the corrected `tblock` is now retried at the block's own `tblock`. The retry is only reachable under host-function v1, so it never applies to blocks after the v2 runtime upgrade at mainnet block #2738210. The author verified a sync to tip with a 2.1.0 build, with db-sync inherent checks turned off; a full replay of mainnet #1774491 to #2738209 was not done (PR #2216, backported in PR #2218).
- *Node upgrade + Runtime upgrade.* cNIGHT observation no longer logs expected on-chain data as fatal. A registration whose DUST public key is out of range for the Fr field logs the skipped `CNightGeneratesDustEvent` at debug instead of `Fatal:` at error, and the native `construct_cnight_generates_dust_event` host function logs the same deserialization failure at debug, which also quiets it during sync from genesis. Any other failure to build the event logs a warning that the observation was dropped, with the UTXO reference. An address that already has two or more registrations gaining another now logs at debug instead of `fatal integrity error`; re-observing a stored registration UTXO stays at error, reworded to point at the cursor or data source. The host-function change takes effect on node upgrade, the pallet change at the next runtime upgrade; registration semantics are unchanged (PR #2220, backported in PR #2225).
- Dependency housekeeping: `npm audit fix` refreshes the `local-environment` and `util/toolkit-js` lockfiles (commit 4567f6401).

## New features

None

## New features requiring configuration updates

None

## Improvements

**Improvement**: Quieter cNIGHT observation logs

**Description**: *Node upgrade + Runtime upgrade.* The error-level flood from ordinary Cardano registration data, which hid real failures during sync, drops to debug, and a genuinely dropped observation now carries its UTXO reference (PR #2220).

## Deprecations

None

## Breaking changes

None

## Known issues

### Issue: filtered transactions enter blocks in safe mode

**Description**: While the chain is in safe mode, filtered `send_mn_transaction` extrinsics still enter the pool and are included as failed extrinsics. Issue [#2205](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/2205) is open, and the rc.3 to rc.4 diff does not touch this path (commit 1b2b31c71). It affects rc.4, and the fix lands in a release after 2.1.0 (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).
**Workaround (if any)**: none needed. Impact is low, because block space is always reserved for governance actions (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).

### Issue: `reset_members` reports more weight than it declares

**Description**: When both governance committees change in one block, the `reset_members` inherent reports more weight than it declares and nodes log a post-dispatch weight warning. Issue [#2226](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/2226) is open, and the rc.3 to rc.4 diff does not touch `federated-authority-observation` (commit 1b2b31c71). It affects rc.4; impact is low, and the fix lands in a release after 2.1.0 (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).
**Workaround (if any)**: None known (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01).

## Links and references

- **QA test coverage / test evidence**: — (no release QA yet) (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01)
- **PRs**: [#2216](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2216), [#2218](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2218), [#2220](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2220), [#2225](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2225); compare [node-2.1.0-rc.3...node-2.1.0-rc.4](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/compare/node-2.1.0-rc.3...node-2.1.0-rc.4)
- **Engineering docs**: —
- **Migration guides**: —
- **SDK docs**: —
- **Known issues board**: [open issues](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues)
- **Public schema**: —
- **API documentation**: —

## Fixed defect list

The following defects were fixed in 2.1.0-rc.4.

| Defect number | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [#2229](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/2229) | A node syncing mainnet from genesis halted at block #1788979 with `Intent TTL has expired` (PR #2218). rc.4 syncs mainnet from genesis to tip with default settings (owner-confirmed 2026-10-01). |
| [#1819](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/1819) | cNIGHT observation flooded error logs with `fatal integrity error` and `DustPublicKey` deserialization failures during sync (PR #2225). |

The release body also gives a GHCR pull reference, `ghcr.io/midnightntwrk/midnight-node:2.1.0-rc.3`. ## What changed - *Node upgrade + Toolkit.* Security: the node and toolkit images move to the `amazonlinux:2023-minimal` 2023.12.20260918 base. That base ships unbound 1.17.1-1.amzn2023.0.14 for the critical advisory ALAS2023-2026-3101, along with fixed openssl, glibc, libnghttp2, glib2 and libsolv. The `curl-minimal`, `vim-enhanced` and `jq` pins move to that snapshot's versions, since the old pins held them on vulnerable builds (PR #2207, backported in PR #2213). - *Node upgrade + Toolkit.* Security: gdb is removed from the node and toolkit images. A debugger in a validator image allows ptrace-based memory inspection, key material included, for anyone with exec access. `strace`, `procps-ng`, `vim`, `jq` and `tree` remain for triage (PR #2187, rolled up into 2.1.0 in PR #2206). - *Node upgrade.* JSON-RPC sockets now set `TCP_NODELAY`. The substrate RPC server accepted connections without it, so small messages such as `chainHead` notifications were batched and delayed. The fix is upstream paritytech/polkadot-sdk#12797, carried on a shieldedtech fork of `stable2606` (PR #2200). - *Node upgrade.* Cardano-to-Midnight bridge transactions whose Midnight recipient address is too short are now marked invalid. Before this, they would stall bridge processing. The bridge is not yet enabled (PR #2185, backported in PR #2197). - *Node upgrade.* The committee-membership watcher checks for `SessionInfoApi` before calling it. Runtimes without that API are skipped with a single info line, where before every imported block logged an error (PR #2204). - *Toolkit.* `ecdsa:` seeds are accepted on chains forked from ledger 8. The guard used to read the ledger version of the first block and now reads the chain tip, so a chain still on ledger 8 is still refused. Before the fork such a seed replays as a watch-only unshielded wallet at its ECDSA address, and shielded funds received before the fork stay spendable (PR #2181, PR #2183). ## New features None ## New features requiring configuration updates None ## Improvements **Improvement**: Smaller node images with less attack surface **Description**: *Node upgrade + Toolkit.* Removing gdb drops a debugger and its sizeable dependency closure from the node and toolkit images. Fix fork-network runtime upgrade hang connecting to the forked node The `fork-network` workflow's `runtime` upgrade mode could hang until the 45-minute job timeout at "Connecting to node at ws://localhost:9950". The forked chain is healthy the whole time (all validators up, RPC bound, producing and finalizing blocks) — the problem is that on some self-hosted runners the host loopback -> docker-published-port path is black-holed (e.g. Docker started with `userland-proxy` disabled): the SYN is silently dropped, so the polkadot-js `WsProvider` — which has no connect timeout of its own — never establishes and never errors. `image` mode is unaffected because it never opens a `WsProvider`. The `runtime` step now brings the fork up first, then connects to whichever RPC endpoint actually answers — preferring the published port but falling back to node1's docker bridge IP, which is routable from the runner regardless of the loopback/DNAT setup — and reuses that endpoint for the finality-wait and `:code` verification steps. As defense-in-depth, `createApi` in the local-environment tooling now fails fast with an actionable error after a bounded connect timeout (`API_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS`), and its `DEFAULT_RPC_URL` uses an explicit IPv4 host. `full` mode brings the fork up internally (no `--skip-run`) so it still relies on the published port; making it robust needs a follow-up tooling change. name: node-1.0.2
body:
## Metadata

- **Release type**: patch
  - Derived from the semver delta `1.0.1` -> `1.0.2` in `node/Cargo.toml` (commit ba01711e1745).
- **Date**: 2026-09-18
- **Ships in bundle**: none — this patch is not bundle-bound; the board stub at `releases/patches/node/node-1-0-2.md` in `midnight-network-ops` records `ships_in_bundle: none`.
- **Sister-line note**: "This release is on the `1.0.x` mainnet maintenance line. Operators tracking the `2.x` development line should track `node-2.1.0-rc.2` instead."
- **Environment**: Mainnet
- **Released artifact(s)**: see **Artifacts** below (9 GitHub release assets plus 2 container images).
- **Component class**: `core/infra` (drives which operator fields apply; see **Deployment information** below)
- **Upgrade scope**: `binary only` (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Reset required**: `No` (see **Deployment information** below)
- **Governance action required**: `No` (see **Deployment information** below)

## High-level summary

A maintenance patch on the 1.0.x mainnet line. It repins ledger 8 to the 8.1.2 security release (deserialization hardening plus a set of panic and overflow fixes), clears open npm advisories in the toolkit's JavaScript dependencies, and fixes a toolkit-js stack overflow seen on Node.js 24.21 and later. No pallet or runtime code changed: `spec_version` stays at `001_000_000` and `transaction_version` stays at `3`, so this is a node-binary upgrade with no on-chain runtime upgrade.

## Audience

Scoped to:

- Full node operators running the 1.0.x line on Mainnet.
- Stake pool operators tracking the mainnet maintenance line.
- Shielded Technologies engineering and SRE running the release and local environments.
- Toolkit users driving the node from `midnight-node-toolkit` or `toolkit-js`.

Operators on the 2.x development line are not in scope — see the sister-line note above.

## Dependencies

Component-local hard constraints:

- Ledger 8 is pinned exactly at `8.1.2`, whose decoding is stricter than the previously pinned 8.1.1. Mixed 8.1.1 / 8.1.2 validator sets are safe and no lockstep upgrade is required (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21); see **Improvements** for what the hardening covers (release body, commit 2d093ca95b48).
- Toolkit images are built on Node.js 24.21.0 (commit 0d7c0518e34d).

**Downstream impact (cascading effects).**

- None. No RPC, extrinsic or metadata surface changed in this patch (commit ba01711e1745), and the stricter ledger 8.1.2 decoding rejects nothing that downstream indexers, wallets or SDKs have already ingested (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21).

## Tested-with versions

These rows are build pins — not QA-verified. They are read from the workspace manifests and lockfile at tag `node-1.0.2`.

| Component               | Tested-with version   |
| ----------------------- | --------------------- |
| `midnight-ledger`       | `8.1.2`               |
| `midnight-zswap`        | `8.1.2`               |
| `midnight-storage`      | `2.0.3`               |
| `midnight-storage-core` | `1.2.1`               |
| `midnight-onchain-runtime` | `3.1.1`            |
| `midnight-serialize`    | `1.1.1`               |
| `polkadot-sdk`          | `polkadot-stable2603` |
| `midnight-indexer`      | `v4.0.0`              |
| `compactc`              | `0.30.0`              |
| `midnight-node-runtime` | `1.0.0` (spec `001_000_000`, transaction version `3`) |
| `midnight-node-toolkit` | `1.0.0`               |
| Node.js (toolkit image) | `24.21.0`             |

Every row is read from the tagged tree at commit ba01711e1745 (`Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, `COMPACTC_VERSION`, the `indexer` submodule pin, and the `Earthfile` Node.js pin). The repository publishes no root `package.json`, so no registry metadata backs these rows.

## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: `binary only` — no runtime wasm upgrade is required; `spec_version` and `transaction_version` are unchanged from `node-1.0.1` (commit ba01711e1745).
- **Reset required**: `No` — no pallet, storage or migration code changed in the tag-to-tag diff; the only ledger movement is a patch-level crate bump (commit 2d093ca95b48).
- **Governance action required**: `No` — no on-chain proposal, vote or parameter ratification ships with this patch.
- **Downtime / coordination**: `None` — operators can roll this out node by node; no maintenance window or cross-operator timing is needed (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21).

## Artifacts

GitHub release assets at tag `node-1.0.2` (release body):

- `midnight-node-1.0.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz` — node binary, x86-64 Linux.
- `midnight-node-1.0.2-linux-arm64.tar.gz` — node binary, aarch64 Linux.
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz` — toolkit binary, x86-64 Linux.
- `midnight-node-toolkit-1.0.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz` — toolkit binary, aarch64 Linux.
- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.0.wasm` — uncompressed runtime wasm.
- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.0.compact.wasm` — compacted runtime wasm.
- `midnight_node_runtime-1.0.0.compact.compressed.wasm` — compacted and compressed runtime wasm.
- `SHA256SUMS` — checksums for the assets above.
- `srtool-digest.json` — deterministic runtime build attestation.

Container images on Docker Hub, digests resolved 2026-09-21:

- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node:1.0.2` — node image, multi-arch manifest `sha256:612e27363eb3c08d98f1b27b5f27a0cc27b813287dbcace93c55a6c29f7e5a91`; `1.0.2-amd64` is `sha256:ed2ab6f4c94dcd9392f9a4259764384f3028690a20d9ea854e2ee4553de2a6ce` and `1.0.2-arm64` is `sha256:cc4099a3fee5e0eaeab3bbc08cae30f31c571c66bf28053e8a02d0387723f92d`.
- `midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:1.0.0` — toolkit image, multi-arch manifest `sha256:41f55d35c9acc4f527f4afd168ad4d071f745dca65b60cdfdc9d886645e78442`; `1.0.0-amd64` is `sha256:13814c745134c65f399783d7c6b46af12df7526fb239aa6409a38322c3d224c8` and `1.0.0-arm64` is `sha256:4fe3cd04986df859ce91f24c83f0c8790b683a0dc7339570879887bc4a200563`. The toolkit keeps its independent `1.0.0` version at this node tag and the image was re-pushed on 2026-09-18.

## What changed

- Repinned ledger 8 from `8.1.1` to the `8.1.2` security release, taking deserialization hardening, a zero-divisor guard in `DustParameters::time_to_cap`, saturating Dust sequence and delta arithmetic, a Zswap binding-randomness panic fix, and saturating contract-call cost accounting (commit 2d093ca95b48, release body).
- Cleared the open npm advisories in `toolkit-js` and `local-environment`: js-yaml 4.3.2 (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh), nanoid 3.3.19 (GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8), toml 4.3.0 via override (GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf, GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j), turbo 2.9.14 and vitest 4.1.11 (PR #2179).
- Fixed a `toolkit-js` stack overflow on Node.js 24.21 and later, where the compact-js resolve hook re-entered itself through `module.registerHooks` (commit 574ff683539e).
- Build and release housekeeping, not visible in the shipped binaries: toolkit images moved to the Node.js 24.21.0 LTS line (commit 0d7c0518e34d), the contract-compiler local-environment image had its rotted bookworm apt pins refreshed (commit feb04d094352), the shared season pin moved 0.6.0 to 0.7.0 (commit 434ee3643714), and the release-image workflow was reworked so a forced re-tag re-cuts the release rather than erroring (commit 281906cb200e).

## New features

None — this patch introduces no new functionality (commit ba01711e1745).

## New features requiring configuration updates

None — no configuration flag, environment variable or initialisation step changes in this patch (commit ba01711e1745).

## Improvements

**Improvement**: Ledger 8 deserialization hardening

**Description**: The ledger 8 pin moves to 8.1.2, which tightens low-level decoding across `serialize`, `base-crypto`, `storage`, `onchain-state`, `onchain-vm` and `transient-crypto` so that non-canonical encodings and values that violate their type invariants are rejected rather than decoded. Contract-call cost accounting now counts public inputs through `ContractCall::public_inputs_len` with saturating arithmetic instead of materialising the inputs (commit 2d093ca95b48, release body).

**Improvement**: Toolkit image on the Node.js LTS line

**Description**: The `toolkit-js-prep` and `build-test-toolkit` Earthly targets now install Node.js 24.21.0 instead of 23.11.0, and purge the base image's bundled npm and corepack before unpacking so the two trees cannot mix (commit 0d7c0518e34d).

## Deprecations

None.

## Breaking changes

None. Ledger 8.1.2 tightens low-level deserialization — "non-canonical encodings and values violating their type's invariant are now rejected rather than decoded" (release body, commit 2d093ca95b48) — but it requires no consumer action and stays an improvement (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21).

## Known issues

None (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21).

## Links and references

- **QA test coverage / test evidence**: —
- **PRs**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pulls?q=is%3Apr+base%3Arelease%2Fnode-1.0.2+is%3Amerged
- **Engineering docs**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/compare/node-1.0.1...node-1.0.2
- **Migration guides**: — (no migration needed for a binary-only patch)
- **SDK docs**: — (this component ships no SDK)
- **Known issues board**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues
- **Public schema**: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/node-1.0.2/docs/openrpc.json
- **API documentation**: https://docs.midnight.network/ (owner-confirmed 2026-09-21)

## Fixed defect list

The following defects were fixed in `node-1.0.2`.

| Defect number       | Description                                                                                       |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| commit 574ff683539e | `toolkit-js` overflowed the stack on Node.js 24.21+ because the compact-js resolve hook re-entered itself. |
| PR #2179            | npm advisories cleared in `toolkit-js` and `local-environment`: js-yaml 4.3.2 (GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh), nanoid 3.3.19 (GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8), and toml 4.3.0 via override (GHSA-82x6-q7mm-w9cf, GHSA-v5mp-jgw5-2x6j, pending an upstream `@effect/cli` release). |
| commit 2d093ca95b48 | `DustParameters::time_to_cap` divided by zero when `generation_decay_rate` was zero; 8.1.2 guards it. |
| commit 2d093ca95b48 | Dust `seq` increments and `normalize_deltas` delta accumulation could overflow; 8.1.2 saturates.   |
| commit 2d093ca95b48 | Zswap binding-randomness extraction panicked on a proof preimage with no witness to extract.      |
| commit 2d093ca95b48 | Contract-call cost accounting materialised public inputs; 8.1.2 counts them with saturating arithmetic. |

<!-- markdownlint-disable MD012 MD013 MD014 MD022 MD031 MD032 MD033 MD034 MD060 -->

# Midnight Node 2.1.0-rc.2

## Metadata

- **Type of release**: major — the last final release is `node-1.0.1`; `2.0.0` never shipped a final, so `2.1.0` is the first release of a new major line.
- **Date**: 2026-09-17
- **Ships in bundle**: TBD — standalone pre-release (not bundled). No bundle in `midnightntwrk/midnight-network-ops` references this tag; `releases/components/latest-component-releases.md` still lists `2.1.0-rc.1` as the line's latest pre-release and needs updating.
- **Git tag**: [node-2.1.0-rc.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-2.1.0-rc.2)
- **Environment**: devnet, qanet. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/relnotes/overview).
- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime
- **Reset required**: No — with one bootstrap caveat for preview and devnet, see **Deployment information**.
- **Governance action required**: Yes — no *new* action in this delta; the `set_code` enactment carried from `2.1.0-beta.1` still applies.
- **Sister-line note**: This release is on the `2.1.x` line. Operators on the `1.0.x` maintenance line should track `node-1.0.2`. The fork-from baseline is the **`1.0.300`** runtime that devnet actually ran before the hard fork; `2.1.0-beta.1` and `2.1.0-rc.1` named `1.0.3`, which is still pending.

## High-level summary

`2.1.0-rc.2` is a release-engineering candidate: five commits on top of `2.1.0-rc.1`, no new protocol behaviour, no `spec_version` move, and no metadata change. It clears the two things that stood between the line and a publishable final. First, the deterministic srtool runtime WASM is published again — `2.1.0-rc.2` is the **first release of the 2.1.0 line to ship a `*.wasm` asset and an `srtool-digest.json`**, which resolves the headline known issue from `rc.1` and makes a verifiable governance `set_code` artefact available. Second, the 2.1.0 benchmark weights are re-run on the reference machine, correcting a real under-pricing: every call in `pallet_c2m_bridge` and `pallet_partner_chains_bridge` was budgeted at roughly half its cost on validator hardware. Alongside those, two packaged chain-spec corrections fix a defect where a preview or devnet node brought up from an empty disk computed the wrong genesis hash and could not peer.

## Audience

These notes are written for:

- **Full Node Operators (FNOs)** bringing up preview or devnet nodes from an empty disk, or running validators on the `2.1.x` line.
- **Shielded Technologies** engineering, SRE and release engineering, who own the srtool artefact chain and the environment rollout.
- **Midnight Foundation** release coordination, for the governance `set_code` artefact.
- **Developers** using the toolkit to replay devnet history or generate transactions against devnet.
- **External integrators** whose clients, SDKs or indexers decode against the node's metadata — for the one thing they can now stop worrying about, see **Breaking changes**.

## Dependencies

- The runtime WASM blob changes (new weights, new compiler) while `spec_version` stays at `002_001_000` — the third distinct blob to claim that version on this line. ## Deployment information

- **Upgrade scope**: binary + runtime — a new binary and image, plus the coordinated on-chain runtime upgrade. **The supported path into this release is a hard fork from a `1.0.300` chain.** There is no supported upgrade path from `2.1.0-rc.1` or `2.1.0-beta.1`: those are pre-releases on the way to this one, not deployment baselines to step forward from.
- **Reset required**: No for a running node. **Yes for a preview or devnet node that was bootstrapped from `2.1.0-rc.1` or earlier `res/` artefacts** — such a node computed a genesis hash that no live bootnode recognises, was rejected as a different chain, and has been sitting at block #0 with no peers. Wipe its base path and re-bootstrap from this release's `res/`. Nodes already synced on either network are unaffected; their genesis is on disk. **A chain running `2.1.0-rc.1` or `2.1.0-beta.1` is re-forked from `1.0.300`, not stepped forward onto this release.** Nothing else in this delta calls for a state wipe, re-sync or re-index.
- **Governance action required**: Yes, unchanged — the runtime is swapped by a governance `set_code`, and this is the first release of the line that publishes the deterministic blob and digest that action should reference. Enabling the C2M bridge additionally needs a governance action to set its `MainChainScripts` and data checkpoint; without it the bridge's inherent data provider stays `Inert`.
- **Downtime / coordination**: Coordinated, and unchanged from `2.1.0-beta.1` — this is a hard fork from `1.0.300`, not a rolling upgrade of an existing 2.x chain. Roll every validator onto the new binary first, confirm the whole set is importing and finalizing, then enact `set_code`; Cardano observation is gated for the duration of the DUST replay. Only one 2.1.0 pre-release binary should ever be present on a given chain: the cNIGHT UTXO ordering rule (PR [#2123](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2123)) landed mid-series while `spec_version` stayed at `002_001_000`, so mixed pre-release binaries on one 2.x chain reject each other's blocks.

## Improvements

### Deterministic runtime WASM is published again

**Description**: `2.1.0-rc.2` is the first release on the 2.1.0 line to publish `*.wasm` assets and an `srtool-digest.json`. `2.1.0-beta.1` and `2.1.0-rc.1` shipped none, and `rc.1` recorded that as a known issue blocking the final, because a governance `set_code` wants a blob whose hash is independently reproducible — not one extracted from inside a node image. The blocker was the srtool image being pinned to an older Rust (`paritytech/srtool:1.93.0-0.18.4`) than the repo builds with; upstream publishes no 1.98.x tag, so the build now uses `ghcr.io/shieldedtech/srtool:1.98.1-0.18.5`. The resulting artefact is reproducible from the recorded digest, and the first measured metadata diff for the line is in [runtime-diff.md](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/main/docs/release-notes/2.1.0-rc.2/runtime-diff.md). *Runtime upgrade.*
**PR**: [#2166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2166)

### Rust toolchain 1.98.1

**Description**: Updates Rust to 1.98.1 across the workspace `rust-toolchain.toml`, the `subxt` and nightly cNIGHT e2e container base images, and the srtool image. Two build fixes were needed: `ethnum` moves to 1.5.3 (1.5.2 transmuted `()` into `TryFromIntError`, which 1.98.1 rejects), and `WASM_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS` restores `--allow-undefined` for the runtime WASM link, which 1.98.1 dropped from the `wasm32v1-none` target spec and which Substrate's `sp_io` host-function imports rely on. New clippy lints (`useless_borrows_in_formatting`, `unnecessary_get_then_check`) and unused-import warnings account for the rest of the diff across the node, toolkit and the vendored `partner-chains` tree. *Node upgrade + Toolkit + Runtime upgrade.*
**PR**: [#2166](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2166), backported as [#2172](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2172)

### 2.1.0 benchmark weights, measured rather than estimated

**Description**: `benchmark pallet --pallet '*'` was silently skipping four surfaces, so the runtime carried estimates for them. All four are now registered and measured on the reference machine (`c7i.xlarge`, Intel Xeon Platinum 8488C — the same CPU as the 2026-05-08 run) at `STEPS=50, REPEAT=20`:

- `frame_system_extensions` — the `TxExtension` checks every signed transaction pays for. `frame_system::Config::ExtensionsWeightInfo` had been falling back to upstream's `()` impl, whose numbers are Parity's reference hardware and RocksDB; this runtime is ParityDb.
- `pallet_safe_mode` — the crate feature was enabled but the pallet was never listed, so the runtime used upstream `SubstrateWeight`. Safe mode became load-bearing when [#2079](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2079) made it the failed-multi-block-migration handler.
- `pallet_version` — gains a `runtime-benchmarks` feature and an `on_initialize` benchmark. Its production `WeightInfo` returned `Weight::zero()` behind a TODO while the hook appends a digest log on every block.
- `pallet_cnight_observation::set_mapping_validator_contract_address` — the one call in the pallet still priced by a hardcoded `DbWeight::writes(1)`.

Outside those, everything moved within noise except the three `pallet_cnight_observation` setters and `pallet_timestamp::on_finalize`, which fell; the cNIGHT setters were hand-written 10ms placeholders now measured at ~3.8ms. *Runtime upgrade.*
**PR**: [#2160](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2160)

### Bridge pallet weights corrected upward

**Description**: Every function in `pallet_c2m_bridge` and `pallet_partner_chains_bridge` rose 1.92x–2.51x. Those two weight files had previously been generated on a developer workstation (AMD Ryzen 9 9950X) rather than the reference machine, so the runtime had been budgeting roughly half the real cost on validator hardware. `handle_transfers` moves from 121µs to 233µs and is a `Mandatory` inherent, where under-weighting is the unsafe direction — a `Mandatory` call is executed regardless of the remaining block weight budget, so an under-priced one can push a block past its limit rather than being deferred. *Runtime upgrade.*
**PR**: [#2160](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2160)

## Breaking changes

> A third distinct runtime blob now claims `spec_version` `002_001_000`. Operators enacting a `set_code` must reference the blob by hash, not by version — see [runtime-diff.md](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/main/docs/release-notes/2.1.0-rc.2/runtime-diff.md) for the measured metadata and the per-hash identifiers.

### Runtime WASM changes again without a `spec_version` bump — but metadata does not

**What changed**: The runtime blob differs from `2.1.0-rc.1`'s (re-measured weights, new compiler) while `spec_version` stays `002_001_000` and `transaction_version` stays `4`. This narrows — and largely retires — the equivalent breaking change announced in `2.1.0-rc.1`, which was about metadata drifting under a frozen `spec_version`.

**What breaks**: Less than in `rc.1`. **Runtime metadata is unchanged between `rc.1` and `rc.2`, measured directly.** `rc.1` published no WASM asset, but its node image carries one, so the two blobs can be compared: `subwasm diff` reports `No change detected`, and both advertise the same 26 runtime APIs at the same versions. The checked-in `metadata/static/midnight_metadata.scale` is byte-identical at both tags (144,075 bytes) and agrees. This is expected — V14 metadata encodes types, calls, events, errors, storage and constants, **not weights**, and PR [#2160](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2160)'s runtime changes are `WeightInfo` associated-type swaps plus `define_benchmarks!` registrations behind `cfg(feature = "runtime-benchmarks")`. Read that as a property of the blobs, not as upgrade guidance: it says `rc.2` adds no client-facing surface that `rc.1` did not already have, which is what a release candidate should be able to demonstrate. It is not a statement that a chain can move from `rc.1` to `rc.2` — no such path is supported. The client-facing action is the one driven by `1.0.300` → `2.1.0` and it is unchanged: refresh runtime metadata and re-sign. The reproduction is in [runtime-diff.md](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/blob/main/docs/release-notes/2.1.0-rc.2/runtime-diff.md).

What does still bite is artefact identity: three blobs on this line now advertise the same `spec_version`, so `spec_version` alone no longer identifies which runtime a chain is running or which one a proposal enacts.

**Required actions**:

- Identify the runtime by blob hash, not by `spec_version`. For this release: blake2-256 `0xb15f7383617c41cdb1b74b1ea4c8db0f4d0cde5e8438708a89e9f1df343a01b3`, `system.setCode` proposal hash `0x661ab01fc058cdd0bccb33b0372868eae3e6f8ef3c4263a7a63f93e6d2c5fed3`.
- Do not pin production tooling against `rc.2` metadata: `002_001_000` is not yet released onto any chain and is still being filled in on this line.
- Do not treat the unchanged metadata as a path between pre-releases: a chain on `2.1.0-rc.1` or `2.1.0-beta.1` is re-forked from `1.0.300`, not stepped forward onto this release.

**Code example**: — (no client-facing API surface changes)

### Carried forward, unchanged

The consensus-affecting cNIGHT UTXO ordering change (PR [#2123](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/2123)) announced in `2.1.0-rc.1` still applies in full: a `2.1.0-beta.1` binary and any `2.1.0-rc.x` binary must not validate the same `2.x` chain concurrently, because the ordering rule changed mid-series while `spec_version` stayed at `002_001_000`. The operative rule for this release is simpler than the flag-day procedure `rc.1` described: fork from `1.0.300` with one pre-release binary across the whole validator set, and re-fork rather than step a chain forward from an earlier 2.1.0 pre-release. See the [`2.1.0-rc.1` notes](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-2.1.0-rc.1) for the full description of the ordering change.
