# Midnight Node 1.0.0-rc.1 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-04-02
**Git tag:** [node-1.0.0-rc.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-1.0.0-rc.1)
**Tree hash:** c0b6eef82d3de5f78b8e0798bd8d945d814a3526
**Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview, qanet)

## Docker Images

```shell
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:1.0.0-rc.1
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:1.0.0-rc.1
```

## Summary

Midnight Node 1.0.0-rc.1 is the first release candidate for the 1.0.0 mainnet release. It includes two runtime changes — a governance weight-bound fix and a per-account transaction count throttle with storage migration — alongside significant node reliability improvements (chain-state truncation fix, graceful shutdown), security hardening across CI workflows and the toolkit, and a major toolkit overhaul with file-based caching, batch transaction generation, and performance improvements.

## Audience

- [x] **Node operators** — runtime upgrade with storage migration; node binary update required
- [x] **Toolkit users** — new commands, breaking CLI and log format changes
- [ ] **DApp developers** — no direct API changes

## What Changed

| Change | Upgrade Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Add proposal_weight_bound parameter to motion_close | Runtime | [#1032](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1032) |
| Add per-account transaction count limit to throttle pallet (with migration) | Runtime | [#1060](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1060) |
| Add per-SQL-query Prometheus timing for data source queries | Node | [#904](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/904) |
| Add `rpc.discover` endpoint with OpenRPC v1.4 API specification | Node | [#869](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/869) |
| Point to midnightntwrk partner chains fork | Node | [#948](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/948) |
| Clean up Postgresql connection, add ssl_root_cert config | Node | [#1029](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1029) |
| Improve logging for ledger transaction errors | Node | [#961](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/961) |
| Cache multi_asset.id to avoid excessive joins | Node | [#934](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/934) |
| Fix chain-state truncation after unclean shutdown | Node | [#1140](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1140) |
| Drop ledger default storage on node shutdown | Node | [#886](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/886) |
| Reduce cNIGHT observation address logging level | Node | [#905](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/905) |
| Remove hard-fork test ledger version dependencies | Node | [#1024](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1024) |
| Reject unsupported system transaction types | Node | [#840](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/840) |
| Remove stale cost model stubs and re-enable integration test | Node | [#839](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/839) |
| Validate genesis file type and size before reading | Node | [#832](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/832) |
| Bump version to 1.0.0 | Node | [#919](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/919) |
| Bump vulnerable dependencies | Node + Toolkit | [#1079](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1079) |

## Known Issues

- Omission: RC.1 does not include the mainnet chainspecs.

## New Features

### Runtime

- **Per-account transaction count throttle** (Runtime, [#1060](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1060)) — Extends the existing per-account throttle to enforce a maximum number of transactions (`MaxTxs`) within each rolling block window, alongside the existing byte limit. Prevents governance committee members from filling blocks with small but high-weight transactions. Includes a storage migration from the 2-field `AccountUsage` tuple to a 3-field `UsageStats` struct.

- **Proposal weight bound for motion_close** (Runtime, [#1032](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1032)) — The `motion_close` extrinsic now requires a `proposal_weight_bound` parameter following the `pallet_collective::close` pattern, ensuring the declared weight includes the inner call's weight upfront. The extrinsic is also `DispatchClass::Operational`.

### Node

- **`rpc.discover` endpoint** (Node, [#869](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/869)) — Standards-compliant OpenRPC v1.4 discovery method documenting 16 custom Midnight methods and 52 standard Substrate methods, with JSON Schema type definitions. Enables client code generation and request validation.

- **Per-SQL-query Prometheus timing** (Node, [#904](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/904)) — 13 sub-query timers provide per-query latency visibility at `:9615/metrics` under the `midnight_data_source_query_time_elapsed` metric with `query_name` labels.

- **PostgreSQL ssl_root_cert configuration** (Node, [#1029](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1029)) — New `ssl_root_cert` configuration option for PostgreSQL connections.

### Toolkit

- **Batch transaction generation** (Toolkit, [#820](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/820), [#939](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/939)) — New `batch-single-tx` subcommand generates multiple transactions from a JSON specification file with configurable concurrency and parallel ZK proving.

- **File-based wallet and ledger state caching** (Toolkit, [#820](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/820), [#939](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/939)) — Two-tier file cache persists ledger snapshots and per-wallet state across runs, eliminating full chain replay on every invocation. New CLI flags: `--ledger-state-db <path>`, `--fetch-only-cached`, `--seeds`.

- **Show-block command** (Toolkit, [#1068](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1068)) — Diagnostic command to inspect individual blocks with human-readable and JSON output.

- **Fallible contract calls and inputs** (Toolkit, [#888](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/888), [#966](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/966)) — Support for fallible contract calls and fallible inputs in transaction generation.

- **Multiple shielded coin inputs** (Toolkit, [#1216](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1216)) — Multiple shielded amounts spread across coins of small values are now combined to produce the required output amount in `single-tx`, `batch-single-tx`, and `batches`.

- **Zswap state chaining** (Toolkit, [#879](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/879)) — Support for zswap state chaining in batched intents.

- **Contract on-chain state export** (Toolkit, [#946](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/946)) — Option to write out contract on-chain state when generating intents. Supports multiple ledger stacks via `LEDGER_VERSION` environment variable.

- **Structured logging** (Toolkit, [#859](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/859)) — Default log output is now human-readable with colored level labels. Pass `--log-json` for structured JSON output. New `--verbose`/`-v`, `--quiet`/`-q`, `--verbose-fetch`, `--verbose-ledger` flags.

### Features Requiring Configuration Updates

- **Toolkit cache location change** — Default cache location changed from `./toolkit.db` to `./toolkit_cache` ([#939](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/939)). Update scripts referencing the old path.
- **Toolkit JSON log format change** — `structured_logger` replaced by `tracing_subscriber` ([#899](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/899)). Log parsing pipelines consuming JSON output need updating.
- **Dust address format change** — Prefix changed from `dust-addr` to `dust`, now uses `untagged_serialization` ([#1059](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1059)).
- **motion_close parameter change** — Callers of `motion_close` must now provide `proposal_weight_bound` ([#1032](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1032)).

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

> **Runtime upgrade required.** This release includes runtime changes that require a coordinated upgrade. The runtime must be upgraded via governance proposal before nodes running the new binary will produce blocks with the new logic.

- **Storage migration:** The throttle pallet's `AccountUsage` storage is migrated from a 2-field tuple to a 3-field `UsageStats` struct. The `ClearAccountUsageV1` migration clears the existing map on upgrade. (`spec_version: 001_000_000`)
- **motion_close signature change:** The `motion_close` extrinsic now requires a `proposal_weight_bound` parameter. Existing callers (toolkit, upgrader, any off-chain governance tooling) must be updated.
- **Toolkit JSON log format change:** The `structured_logger` crate has been replaced by `tracing_subscriber`. Any log parsing pipelines consuming JSON output from the toolkit must be updated to the new format.
- **Toolkit default cache location:** Changed from `./toolkit.db` to `./toolkit_cache`.
- **Dust address format:** Prefix changed from `dust-addr` to `dust` and now uses `untagged_serialization`.

Introduces a two-tier file cache that persists ledger snapshots and per-wallet state across toolkit runs, eliminating the need to replay the full chain on every invocation. Ledger snapshots (postcard encoding, zstd-compressed, ~1.4 compression) are stored once per block height and shared across wallets; per-wallet state (postcard encoded) is keyed by seed hash. Write to `.tmp`, then atomic rename pattern prevents data corruption on concurrent writes on POSIX.

Stale snapshot garbage collection reads only the first 8 bytes of wallet files headers to extract block height without full deserialization.

New CLI flags: `--ledger-state-db <path>` to set the cache directory (default: `ledger_state_db`), and `--fetch-only-cached` for offline operation from a pre-populated cache.

{"timestamp":"2026-03-10T17:26:45.103688Z","level":"INFO","fields":{"message":"spawning 20 fetch workers","log.target":"midnight_node_toolkit::fetcher","log.module_path":"midnight_node_toolkit::fetcher","log.file":"util/toolkit/src/fetcher.rs","log.line":171},"target":"midnight_node_toolkit::fetcher"}

# Midnight Node 0.22.1 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-03-19
**Git tag:** [node-0.22.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.1)
**Tree hash:** `40368f4c7354b73deaeb4d9fe87a0fc3fb64d497`
**Environment:** All public networks

## Docker Images

```shell
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.1
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.1
```

## Summary

Security patch release addressing a yamux networking vulnerability and restricting peer info RPC methods to unsafe-only access. Node-only upgrade — no runtime changes. Fully backward compatible with node-0.22.0.

## Audience

- [x] Node operators / SPOs — binary restart required
- [ ] Runtime upgrade required — **not required for this release**
- [ ] DApp developers
- [ ] Toolkit users

## What Changed

| Change | Upgrade Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Fix yamux vulnerability (GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338) | Node | [#1040](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1040) |
| Mark peer info RPC methods as unsafe | Node | [#1039](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1039) |

## Improvements

- **Yamux vulnerability fix** — A malicious peer could crash a node by sending crafted yamux frames that trigger a panic via overflow in `increase_send_window_by`. This release bumps `yamux` 0.13.8 to 0.13.10 and patches `yamux` 0.12.1 to 0.12.2 via a custom fork, since upstream 0.12.x has no fix. Regression tests are included. Advisory: [GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338).
- **Peer info RPC methods restricted** — The `network_peerReputations`, `network_peerReputation`, and `network_unbanPeer` RPC methods now require `--rpc-methods unsafe` to be called, preventing exposure of peer reputation data and peer management on public-facing RPC endpoints.

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

No breaking changes except if you call `network_peerReputations`, `network_peerReputation`, or `network_unbanPeer` RPC methods, you must now pass `--rpc-methods unsafe` to expose them via the node.

## Links and References

- [PR #1040 — Backport yamux fix](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1040)
- [PR #1039 — Backport mark peer RPCs unsafe](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1039)
- [GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338 — yamux advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338)
- [Custom yamux 0.12.x fork](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/rust-yamux/tree/yamux-v0.12.2)

## Full Change Details

<details>
<summary>Backport yamux fix (#1040)</summary>

Backport fix for yamux vulnerability [GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vxx9-2994-q338). A malicious peer could crash a node by sending crafted yamux frames that trigger a panic via `checked_add(...).expect(...)` overflow in `increase_send_window_by`.

Changes:
- Bump `yamux` 0.13.8 → 0.13.10 (contains the fix)
- Patch `yamux` 0.12.1 → 0.12.2 via custom fork (`midnightntwrk/rust-yamux`) since upstream 0.12.x has no fix
- Add regression tests verifying the node does not panic on:
  - WindowUpdate with u32::MAX credit (overflow)
  - Oversized Data|SYN frame exceeding default credit
  - Two consecutive WindowUpdates that together overflow

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1040
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mark peer info RPC methods as unsafe (#1039)</summary>

Marks the `network_peerReputations`, `network_peerReputation`, and `network_unbanPeer` RPC methods as unsafe so they require `--rpc-methods unsafe` to be called. This prevents exposing peer reputation data and peer management on public-facing RPC endpoints.

Backport of [#1027](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1027) to `release/node-0.22.1`.

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/1039
</details>

# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.11 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-03-16 **Git tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.11](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.11) **Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview) ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.11 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.11 ``` ## Summary RC.11 finalises genesis construction and verification tooling, regenerates the preprod chainspec to start from ledger 8, generates the mainnet chain-spec, and updates mainnet bootnodes. No new runtime or toolkit changes since rc.10. ## Audience - [x] Node operators / SPOs - [ ] DApp developers - [ ] Toolkit users ## What Changed | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | --- | --- | --- | | Final genesis construction & verification changes | Node | [#945](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/945) | | Update mainnet bootnodes | Node | [#947](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/947) | | Regen preprod chainspec to start from ledger 8 | Node | [#933](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/933) | | Generate mainnet chain-spec | Node | [#953](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/953) | ## Improvements - Genesis construction script receives final polish: genesis message verification, genesis timestamp verification, reserve auth script verification, and mainnet config preset ([#945](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/945)) - Preprod chainspec regenerated to boot from ledger 8, with updated bootnodes and chain config ([#933](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/933)) - Mainnet chain-spec generated with srtool-verified deterministic WASM, including genesis state, cardano tip, and permissioned candidates config ([#953](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/953)) - Mainnet bootnode addresses updated ([#947](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/947)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions No new breaking changes in this RC. See rc.1 through rc.10 notes for the full list of breaking changes in the 0.22.0 release series. ## Links and References - [PR #945 — Final genesis construction & verification changes](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/945) - [PR #947 — Update mainnet bootnodes](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/947) - [PR #933 — Regen preprod chainspec to start from ledger 8](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/933) - [PR #953 — Generate mainnet chain-spec](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/953) ## Full Change Details The following is the cumulative auto-generated release body for all changes in the 0.22.0 release series up to rc.11.
Expand cumulative change details Git tag: [node-0.22.0-rc.11](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.11) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.11 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.11 ``` ## Added
Binary verification tooling (#635, SRE-1798) (#security, #operations) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases: - `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob - `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798
Add ephemeral env configuration for govnet (#619) Allow running govnet in local-environment PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619
Op::Deploy and Op::Maintain filter (#894, PM-22280) (#node) Runtime `--filter-deploy-txs` switch has been added along with a TransactionPool wrapper. When the switch is used, then the node transaction pool won't accept extrinsics that contain Midnight `Op::Deploy` or `Op::Maintain` operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/894 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22280
Finer grained ledger error codes (#745, PM-21798) (#node) Map all known MalformedTransaction and TransactionInvalid variants to specific error codes instead of falling through to UnknownError. Fixes the u8 collision between MalformedError::UnknownError and SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785

Update Compact version to 0.29.0 (#728, PM-21765) (#toolkit) Starting with this version, we're pulling releases from a public github repository, so we can remove usage of `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765
Use native ARM64 compactc, remove QEMU emulation from CI (#826, PM-21000) (#ci) Now that compactc releases arm64 binaries, CI builds use native compactc on arm64 runners instead of emulating x86_64 via QEMU. The contract precompile image workflow builds for both amd64 and arm64 natively. Also consolidates Node.js, subxt-cli, and Docker into the CI base image to reduce per-target installation overhead. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21000

# Midnight Node 0.22.0 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-03-16
**Git tag:** [node-0.22.0](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0)
**Tree hash:** `13ab84502bba91a4b10fb63b3a9e501217b45975`
**Environment:** All public networks (mainnet, preprod, preview)

## Docker Images

```shell
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0
```

## Summary

Node 0.22.0 is a major release that upgrades the ledger from version 7 to 8, introduces per-account transaction throttling for governance members, adds comprehensive genesis construction and verification tooling for mainnet launch, resolves multiple audit findings, and delivers significant improvements to determinism, memory management, and observability across both the node and toolkit.

**Important:** The on-disk ledger storage format has changed to v2. Existing chain data from previous releases is incompatible. Nodes upgrading to 0.22.0 must sync from genesis or use a pre-synced snapshot in the new ledger storage v2 format.

**Important:** Initially for the first few weeks mainnet is going to have permissioned contract submission, as such if you're running a validator external contract deploy transactions will not be gossiped to the validators and may languish in the mempool. You may wish to run with `--filter-deploy-txs` to prevent the mempool being filled with deploy transactions with no where to go.

## Audience

- [x] Node operators / SPOs
- [x] DApp developers
- [x] Toolkit users

## New Features

### Ledger 8.0.2 Upgrade (Runtime upgrade)

The headline change in 0.22.0 is the upgrade from Ledger 7 to Ledger 8.0.2. This is a **runtime upgrade** gated by `spec_version` — the new ledger version activates when the runtime upgrade takes effect. Ledger 8 introduces changes to the privacy ledger's proof system and state management.

- [Ledger 8.0.2 release notes](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/releases/tag/ledger-8.0.2)
- PRs: [#636](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636), [#658](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658), [#765](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765), [#906](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/906)

### Per-Account Transaction Throttling (Runtime upgrade)

New `pallet-throttle` limits per-committee-member byte usage within a rolling block window. Each governance committee member account is allowed up to 10 MB of transaction data per day (14400 blocks at 6s/block). Usage resets automatically once the window expires. Unsigned and inherent transactions bypass the throttle.

- PR: [#770](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770)
- Issue: [#980](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/980)

### Governance System Transaction Gating (Runtime upgrade)

Governance can now only dispatch `OverwriteParameters` (ledger parameter updates) via system transactions. This restricts the federated-authority pallet from executing arbitrary system transactions.

Genesis generation uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano.

- PR: [#658](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658)
- Issue: [#987](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/987)

### Op::Deploy and Op::Maintain Filter (Node upgrade)

New `--filter-deploy-txs` CLI switch with a TransactionPool wrapper. When enabled, the node's transaction pool rejects extrinsics containing `Op::Deploy` or `Op::Maintain` operations.

- PR: [#894](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/894)
- Issue: [#1017](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/1017)

### Genesis Construction and Verification Tooling (Node upgrade)

Comprehensive tooling for constructing and verifying chain specifications before network launch:

- Interactive construction wizard (`genesis-construction.sh`) with skippable verification steps, genesis messages, and fee checking
- Verification tool with CLI subcommands: `verify-ledger-state-genesis`, `verify-cardano-tip-finalized`, `verify-auth-script`, and more
- Interactive verification script (`genesis-verification.sh`) performing 5 verification steps
- Documentation in `docs/genesis/construction.md` and `docs/genesis/verification.md`

- PRs: [#654](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654), [#694](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/694), [#945](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/945)

### Memory Headroom Monitor (Node upgrade)

Periodically checks available system memory and triggers graceful shutdown before the OOM killer strikes. On Linux, detects cgroup v2/v1 limits (Docker/K8s) or falls back to `/proc/meminfo` (bare metal). Opt-in via the `--memory-threshold` CLI flag (value in MiB); disabled by default.

- PR: [#771](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771)
- Issue: [#1006](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/1006)

### Peer Reputation RPC Endpoints (Node upgrade)

Two new RPC endpoints for debugging peer connectivity:

- `network_peerReputations` — returns all connected peers with reputation score and ban status
- `network_peerReputation` — returns info for a single peer by ID
- `network_unbanPeer` (unsafe) — allows unbannnig a peer; disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set

- PRs: [#649](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649), [#666](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666)

### Binary Verification Tooling (Node upgrade)

Scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases using cosign.

- `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob
- `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting

- PR: [#635](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635)
- Issue: [#1018](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/1018)

### Deterministic Runtime WASM Builds via srtool (Node upgrade)

Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using [srtool](https://github.com/paritytech/srtool). New Earthly targets: `+srtool-build`, `+srtool-info`, `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic`. The genesis generation script can optionally use srtool for deterministic WASM and produces a `chain-spec-hash.json` for verification.

- PR: [#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681)
- Issue: [#998](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/998)

### Ledger Storage v2 Layout (Node upgrade)

Enables the `layout-v2` feature on `midnight-storage-core` 1.1.0, which removes reference counting from the storage layer to eliminate quasi-exponential write cost growth.

- PR: [#847](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847)
- JIRA: [PM-22058](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058)

### Toolkit: Multiple Ledger Version Support (Toolkit)

The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains.

- PR: [#711](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711)
- Issue: [#965](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/965)

### Toolkit: On-Chain State Output for Intent Generation (Toolkit)

New `--output-onchain-state` option on `generate-intent` writes out the contract's public state to a file. This file can be supplied via `--input-onchain-state` on subsequent invocations to chain contract calls together.

- PR: [#812](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812)
- Issue: [#996](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/996)

### Toolkit: DUST Address Registration Without Owning DUST (Toolkit)

Registers a DUST address using virtual DUST that would have accrued if the NIGHT was registered for DUST production from UTXO creation.

- PR: [#849](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849)
- Issue: [#981](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/981)

### Features Requiring Configuration Updates

- **Memory headroom monitor:** Pass `--memory-threshold <MiB>` CLI flag to enable. Disabled by default.
- **Op::Deploy filter:** Use the `--filter-deploy-txs` CLI flag to reject deploy/maintain transactions.

## Improvements

- Validation cache now has both TTL (60s) and TimeToIdle to evict stale entries on relay nodes ([#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737), [#748](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/748), [#659](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659))
- Deterministic block production while allowing non-deterministic sync for historical blocks ([#685](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685), [#700](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/700))
- UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks on qanet, preview, and preprod ([#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716))
- Replaced HashMap with deterministic-iteration collection in transaction processing ([#678](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678))
- Additional ledger operation logging with per-step timing ([#727](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727))
- Metrics for mainchain follower operations using observed_async_trait macro ([#593](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593))
- Composite index on ma_tx_out (tx_out_id, ident) for genesis query performance ([#907](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/907))
- Offline subcommands now derive genesis state from the chain spec instead of hardcoded defaults ([#768](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768))
- Bumped yamux from 0.13.6 to 0.13.8 to avoid panics with websocket connections ([#755](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755))
- Cleaned up verbose logging: removed unnecessary println and dbg! calls ([#802](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802))
- Removed unused SyncStatusExt and sync-status-monitor ([#811](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811))
- Toolkit: fetch-compute-concurrency option to limit threads in multi-threaded applications ([#675](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675))
- Toolkit: option to use only cached transactions, skipping RPC fetch on startup ([#682](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682))
- Toolkit: support for zswap inputs and transients ([#784](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784))
- Toolkit: fetches latest LedgerParameters from chain for intent generation ([#837](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837))
- Toolkit: uses ledger_parameters.global_ttl for transaction TTL instead of hardcoded 10 minutes ([#791](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791))
- Toolkit: tagged-only decoding in hex_ledger_decode, checked arithmetic, and file size limits ([#807](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807))
- Toolkit: Compact version updated to 0.29.0, now pulled from public repository ([#728](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728))
- Toolkit: removed unused `replace-initial-tx` command ([#835](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835))
- Toolkit-js made optional in toolkit-image, allowing genesis generation without GITHUB_TOKEN ([#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676))
- CI: srtool WASM build workflow for deterministic runtime artifacts on releases ([#795](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795))
- CI: migrated image signing from Cosign/Sigstore to GitHub native attestations ([#786](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786))
- CI: native ARM64 compactc binaries, removing QEMU emulation ([#826](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826))
- CI: remediated 7 audit findings by migrating secret interpolations to env: block indirection ([#850](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850))
- Added guardnet and ddosnet cfg presets ([#868](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868))
- Added ephemeral env configuration for govnet ([#619](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619))

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

> **Warning:** This release includes runtime upgrade changes. Node operators must update their binary **and** ensure the runtime upgrade is enacted on-chain. Running an old binary after the runtime upgrade will cause the node to stop producing or importing blocks.

### Ledger 7 to 8 Upgrade (Runtime upgrade)

The ledger is upgraded from version 7 to 8.0.2. This is gated by `spec_version` and activates automatically when the runtime upgrade is enacted. Nodes must be running the 0.22.0 binary before the upgrade is enacted.

### Ledger Storage v2 Layout

The `layout-v2` feature removes reference counting from the storage layer. **Existing on-disk chain data from previous releases is incompatible.** Node operators must:

1. Stop the node
2. Delete the chain data directory
3. Resync from genesis with the 0.22.0 binary

### Remove Default impl for WalletSeed

Callers of `WalletSeed` must now provide an explicit seed value. The `Default` trait implementation has been removed. ([#804](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804))

### Toolkit: Restore Untagged Decoding for contract-address and coin-public

The `contract-address` and `coin-public` CLI inputs use untagged decoding. If you were relying on tagged decoding for these inputs, update accordingly. ([#853](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853))

earthly +rebuild-chainspec-deterministic --NETWORK=mainnet

<summary>Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache (<a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659">#659</a>, <a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/989">#989</a>) (<code>#client</code>, <code>#node</code>, <code>#performance</code>)</summary>

Added a Time-To-Idle for the transaction validation cache to prevent entries lingering in the cache indefinitely.

Also tuned the limits of the two caches.

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659
Ticket: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/989
</details>

<details>
<summary>Update Compact version to 0.29.0 (<a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728">#728</a>, <a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/985">#985</a>) (<code>#toolkit</code>)</summary>

Starting with this version, we're pulling releases from a public github repository, so we can remove usage of `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places.

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728
Ticket: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/985
</details>

<details>
<summary>Use native ARM64 compactc, remove QEMU emulation from CI (<a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826">#826</a>, <a href="https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/978">#978</a>) (<code>#ci</code>)</summary>

Now that compactc releases arm64 binaries, CI builds use native compactc on arm64 runners
instead of emulating x86_64 via QEMU. The contract precompile image workflow builds for
both amd64 and arm64 natively. Also consolidates Node.js, subxt-cli, and Docker into the
CI base image to reduce per-target installation overhead.

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826
Issue: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/issues/978
</details>

</details>

name: node-0.22.0-rc.10
body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.10 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-03-13 **Git tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.10](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.10) **Environment:** All public networks (preview, preprod, mainnet) ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.10 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.10 ``` ## Summary Release candidate 10 for node 0.22.0. This RC regenerates the preview network chain specs so that preview genesis starts from ledger 8. No code changes — configuration only. ## Audience - [ ] **Node operators / SPOs** — preview network operators must restart with updated chain specs - [ ] **DApp developers** — no action required - [ ] **Infrastructure / DevOps** — no action required ## What Changed | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | --- | --- | --- | | Regenerate preview chain specs for ledger 8 genesis | Infrastructure/Config | [#932](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/932) | ## Improvements - **Preview chain spec regeneration**: Regenerated preview network chain specs and genesis files so that the preview environment starts from ledger 8. Preprod changes were initially included but reverted — those will be handled in a separate PR ([#932](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/932)) ## Links and References - [PR #932 — Regenerate preview chain specs](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/932) ## Full Change Details The following is the complete auto-generated change log for node-0.22.0-rc.10 (cumulative since node-0.21.0). ## Added
Binary verification tooling (#635, SRE-1798) (#security, #operations) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases: - `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob - `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798
Add ephemeral env configuration for govnet (#619) Allow running govnet in local-environment PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619
Op::Deploy and Op::Maintain filter (#894, PM-22280) (#node) Runtime `--filter-deploy-txs` switch has been added along with a TransactionPool wrapper. When the switch is used, then the node transaction pool won’t accept extrinsics that contain Midnight `Op::Deploy` or `Op::Maintain` operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/894 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22280
Finer grained ledger error codes (#745, PM-21798) (#node) Map all known MalformedTransaction and TransactionInvalid variants to specific error codes instead of falling through to UnknownError. Fixes the u8 collision between MalformedError::UnknownError and SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add guardnet and ddosnet cfg presets (SRE-1941, #868) (#cfg) Add `res/cfg/guardnet.toml` and `res/cfg/ddosnet.toml` so the binary recognizes `CFG_PRESET=guardnet` and `CFG_PRESET=ddosnet`. Without these files nodes crash immediately with "Failed to load config guardnet/ddosnet". Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1941 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868
Improve genesis contruction and verification (#694, PM-20554) (#node, #genesis) - Genesis construction script (`genesis-construction.sh`) with interactive wizard supporting skippable verification steps, genesis messages, and fee checking - Fixed genesis query bugs: `policy_id` decoding, asset name encoding, SQL amount casting to `BIGINT` - UTXO filtering in cnight genesis to exclude UTXOs without a prior registration - Enabled all verification steps for mainnet genesis - Added genesis message - Verify ledger fees - Add bootnodes as a congif file - Improve genesis generarion addid `--no-cache` to Earthly commands PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/694 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20554
Additional logging for ledger (PM-21954, #727) (#ledger) Added additional logging for operations performed on the ledger with additional tracking of time we spent on each of the steps. Issue: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21954 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727
Enable ledger storage v2 layout (#847, PM-22058) (#node) Enable the `layout-v2` feature on `midnight-storage-core` 1.1.0, which removes reference counting from the storage layer to eliminate quasi-exponential write cost growth. Ledger 7 deps moved to crates.io with `[patch.crates-io]` to enable the storage-core override. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058
Add composite index on ma_tx_out (tx_out_id, ident) (#907, PM-21995) (#node) Add a database index on the ma_tx_out table covering (tx_out_id, ident) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/907 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21995
Memory headroom monitor (#771, PM-22043) (#node) Adds a memory monitor service that periodically checks available system memory and triggers graceful shutdown before the OOM killer strikes. On Linux, detects cgroup v2/v1 limits (for Docker/K8s) or falls back to /proc/meminfo (bare metal). Disabled by default (memory_threshold=0); set memory_threshold to a MiB value to enable. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22043
Add metrics for partner chain operations (#593, PM-20927) (#node) Enable additional metrics for mainchain follower operations using an observed_async_trait macro, replacing manual metric instrumentation with a cleaner declarative approach. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20927
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Per-account signed transaction throttling (#770, PM-21204) (#runtime) Adds a new `pallet-throttle` with a `CheckThrottle` transaction extension that limits per-account byte usage within a rolling block window. Each account is allowed up to 10 MB of transaction data per day (14400 blocks at 6s/block). Usage resets automatically once the window expires. - New pallet at `pallets/throttle/` with `AccountUsage` storage tracking `(bytes_used, window_start_block)` per account - `CheckThrottle` implements `TransactionExtension`: `validate()` rejects transactions exceeding the limit, `prepare()` persists updated usage - Unsigned/inherent transactions bypass the throttle - 25 unit tests covering accumulation, window expiry, boundary conditions, multi-account isolation, and overflow safety PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21204
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add `runtime-upgrade` command (PM-22108, #834) (#toolkit) Used for executing a hard-fork test in CI Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834
Add srtool WASM build workflow for releases (#795, PM-22075) (#ci) New `srtool Build` GitHub Actions workflow that builds deterministic runtime WASM artifacts and uploads them to GitHub releases. Can be triggered standalone to backfill past releases, or runs automatically as part of the `Create Release` workflow. Artifacts attached to releases: `midnight_node_runtime.wasm`, `.compact.wasm`, `.compact.compressed.wasm`, `srtool-digest.json`, checksums, and Cosign signatures. A new `node-only` option on the `Create Release` workflow skips the srtool build for node-only releases that don't include runtime changes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22075
Add option when generating intents to write out the contract on-chain state (#812, PM-21901) (#toolkit) Adds a new optional `--output-onchain-state` option to the `generate-intent` command, that when supplied, will write out the contract's on-chain (public) state to the specified file. This file can then be supplied on subsequent usages of `generate-intent` via the `--input-onchain-state` option to _chain_ contract calls together, ensuring that changes in state are preserved through each of the contract invocations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Every time the toolkit.db is fetched, it uses by default 20 workers for fetching and MAX for computing. When the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications this leads to resource competition and wrong behavior. We propose to limit the number of threads used for computing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
Add support for multiple ledger versions (#711, PM-11244) (#toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244
Add support for zswap inputs and transients (#784, PM-21891) (#toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, we now also read the inputs and construct the transients if needed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891
## Changed
Add benchmarked weight and UTXO count validation to process_tokens (#798, PM-19778) (#audit, #runtime) The `process_tokens` inherent extrinsic previously declared zero weight with `DispatchClass::Mandatory`, bypassing block weight accounting. This adds FRAME benchmarking infrastructure, a runtime UTXO count guard (`TooManyUtxos`), and `PostDispatchInfo` actual-weight correction to the cnight-observation pallet. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778
Use take instead of get (#317, PM-19770) (#audit) Remove `UtxoOwners` key after spending PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770
Add test coverage for UtxoOwners persistence guards (#762, PM-20218) (#audit) Tests that event construction failure does not leave orphaned UtxoOwners entries, and that spending a UTXO without a prior create does not emit a Destroy event. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Update Ledger to 7.0.2 (#739) (#client, #ledger) Bump core ledger versions to 7.0.2. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739
Bump ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5 (#816, PM-22040) (#client, #ledger) Bump ledger 7 from 7.0.2 (crates.io) to 7.0.3-rc.1 (git tag) and ledger 8 from 8.0.0-rc.4 to 8.0.0-rc.5. Fixes diamond dependency on shared crates (base-crypto, coin-structure, etc.) by giving each ledger version its own dependency tree. Concretizes fork module generics with concrete Db7/Db8 types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Bump yamux to 0.13.8 to prevent panics (#755) (#node) Backport of a fix from polkadot-sdk stable2509-3 (paritytech/polkadot-sdk#10479). Updates yamux from 0.13.6 to 0.13.8 to avoid panics when tungstenite websocket connections are used with yamux in the p2p networking layer. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755
Clean up verbose logging (#802) (#node, #toolkit) Remove unnecessary println and dbg! calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet has enough funds but not in one UTXO (#782, PM-21914) (#toolkit) Fixes toolkit panic when simple-tx needs to spend more than biggest UTXO of funding UTXO. Also prevents high evaluation time moving offer to fallible if there are more than one input. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914
Update npm version to prevent npm audit failure in CI. (#797) (#ci) Updates the version to stable 11.11.0 because npm audit complained at 10.9.4 which comes by default with node 22. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/797
Fix order of CNGD ownership insertion order (#757, PM-20218) Ensures we insert cngd utxos after successful event creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/757 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Ensure Terms and Conditions values at genesis (#646) Ensures we do not allow creating a genesis without both Terms and Conditions values PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646
Replace genesis state decode panics with error propagation (#766, PM-20204) (#node, #security) The node panicked on startup when the chain spec contained a missing, non-string, or invalid-hex `genesis_state` property. This replaces three `unwrap()` calls in `run_node` with a `decode_genesis_state` helper that returns descriptive errors via `sc_cli::Error::Input`, matching the existing error handling pattern used for seed file loading. Adds a 256 MiB size guard against adversarial chain specs. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204
Fix governance update command in ephemeral environments (#517, PM-21136) Fixes parsing of large WASM files when attempting the upgrade. Remove hard-coded threshold for proposal calls from ephemeral env script. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/517 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
Fix minimatch high severity vulnerability in local-environment (#808) Update minimatch override from 10.2.1 to 10.2.4 to resolve ReDoS vulnerabilities (GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj, GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/808
Fix `NotNormalized` error when dust spends and registrations are empty (#758, PM-21958) (#toolkit) Fixes the toolkit to omit `DustActions` in a transaction if it's a No-op. Resolves `NotNormalized` errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958
Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block (#575, PM-21649) (#node) Add InherentExecutedThisBlock guard to cnight-observation and federated-authority-observation pallets to ensure inherents can only execute once per block. This prevents potential issues from multiple inherent calls being processed in a single block. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649
Rename is_spend (#710, PM-21789) (#client) Fixes the naming of is_spend. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21789
Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast in utxos_info_from_output (#668, PM-20208) Fix for unsafe cast PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208
Fix runtime-call panics caused by uninitialized storage during runtime upgrade (#870, PM-22228) (#node, #runtime) Before this fix, ledger storage was only re-initialized at the start of each block. This allowed for a small time window after a runtime upgrade where the storage for the new ledger version is uninitialized. This change closes this window by always checking storage initialization on a runtime upgrade. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870 Fixes: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22228
Fix sync issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 binaries (#852, PM-22123) (#node, #binary) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/852 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22123
Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public inputs (#853) (#toolkit) The contract-address and coin-public CLI inputs are intentionally untagged. Reverts the tagged-only change for these two inputs while keeping tagged decoding as the default for other ledger types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Migrate image signing from Cosign/Sigstore to GitHub native attestations (#786) (#ci) Replace Cosign keyless signing with GitHub's `actions/attest-build-provenance` and `actions/attest-sbom` actions, eliminating external Sigstore/Rekor dependencies. Re-enable SBOM attestation (previously disabled due to Rekor rejecting payloads). Add build provenance attestation for release binary assets. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786
Fix motion cleanup and member ordering in governance pallets (#803) (#runtime) Ensure motions are removed from storage on close even when dispatch fails. Sort authority pairs before unzipping to keep member associations aligned. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803
Add guards to NextCardanoPosition updates (#763, PM-19901) (#audit) Enforce monotonicity and window-bound validation on `NextCardanoPosition` in `process_tokens` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/763 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19901
Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks (#716, PM-21823) (#ledger) Provide per-network UTXO ordering override data for qanet, preview, and preprod so that nodes can sync past blocks that were originally produced with non-deterministic UTXO consumption order. Includes tooling to generate the override data from an indexer database. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.4 (#765, PM-22040) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.4/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Update Ledger to released version 8.0.2 (#906, PM-22040) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Bumps ledger dependencies from release candidates to the final 8.0.2 release. Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.2/CHANGELOG.md PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/906 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Unify genesis state source for offline subcommands (#768, PM-20203) (#node) Offline subcommands (CheckBlock, ExportBlocks, ExportState, ImportBlocks, Revert, benchmarks) now derive genesis state from the chain specification instead of the hardcoded UndeployedNetwork default. Addresses Least Authority audit Issue L. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20203

#hardfork ## Changed
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682

Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
#toolkit ## Added
Add `runtime-upgrade` command (PM-22108, #834) (#toolkit) Used for executing a hard-fork test in CI Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834
Add option when generating intents to write out the contract on-chain state (#812, PM-21901) (#toolkit) Adds a new optional `--output-onchain-state` option to the `generate-intent` command, that when supplied, will write out the contract's on-chain (public) state to the specified file. This file can then be supplied on subsequent usages of `generate-intent` via the `--input-onchain-state` option to _chain_ contract calls together, ensuring that changes in state are preserved through each of the contract invocations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Every time the toolkit.db is fetched, it uses by default 20 workers for fetching and MAX for computing. When the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications this leads to resource competition and wrong behavior. We propose to limit the number of threads used for computing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
Add support for multiple ledger versions (#711, PM-11244) (#toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244
Add support for zswap inputs and transients (#784, PM-21891) (#toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, we now also read the inputs and construct the transients if needed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891
## Changed
Clean up verbose logging (#802) (#node, #toolkit) Remove unnecessary println and dbg! calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802
Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet has enough funds but not in one UTXO (#782, PM-21914) (#toolkit) Fixes toolkit panic when simple-tx needs to spend more than biggest UTXO of funding UTXO. Also prevents high evaluation time moving offer to fallible if there are more than one input. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914
Fix `NotNormalized` error when dust spends and registrations are empty (#758, PM-21958) (#toolkit) Fixes the toolkit to omit `DustActions` in a transaction if it's a No-op. Resolves `NotNormalized` errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958
Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public inputs (#853) (#toolkit) The contract-address and coin-public CLI inputs are intentionally untagged. Reverts the tagged-only change for these two inputs while keeping tagged decoding as the default for other ledger types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853
Remove Default impl for WalletSeed (#804) (#node, #toolkit) Remove the Default trait implementation for WalletSeed. Callers should provide an explicit seed value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804
Allow DUST address registration without owning DUST (#849) (#toolkit) It uses possiblity that ledger gives us to register DUST address paying with virtual DUST that would have been accured if the NIGHT was registered for DUST production from UTXO creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21236
Pass the latest ledger parameters on intent generation (#837, PM-22073) (#toolkit) Fetch the latest LedgerParameters from the chain and pass them as input to toolkit.js when generating intents. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22073
Clean up toolkit input handling (#807) (#toolkit) Use tagged-only decoding in hex_ledger_decode, switch to checked arithmetic in transaction builder, and add file size limits when reading input files. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22088 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22089 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22090
Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx (#767, PM-19905) (#toolkit, #security) Hold the ledger_state mutex for the full read-modify-write cycle in update_from_tx, preventing potential lost updates under concurrent access. Addresses audit finding Issue AJ. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905
When building transations use global_ttl from the ledger parameters instead of hardcoded 10 minutes (#791, PM-21976) (#toolkit) Changes the toolkit to use ledger_parameters.global_ttl to compute transaction ttl instead of hardcoded 10 minutes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21976
Remove unused `replace-initial-tx` command (PM-22112, #835) (#toolkit) Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22112 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835
Update Compact version to 0.29.0 (#728, PM-21765) (#toolkit) Starting with this version, we're pulling releases from a public github repository, so we can remove usage of `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765
