# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.7 Release Notes

**Release date:** 2026-03-10
**Git tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.7](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.7)
**Environment:** All public networks (qanet, preview, preprod)

## Docker Images

```shell
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.7
docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.7
```

## Summary

Re-tag of rc.6 with a regenerated qanet chain specification. No new code changes — all PRs were already included in prior release candidates (rc.1 through rc.6).

## Audience

- [x] Node operators running qanet (chain-spec update)

## What Changed

| Change | Upgrade Type | PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Regenerate qanet chain-spec | Infrastructure | [#896](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/896) |

## Breaking Changes or Required Actions

Qanet node operators should update to this release to pick up the regenerated chain specification.

name: node-0.22.0-rc.6
body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.6 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-03-06 **Git tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.6](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.6) **Release candidate:** This is a pre-release. It is not intended for production use. ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.6 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.6 ``` ## Summary Node 0.22.0-rc.6 enables ledger storage v2 layout (eliminating quasi-exponential write cost growth), fixes runtime-call panics caused by uninitialized storage during runtime upgrades, and adds four toolkit improvements including DUST address registration without owning DUST and zswap input support. This release requires a fresh substrate database and a full resync from genesis. ## Audience - [x] **Node operators / SPOs** — binary upgrade required (fresh substrate DB + resync from genesis) - [x] **DApp developers** — toolkit changes (zswap inputs, DUST registration, ledger parameters) - [ ] **Network administrators** — no new runtime upgrade changes beyond what was in rc.5 ## What Changed Changes new in rc.6 (not previously announced in rc.1 through rc.5): | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | --- | --- | --- | | Fix runtime-call panics from uninitialized storage during runtime upgrade | Runtime upgrade | [#870](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870) | | Enable ledger storage v2 layout | Node upgrade | [#847](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847) | | Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet lacks single UTXO | Toolkit | [#782](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782) | | Support zswap inputs and transients | Toolkit | [#784](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784) | | Pass latest ledger parameters on intent generation | Toolkit | [#837](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837) | | Allow DUST address registration without owning DUST | Toolkit | [#849](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849) | | Skip SBOM attestation for non-release CI builds | Infrastructure | [#781](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/781) | | Use native ARM64 compactc, remove QEMU emulation | Infrastructure | [#826](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826) | | Migrate secret interpolations to env: block indirection | Infrastructure | [#850](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850) | | Change storage cache size to ledger default (10,000 elements) | Node upgrade | [#862](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/862) | | Add guardnet and ddosnet cfg presets | Infrastructure | [#868](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868) | ## New Features ### Ledger Storage v2 Layout (Node upgrade) Enables the `layout-v2` feature on `midnight-storage-core` 1.1.0, which removes reference counting from the storage layer to eliminate quasi-exponential write cost growth. Ledger 7 deps moved to crates.io with `[patch.crates-io]` to enable the storage-core override. ([#847](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847), [PM-22058](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058)) ### Toolkit: DUST Address Registration Without Owning DUST (Toolkit) Uses the ledger's capability to register a DUST address by paying with virtual DUST that would have accrued from NIGHT if registered from UTXO creation. ([#849](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849), [PM-21236](https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21236)) ### Toolkit: Zswap Inputs and Transients Support (Toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, the toolkit now also reads inputs and constructs transients. ([#784](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784), [PM-21891](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891)) ### Features Requiring Configuration Updates - **guardnet/ddosnet presets:** Use `CFG_PRESET=guardnet` or `CFG_PRESET=ddosnet` to run nodes on these networks. ([#868](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868)) ## Improvements - **Storage cache size:** Changed `storage_cache_size` to the ledger default of 10,000 elements, improving memory profile. ([#862](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/862)) - **Ledger parameters on intent generation:** The toolkit now fetches the latest `LedgerParameters` from the chain and passes them as input to toolkit.js when generating intents. ([#837](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837)) - **CI security:** Migrated 7 workflow files to use env: block indirection instead of direct `${{ }}` expression interpolation, eliminating shell metacharacter and expression injection vectors. ([#850](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850)) - **ARM64 compactc:** CI now uses native ARM64 compactc binaries instead of QEMU x86_64 emulation, also consolidating Node.js, subxt-cli, and Docker into the CI base image. ([#826](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826)) - **SBOM attestation:** Non-release CI builds now skip SBOM attestation entirely. Release builds retain full attestation with transparency log upload. ([#781](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/781)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions > **WARNING:** This release includes runtime upgrade changes. Nodes that do not upgrade will be unable to participate in the network after the runtime upgrade is enacted. ### Fresh Substrate Database Required The ledger storage v2 layout change ([#847](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847)) requires a **fresh substrate database**. You must: 1. **Delete your existing substrate database** (the db-sync database does **not** need to be reset) 2. **Resync from genesis** using already-synced nodes running v0.21 or v0.22 — any node works as a sync source, it does not need to be an archive node ### Runtime Upgrade Storage Fix Fixes a window after runtime upgrade where ledger storage for the new version could be uninitialized, causing panics on runtime calls. Storage initialization is now checked on every runtime upgrade. ([#870](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870)) ## Fixed Defects | Defect | Summary | Priority | | --- | --- | --- | | [PM-22228](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22228) | Fix runtime-call panics from uninitialized storage during runtime upgrade | High | | [PM-21914](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914) | Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet lacks single UTXO | Medium | ## Links and References ### Pull Requests - [#781](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/781) — Skip SBOM attestation for non-release CI - [#782](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782) — Fix simple_tx panic - [#784](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784) — Zswap inputs and transients - [#826](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826) — Native ARM64 compactc - [#837](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837) — Pass latest ledger parameters - [#847](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847) — Enable ledger storage v2 layout - [#849](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849) — DUST registration without owning DUST - [#862](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/862) — Change storage cache size to ledger default - [#850](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850) — Migrate secret interpolations - [#868](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868) — guardnet/ddosnet cfg presets - [#870](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870) — Fix runtime-call panics on upgrade ### JIRA Tickets - [PM-21000](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21000) — ARM64 compactc - [PM-21236](https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21236) — DUST registration without DUST - [PM-21891](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891) — Zswap inputs and transients - [PM-21914](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914) — simple_tx panic fix - [PM-22058](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058) — Storage v2 layout - [PM-22073](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22073) — Ledger parameters on intent generation - [PM-22118](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22118) — CI secret interpolation - [PM-22228](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22228) — Runtime upgrade storage panics - [SRE-1941](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1941) — guardnet/ddosnet presets ## Full Change Details Changes new since rc.5. For the complete cumulative changelog, see the [GitHub release](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.0-rc.6). ### Added
Add guardnet and ddosnet cfg presets (SRE-1941, #868) (#cfg) Add `res/cfg/guardnet.toml` and `res/cfg/ddosnet.toml` so the binary recognizes `CFG_PRESET=guardnet` and `CFG_PRESET=ddosnet`. Without these files nodes crash immediately with "Failed to load config guardnet/ddosnet". Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1941 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868
Enable ledger storage v2 layout (#847, PM-22058) (#node) Enable the `layout-v2` feature on `midnight-storage-core` 1.1.0, which removes reference counting from the storage layer to eliminate quasi-exponential write cost growth. Ledger 7 deps moved to crates.io with `[patch.crates-io]` to enable the storage-core override. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058
Add support for zswap inputs and transients (#784, PM-21891) (#toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, we now also read the inputs and construct the transients if needed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891
### Changed
Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet has enough funds but not in one UTXO (#782, PM-21914) (#toolkit) Fixes toolkit panic when simple-tx needs to spend more than biggest UTXO of funding UTXO. Also prevents high evaluation time moving offer to fallible if there are more than one input. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914
Fix runtime-call panics caused by uninitialized storage during runtime upgrade (#870, PM-22228) (#node, #runtime) Before this fix, ledger storage was only re-initialized at the start of each block. This allowed for a small time window after a runtime upgrade where the storage for the new ledger version is uninitialized. This change closes this window by always checking storage initialization on a runtime upgrade. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870 Fixes: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22228
Migrate secret and input interpolations to env: block indirection (#850, PM-22118) (#ci, #security) Remediate 7 audit findings (M-F007 through M-F014) by replacing direct ${{ }} expression interpolation in shell run: blocks with step-level env: block indirection across 7 GitHub Actions workflow files. This eliminates shell metacharacter injection and expression injection vectors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22118
Skip SBOM attestation for non-release CI builds (#781) (#ci) Non-release CI builds (PR, main merge) now skip SBOM attestation entirely instead of attempting `--tlog-upload=false`, which cosign v3.0.2 does not respect during bundle signing. SBOM generation and vulnerability scanning still run. Release builds retain full attestation with transparency log upload for supply-chain assurance. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/781
Allow DUST address registration without owning DUST (#849) (#toolkit) It uses possiblity that ledger gives us to register DUST address paying with virtual DUST that would have been accured if the NIGHT was registered for DUST production from UTXO creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21236
Pass the latest ledger parameters on intent generation (#837, PM-22073) (#toolkit) Fetch the latest LedgerParameters from the chain and pass them as input to toolkit.js when generating intents. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22073
Change storage cache size to ledger default (#862) (#node) Changed `storage_cache_size` to the ledger default of 10,000 elements. This improves the node's memory profile. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/862
Use native ARM64 compactc, remove QEMU emulation from CI (#826, PM-21000) (#ci) Now that compactc releases arm64 binaries, CI builds use native compactc on arm64 runners instead of emulating x86_64 via QEMU. The contract precompile image workflow builds for both amd64 and arm64 natively. Also consolidates Node.js, subxt-cli, and Docker into the CI base image to reduce per-target installation overhead. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/826 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21000

name: node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.2
body:
Git tag: [node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.2) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-mainnet-test.2 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-mainnet-test.2 ``` ## Added
Binary verification tooling (#635, SRE-1798) (#security, #operations) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases: - `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob - `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798
Add ephemeral env configuration for govnet (#619) Allow running govnet in local-environment PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619
Finer grained ledger error codes (#745, PM-21798) (#node) Map all known MalformedTransaction and TransactionInvalid variants to specific error codes instead of falling through to UnknownError. Fixes the u8 collision between MalformedError::UnknownError and SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add guardnet and ddosnet cfg presets (SRE-1941, #868) (#cfg) Add `res/cfg/guardnet.toml` and `res/cfg/ddosnet.toml` so the binary recognizes `CFG_PRESET=guardnet` and `CFG_PRESET=ddosnet`. Without these files nodes crash immediately with "Failed to load config guardnet/ddosnet". Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1941 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/868
Additional logging for ledger (PM-21954, #727) (#ledger) Added additional logging for operations performed on the ledger with additional tracking of time we spent on each of the steps. Issue: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21954 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727
Enable ledger storage v2 layout (#847, PM-22058) (#node) Enable the `layout-v2` feature on `midnight-storage-core` 1.1.0, which removes reference counting from the storage layer to eliminate quasi-exponential write cost growth. Ledger 7 deps moved to crates.io with `[patch.crates-io]` to enable the storage-core override. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/847 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22058
Memory headroom monitor (#771, PM-22043) (#node) Adds a memory monitor service that periodically checks available system memory and triggers graceful shutdown before the OOM killer strikes. On Linux, detects cgroup v2/v1 limits (for Docker/K8s) or falls back to /proc/meminfo (bare metal). Disabled by default (memory_threshold=0); set memory_threshold to a MiB value to enable. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22043
Add metrics for partner chain operations (#593, PM-20927) (#node) Enable additional metrics for mainchain follower operations using an observed_async_trait macro, replacing manual metric instrumentation with a cleaner declarative approach. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20927
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Per-account signed transaction throttling (#770, PM-21204) (#runtime) Adds a new `pallet-throttle` with a `CheckThrottle` transaction extension that limits per-account byte usage within a rolling block window. Each account is allowed up to 10 MB of transaction data per day (14400 blocks at 6s/block). Usage resets automatically once the window expires. - New pallet at `pallets/throttle/` with `AccountUsage` storage tracking `(bytes_used, window_start_block)` per account - `CheckThrottle` implements `TransactionExtension`: `validate()` rejects transactions exceeding the limit, `prepare()` persists updated usage - Unsigned/inherent transactions bypass the throttle - 25 unit tests covering accumulation, window expiry, boundary conditions, multi-account isolation, and overflow safety PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21204
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add `runtime-upgrade` command (PM-22108, #834) (#toolkit) Used for executing a hard-fork test in CI Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834
Add srtool WASM build workflow for releases (#795, PM-22075) (#ci) New `srtool Build` GitHub Actions workflow that builds deterministic runtime WASM artifacts and uploads them to GitHub releases. Can be triggered standalone to backfill past releases, or runs automatically as part of the `Create Release` workflow. Artifacts attached to releases: `midnight_node_runtime.wasm`, `.compact.wasm`, `.compact.compressed.wasm`, `srtool-digest.json`, checksums, and Cosign signatures. A new `node-only` option on the `Create Release` workflow skips the srtool build for node-only releases that don't include runtime changes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22075
Add option when generating intents to write out the contract on-chain state (#812, PM-21901) (#toolkit) Adds a new optional `--output-onchain-state` option to the `generate-intent` command, that when supplied, will write out the contract's on-chain (public) state to the specified file. This file can then be supplied on subsequent usages of `generate-intent` via the `--input-onchain-state` option to _chain_ contract calls together, ensuring that changes in state are preserved through each of the contract invocations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Every time the toolkit.db is fetched, it uses by default 20 workers for fetching and MAX for computing. When the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications this leads to resource competition and wrong behavior. We propose to limit the number of threads used for computing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
Add support for multiple ledger versions (#711, PM-11244) (#toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244
Add support for zswap inputs and transients (#784, PM-21891) (#toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, we now also read the inputs and construct the transients if needed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891
## Changed
Add benchmarked weight and UTXO count validation to process_tokens (#798, PM-19778) (#audit, #runtime) The `process_tokens` inherent extrinsic previously declared zero weight with `DispatchClass::Mandatory`, bypassing block weight accounting. This adds FRAME benchmarking infrastructure, a runtime UTXO count guard (`TooManyUtxos`), and `PostDispatchInfo` actual-weight correction to the cnight-observation pallet. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778
Use take instead of get (#317, PM-19770) (#audit) Remove `UtxoOwners` key after spending PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770
Add test coverage for UtxoOwners persistence guards (#762, PM-20218) (#audit) Tests that event construction failure does not leave orphaned UtxoOwners entries, and that spending a UTXO without a prior create does not emit a Destroy event. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Update Ledger to 7.0.2 (#739) (#client, #ledger) Bump core ledger versions to 7.0.2. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739
Bump ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5 (#816, PM-22040) (#client, #ledger) Bump ledger 7 from 7.0.2 (crates.io) to 7.0.3-rc.1 (git tag) and ledger 8 from 8.0.0-rc.4 to 8.0.0-rc.5. Fixes diamond dependency on shared crates (base-crypto, coin-structure, etc.) by giving each ledger version its own dependency tree. Concretizes fork module generics with concrete Db7/Db8 types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Bump yamux to 0.13.8 to prevent panics (#755) (#node) Backport of a fix from polkadot-sdk stable2509-3 (paritytech/polkadot-sdk#10479). Updates yamux from 0.13.6 to 0.13.8 to avoid panics when tungstenite websocket connections are used with yamux in the p2p networking layer. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755
Clean up verbose logging (#802) (#node, #toolkit) Remove unnecessary println and dbg! calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet has enough funds but not in one UTXO (#782, PM-21914) (#toolkit) Fixes toolkit panic when simple-tx needs to spend more than biggest UTXO of funding UTXO. #hardfork ## Changed
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. Add benchmarked weight and UTXO count validation to process_tokens (#798, PM-19778) (#audit, #runtime) The `process_tokens` inherent extrinsic previously declared zero weight with `DispatchClass::Mandatory`, bypassing block weight accounting.
