PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778
Fix runtime-call panics caused by uninitialized storage during runtime upgrade (#870, PM-22228) (#node, #runtime) Before this fix, ledger storage was only re-initialized at the start of each block. This allowed for a small time window after a runtime upgrade where the storage for the new ledger version is uninitialized. This change closes this window by always checking storage initialization on a runtime upgrade. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/870 Fixes: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22228
Fix motion cleanup and member ordering in governance pallets (#803) (#runtime) Ensure motions are removed from storage on close even when dispatch fails. Sort authority pairs before unzipping to keep member associations aligned. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.4 (#765, PM-22040) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.4/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
#security ## Added
Binary verification tooling (#635, SRE-1798) (#security, #operations) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases: - `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob - `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798
## Changed
Replace genesis state decode panics with error propagation (#766, PM-20204) (#node, #security) The node panicked on startup when the chain spec contained a missing, non-string, or invalid-hex `genesis_state` property. This replaces three `unwrap()` calls in `run_node` with a `decode_genesis_state` helper that returns descriptive errors via `sc_cli::Error::Input`, matching the existing error handling pattern used for seed file loading. Adds a 256 MiB size guard against adversarial chain specs. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204
Migrate secret and input interpolations to env: block indirection (#850, PM-22118) (#ci, #security) Remediate 7 audit findings (M-F007 through M-F014) by replacing direct ${{ }} expression interpolation in shell run: blocks with step-level env: block indirection across 7 GitHub Actions workflow files. This eliminates shell metacharacter injection and expression injection vectors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/850 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22118
Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx (#767, PM-19905) (#toolkit, #security) Hold the ledger_state mutex for the full read-modify-write cycle in update_from_tx, preventing potential lost updates under concurrent access. Addresses audit finding Issue AJ. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905
#tooling ## Added
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
#toolkit ## Added
Add `runtime-upgrade` command (PM-22108, #834) (#toolkit) Used for executing a hard-fork test in CI Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834
Add option when generating intents to write out the contract on-chain state (#812, PM-21901) (#toolkit) Adds a new optional `--output-onchain-state` option to the `generate-intent` command, that when supplied, will write out the contract's on-chain (public) state to the specified file. This file can then be supplied on subsequent usages of `generate-intent` via the `--input-onchain-state` option to _chain_ contract calls together, ensuring that changes in state are preserved through each of the contract invocations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Every time the toolkit.db is fetched, it uses by default 20 workers for fetching and MAX for computing. When the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications this leads to resource competition and wrong behavior. We propose to limit the number of threads used for computing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
Add support for multiple ledger versions (#711, PM-11244) (#toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244
Add support for zswap inputs and transients (#784, PM-21891) (#toolkit) When reading the provided zswap state, we now also read the inputs and construct the transients if needed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/784 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21891
## Changed
Clean up verbose logging (#802) (#node, #toolkit) Remove unnecessary println and dbg! calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802
Fix simple_tx panic when funding wallet has enough funds but not in one UTXO (#782, PM-21914) (#toolkit) Fixes toolkit panic when simple-tx needs to spend more than biggest UTXO of funding UTXO. Also prevents high evaluation time moving offer to fallible if there are more than one input. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/782 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21914
Fix `NotNormalized` error when dust spends and registrations are empty (#758, PM-21958) (#toolkit) Fixes the toolkit to omit `DustActions` in a transaction if it's a No-op. Resolves `NotNormalized` errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958
Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public inputs (#853) (#toolkit) The contract-address and coin-public CLI inputs are intentionally untagged. Reverts the tagged-only change for these two inputs while keeping tagged decoding as the default for other ledger types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853
Remove Default impl for WalletSeed (#804) (#node, #toolkit) Remove the Default trait implementation for WalletSeed. Callers should provide an explicit seed value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804
Allow DUST address registration without owning DUST (#849) (#toolkit) It uses possiblity that ledger gives us to register DUST address paying with virtual DUST that would have been accured if the NIGHT was registered for DUST production from UTXO creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/849 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21236
Pass the latest ledger parameters on intent generation (#837, PM-22073) (#toolkit) Fetch the latest LedgerParameters from the chain and pass them as input to toolkit.js when generating intents. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/837 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22073
Clean up toolkit input handling (#807) (#toolkit) Use tagged-only decoding in hex_ledger_decode, switch to checked arithmetic in transaction builder, and add file size limits when reading input files. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22088 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22089 JIRA: https://midnight-ntwrk.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22090
Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx (#767, PM-19905) (#toolkit, #security) Hold the ledger_state mutex for the full read-modify-write cycle in update_from_tx, preventing potential lost updates under concurrent access. Addresses audit finding Issue AJ. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905
When building transations use global_ttl from the ledger parameters instead of hardcoded 10 minutes (#791, PM-21976) (#toolkit) Changes the toolkit to use ledger_parameters.global_ttl to compute transaction ttl instead of hardcoded 10 minutes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21976
Remove unused `replace-initial-tx` command (PM-22112, #835) (#toolkit) Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22112 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835
Update Compact version to 0.29.0 (#728, PM-21765) (#toolkit) Starting with this version, we're pulling releases from a public github repository, so we can remove usage of `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765

name: node-0.22.0-rc.5
body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.5 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-03-04 **Git tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.5](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.5) **Release candidate:** This is a pre-release. It is not intended for production use. ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.5 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.5 ``` ## Summary Node 0.22.0-rc.5 upgrades to **ledger 8**. This RC also adds runtime audit fixes (benchmarked weights for `process_tokens`, duplicate inherent guards), memory management improvements (headroom monitor, validation cache TTL), and toolkit enhancements (on-chain state output, deterministic WASM builds via srtool). ## Audience - [x] **Node operators / SPOs** — binary upgrade required - [x] **DApp developers** — toolkit changes (on-chain state output, input handling) - [x] **Network administrators** — runtime upgrade required ## What Changed Changes new in rc.5 (not previously announced in rc.4): | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | --- | --- | --- | | Add benchmarked weight and UTXO count validation to `process_tokens` | Runtime upgrade | [#798](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798) | | Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block | Runtime upgrade | [#575](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575) | | Add test coverage for UtxoOwners persistence guards | Runtime upgrade | [#762](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762) | | Memory headroom monitor | Node upgrade | [#771](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771) | | Add metrics for partner chain operations | Node upgrade | [#593](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593) | | Rename is_spend | Node upgrade | [#710](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710) | | Fix sync issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 binaries | Node upgrade | [#852](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/852) | | Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory | Node upgrade | [#657](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657) | | Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks | Node upgrade | [#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716) | | Unify genesis state source for offline subcommands | Node upgrade | [#768](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768) | | Remove costly call to gc() until optimised | Node upgrade | [#750](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/750) | | Add TTL to soft transaction validation cache | Node upgrade | [#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737), [#748](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/748) | | Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism | Node upgrade | [#685](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685), [#700](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/700) | | Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache | Node upgrade | [#659](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659) | | Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast in utxos_info_from_output | Node upgrade | [#668](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668) | | Add `runtime-upgrade` command | Toolkit | [#834](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834) | | Add option to write out contract on-chain state | Toolkit | [#812](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812) | | Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public | Toolkit | [#853](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853) | | Clean up toolkit input handling | Toolkit | [#807](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807) | | Remove unused `replace-initial-tx` command | Toolkit | [#835](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835) | | Add srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds | Infrastructure | [#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681) | | Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image for genesis generation | Infrastructure | [#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676) | ## New Features ### Memory Headroom Monitor (Node upgrade) Adds a memory monitor service that periodically checks available system memory and triggers graceful shutdown before the OOM killer strikes. On Linux, detects cgroup v2/v1 limits (for Docker/K8s) or falls back to `/proc/meminfo` (bare metal). Disabled by default (`memory_threshold=0`); set `memory_threshold` to a MiB value to enable. ([#771](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771), [PM-22043](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22043)) ### Partner Chain Metrics (Node upgrade) Additional metrics for mainchain follower operations using an `observed_async_trait` macro, replacing manual metric instrumentation with a cleaner declarative approach. ([#593](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593), [PM-20927](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20927)) ### Toolkit: Write Out Contract On-Chain State (Toolkit) New `--output-onchain-state` option for the `generate-intent` command writes the contract's public state to a file. This file can be supplied via `--input-onchain-state` on subsequent calls to chain contract invocations together, preserving state changes. ([#812](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812), [PM-21901](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901)) ### Toolkit: Runtime Upgrade Command (Toolkit) New `runtime-upgrade` command for executing hard-fork tests in CI. ([#834](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834), [PM-22108](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108)) ### Deterministic Runtime WASM Builds via srtool (Infrastructure) Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using [srtool](https://github.com/paritytech/srtool). New Earthly targets: `+srtool-build`, `+srtool-info`, `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic`. The genesis generation script now prompts whether to use a deterministic srtool build. ([#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681), [PM-21907](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907)) ### Features Requiring Configuration Updates - **Memory headroom monitor:** Set `memory_threshold` (in MiB) to enable. Defaults to `0` (disabled). ## Improvements - **Benchmarked weight for `process_tokens`:** The `process_tokens` inherent now has proper FRAME benchmarked weights and a runtime UTXO count guard (`TooManyUtxos`), replacing the previous zero-weight `DispatchClass::Mandatory` bypass. ([#798](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798)) - **Duplicate inherent guard:** `InherentExecutedThisBlock` guard added to `cnight-observation` and `federated-authority-observation` pallets to ensure inherents execute only once per block. ([#575](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575)) - **Validation cache TTL and TimeToIdle:** Soft transaction validation cache entries now expire after 60 seconds (TTL) and idle entries are evicted, preventing stale mempool entries on relay nodes. ([#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737), [#748](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/748), [#659](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659)) - **UTXO ordering overrides:** Per-network override data for qanet, preview, and preprod enables syncing past blocks that were produced with non-deterministic UTXO consumption order. ([#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716)) - **Deterministic block production:** New blocks are now produced with deterministic UTXO ordering, while syncing remains compatible with historical non-deterministic blocks. ([#685](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685), [#700](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/700)) - **Ledger arena GC:** `backend.gc()` is called after flushing ledger storage to reclaim unreachable trie nodes, reducing memory leak rate during sync by ~50%. ([#657](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657)) Synchronous per-block GC subsequently removed pending optimisation. ([#750](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/750)) - **Offline subcommand genesis source:** CheckBlock, ExportBlocks, ExportState, ImportBlocks, Revert, and benchmarks now derive genesis state from the chain specification instead of the hardcoded UndeployedNetwork default. ([#768](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768)) - **Rename `is_spend`:** Corrected naming for clarity. ([#710](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710)) - **Safe cast:** Replaced unsafe `usize`-to-`u32` cast in `utxos_info_from_output`. ([#668](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668)) - **Toolkit input handling:** Tagged-only decoding in `hex_ledger_decode`, checked arithmetic in transaction builder, file size limits on input files. Contract-address and coin-public inputs remain intentionally untagged. ([#807](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807), [#853](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853)) - **Toolkit cleanup:** Removed unused `replace-initial-tx` command. ([#835](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835)) - **Genesis build:** `toolkit-js-prep` is no longer required when `GENERATE_TEST_TXS=false`, removing the `GITHUB_TOKEN` requirement for genesis generation without test transactions. ([#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676)) - **UtxoOwners test coverage:** Tests confirming event construction failure does not leave orphaned entries, and spending without prior create does not emit a Destroy event. ([#762](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions > **WARNING:** This release includes runtime upgrade changes. Nodes that do not upgrade will be unable to participate in the network after the runtime upgrade is enacted. ### Node-0.21.0 to Node-0.22.0 Sync Fix A sync compatibility issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 binaries has been resolved. ([#852](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/852)) ### Toolkit Breaking Changes - The `replace-initial-tx` command has been removed. ([#835](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835)) - `WalletSeed` no longer implements `Default` — callers must provide an explicit seed value (announced in rc.4, [#804](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804)). ## Fixed Defects | Defect | Summary | Priority | | --- | --- | --- | | [PM-22123](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22123) | Fix sync issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 binaries | High | | [PM-21764](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764) | Memory leak during sync from genesis (gc after flush) | High | | [PM-21969](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21969) | Remove costly synchronous gc() call pending optimisation | High | | [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823) | UTXO ordering overrides + deterministic block production | High | | [PM-21787](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787) | Transaction validation cache TTL and TimeToIdle | High | | [PM-21649](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649) | Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block | High | | [PM-20208](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208) | Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast | Medium | | [PM-20218](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218) | UtxoOwners test coverage for persistence guards | Medium | | [PM-20203](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20203) | Unify genesis state source for offline subcommands | Medium | | [PM-19778](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778) | Add benchmarked weight to process_tokens | Medium | ## Links and References ### Pull Requests - [#575](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575) — Prevent duplicate inherent execution - [#593](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593) — Add metrics for partner chain operations - [#657](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657) — Call gc() after flushing ledger storage - [#659](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659) — Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache - [#668](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668) — Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast - [#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676) — Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image - [#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681) — Add srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds - [#685](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685) — Sync with non-determinism, produce with determinism - [#700](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/700) — Sync with non-determinism (merge to main) - [#710](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710) — Rename is_spend - [#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716) — Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks - [#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737) — Add TTL to soft transaction validation cache - [#748](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/748) — TTL cache rebase - [#750](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/750) — Remove costly gc() call - [#762](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762) — Add test coverage for UtxoOwners persistence guards - [#768](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768) — Unify genesis state source for offline subcommands - [#771](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771) — Memory headroom monitor - [#798](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798) — Add benchmarked weight to process_tokens - [#807](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807) — Clean up toolkit input handling - [#812](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812) — Add option to write out contract on-chain state - [#834](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834) — Add runtime-upgrade command - [#835](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835) — Remove unused replace-initial-tx command - [#852](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/852) — Fix sync issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 - [#853](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853) — Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public ### JIRA Tickets - [PM-19778](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778) — process_tokens weight - [PM-20203](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20203) — Genesis state for offline subcommands - [PM-20208](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208) — Unsafe cast fix - [PM-20218](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218) — UtxoOwners test coverage - [PM-20927](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20927) — Partner chain metrics - [PM-21649](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649) — Duplicate inherent prevention - [PM-21764](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764) — Memory leak during sync - [PM-21787](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787) — Validation cache improvements - [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823) — UTXO ordering determinism - [PM-21901](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901) — Toolkit on-chain state output - [PM-21907](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907) — srtool deterministic builds - [PM-21969](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21969) — gc() performance - [PM-22043](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22043) — Memory headroom monitor - [PM-22108](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108) — Runtime upgrade command - [PM-22123](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22123) — Sync compatibility fix ## Full Change Details Changes new since rc.4. For the complete cumulative changelog, see the [GitHub release](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.0-rc.5). ### Added
Memory headroom monitor (#771, PM-22043) (#node) Adds a memory monitor service that periodically checks available system memory and triggers graceful shutdown before the OOM killer strikes. On Linux, detects cgroup v2/v1 limits (for Docker/K8s) or falls back to /proc/meminfo (bare metal). Disabled by default (memory_threshold=0); set memory_threshold to a MiB value to enable. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/771 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22043
Add metrics for partner chain operations (#593, PM-20927) (#node) Enable additional metrics for mainchain follower operations using an observed_async_trait macro, replacing manual metric instrumentation with a cleaner declarative approach. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/593 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20927
Add option when generating intents to write out the contract on-chain state (#812, PM-21901) (#toolkit) Adds a new optional `--output-onchain-state` option to the `generate-intent` command, that when supplied, will write out the contract's on-chain (public) state to the specified file. This file can then be supplied on subsequent usages of `generate-intent` via the `--input-onchain-state` option to _chain_ contract calls together, ensuring that changes in state are preserved through each of the contract invocations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/812 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21901
Add runtime-upgrade command (PM-22108, #834) (#toolkit) Used for executing a hard-fork test in CI Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22108 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/834
Add srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds (#681, PM-21907) (#node, #genesis) Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using srtool: - New `+srtool-build` target: Builds the runtime WASM deterministically using the srtool Docker image - New `+srtool-info` target: Displays information about srtool configuration - New `DETERMINISTIC` flag for `+rebuild-chainspec`: When `true`, uses srtool-built WASM - New `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic` convenience target The genesis generation script now prompts the user during Step 3 (Chain Spec Generation) whether to use a deterministic srtool build. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907
Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image for genesis generation (#676, PM-21902) (#node, #genesis) When `GENERATE_TEST_TXS=false`, the toolkit-image no longer requires `toolkit-js-prep` to be built. This allows genesis generation to proceed without needing GITHUB_TOKEN when test transactions are not being generated. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21902
### Changed
Add benchmarked weight and UTXO count validation to process_tokens (#798, PM-19778) (#audit, #runtime) The `process_tokens` inherent extrinsic previously declared zero weight with `DispatchClass::Mandatory`, bypassing block weight accounting. This adds FRAME benchmarking infrastructure, a runtime UTXO count guard (`TooManyUtxos`), and `PostDispatchInfo` actual-weight correction to the cnight-observation pallet. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/798 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19778
Add test coverage for UtxoOwners persistence guards (#762, PM-20218) (#audit) Tests that event construction failure does not leave orphaned UtxoOwners entries, and that spending a UTXO without a prior create does not emit a Destroy event. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/762 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block (#575, PM-21649) (#node) Add InherentExecutedThisBlock guard to cnight-observation and federated-authority-observation pallets to ensure inherents can only execute once per block. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649
Fix sync issue between node-0.21.0 and node-0.22.0 binaries (#852, PM-22123) (#node, #binary) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/852 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22123
Restore untagged decoding for contract-address and coin-public inputs (#853) (#toolkit) The contract-address and coin-public CLI inputs are intentionally untagged. Reverts the tagged-only change for these two inputs while keeping tagged decoding as the default for other ledger types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/853
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50%. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Remove costly call to gc() until it's optimised (#750, PM-21969) (#client) We were calling the Ledger storage garbage collection synchronously at the end of each block. After running some benchmarks, we've found that it's in need of optimisation. Removing for now. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/750 Possible cause for: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21969
Add TTL to soft transaction validation cache (#737, #748, PM-21787) (#client, #node, #performance) Added a 60-second Time-To-Live for the soft validation cache to evict stale entries on relay nodes, where transactions were lingering in the mempool indefinitely. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737 Rebase PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/748 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787
Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache (#659, PM-21787) (#client, #node, #performance) Added a Time-To-Idle for the transaction validation cache to prevent entries lingering in the cache indefinitely. Also tuned the limits of the two caches. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787
Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks (#716, PM-21823) (#ledger) Provide per-network UTXO ordering override data for qanet, preview, and preprod so that nodes can sync past blocks that were originally produced with non-deterministic UTXO consumption order. Includes tooling to generate the override data from an indexer database. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, #700, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Preserves the non-deterministic behaviour when syncing historical blocks, while ensuring new blocks are produced deterministically. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685 PR onto main: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/700 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Unify genesis state source for offline subcommands (#768, PM-20203) (#node) Offline subcommands (CheckBlock, ExportBlocks, ExportState, ImportBlocks, Revert, benchmarks) now derive genesis state from the chain specification instead of the hardcoded UndeployedNetwork default. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/768 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20203
Rename is_spend (#710, PM-21789) (#client) Fixes the naming of is_spend. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21789
Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast in utxos_info_from_output (#668, PM-20208) Fix for unsafe cast PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208
Remove unused SyncStatusExt and sync-status-monitor (#811) (#node) Remove the SyncStatusExt runtime extension, the sync-status-monitor background task, and associated is_syncing plumbing. UTXO ordering for historical blocks is handled by the per-transaction override data files instead. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811
Clean up toolkit input handling (#807) (#toolkit) Use tagged-only decoding in hex_ledger_decode, switch to checked arithmetic in transaction builder, and add file size limits when reading input files. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/807
Remove unused replace-initial-tx command (PM-22112, #835) (#toolkit) Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22112 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/835

name: node-0.22.0-rc.4
body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.4 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-03-02 **Git tag:** [`node-0.22.0-rc.4`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.4) **Environment:** All public networks. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/relnotes/overview). ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.4 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.4 ``` ## Summary This release candidate adds per-account transaction throttling to the runtime, multi-ledger-version support in the toolkit, and several fixes including governance motion cleanup, NextCardanoPosition validation guards, genesis state decode error handling, and ledger dependency diamond resolution. It also bumps ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5. ## Audience This release is relevant to: - [x] Node operators - [x] DApp developers - [x] Indexer operators ## What Changed Changes new in rc.4 (incremental from [rc.3](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.0-rc.3)): | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | ------ | ------------ | --- | | Add guards to NextCardanoPosition updates | Runtime | [#763](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/763) | | Per-account signed transaction throttling | Runtime | [#770](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770) | | Fix motion cleanup and member ordering in governance pallets | Runtime | [#803](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803) | | Replace genesis state decode panics with error propagation | Node | [#766](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766) | | Remove unused SyncStatusExt and sync-status-monitor | Node | [#811](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811) | | Bump ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5 | Node | [#816](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816) | | Clean up verbose logging | Node + Toolkit | [#802](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802) | | Remove Default impl for WalletSeed | Node + Toolkit | [#804](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804) | | Add support for multiple ledger versions | Toolkit | [#711](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711) | | Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx | Toolkit | [#767](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767) | | Use global_ttl from ledger parameters for transaction TTL | Toolkit | [#791](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791) | | Migrate image signing to GitHub native attestations | Infrastructure | [#786](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786) | | Add srtool WASM build workflow for releases | Infrastructure | [#795](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795) | | Update npm version to prevent audit failure | Infrastructure | [#797](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/797) | | Fix minimatch high severity vulnerability | Infrastructure | [#808](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/808) | ## New Features ### Per-account signed transaction throttling (Runtime) New `pallet-throttle` with a `CheckThrottle` transaction extension that limits per-account byte usage within a rolling block window. Each account is allowed up to 10 MB of transaction data per day (14,400 blocks at 6s/block). Usage resets automatically once the window expires. Unsigned and inherent transactions bypass the throttle. PR: [#770](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770) | JIRA: [PM-21204](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21204) ### Multi-ledger-version support in toolkit (Toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains, enabling cross-version compatibility during the transition period. PR: [#711](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711) | JIRA: [PM-11244](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244) ### Deterministic runtime WASM builds via srtool (Infrastructure) New GitHub Actions workflow that builds deterministic runtime WASM artifacts and uploads them to GitHub releases. Artifacts include `midnight_node_runtime.wasm`, compact/compressed variants, `srtool-digest.json`, checksums, and Cosign signatures. PR: [#795](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795) | JIRA: [PM-22075](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22075) ## Improvements - **Add guards to NextCardanoPosition updates** (Runtime): Enforce monotonicity and window-bound validation on `NextCardanoPosition` in `process_tokens`. ([#763](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/763), [PM-19901](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19901)) - **Fix motion cleanup and member ordering in governance pallets** (Runtime): Ensure motions are removed from storage on close even when dispatch fails; sort authority pairs before unzipping to keep member associations aligned. ([#803](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803)) - **Replace genesis state decode panics with error propagation** (Node): Replace three `unwrap()` calls in `run_node` with descriptive errors via `sc_cli::Error::Input`. Adds a 256 MiB size guard against adversarial chain specs. ([#766](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766), [PM-20204](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204)) - **Remove unused SyncStatusExt and sync-status-monitor** (Node): Remove dead code that was never read by any consumer. ([#811](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811)) - **Bump ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5** (Node): Fixes diamond dependency on shared crates by giving each ledger version its own dependency tree. Concretizes fork module generics with concrete Db7/Db8 types. ([#816](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816), [PM-22040](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040)) - **Clean up verbose logging** (Node + Toolkit): Remove unnecessary `println` and `dbg!` calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. ([#802](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802)) - **Remove Default impl for WalletSeed** (Node + Toolkit): Callers must now provide an explicit seed value, preventing use of a recoverable default seed. ([#804](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804)) - **Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx** (Toolkit): Hold the `ledger_state` mutex for the full read-modify-write cycle, preventing lost updates under concurrent access. Addresses audit finding Issue AJ. ([#767](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767), [PM-19905](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905)) - **Use global_ttl from ledger parameters for transaction TTL** (Toolkit): Replace hardcoded 10-minute TTL with the value from `ledger_parameters.global_ttl`. ([#791](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791), [PM-21976](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21976)) - **Migrate image signing to GitHub native attestations** (Infrastructure): Replace Cosign keyless signing with `actions/attest-build-provenance`. ([#786](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786)) - **Fix minimatch high severity vulnerability** (Infrastructure): Update minimatch override from 10.2.1 to 10.2.4 to resolve ReDoS vulnerabilities. ([#808](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/808)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions > **Runtime upgrade required.** This release includes runtime changes (pallet-throttle, governance motion cleanup, NextCardanoPosition guards). Node operators must perform a runtime upgrade after updating the binary. - **`WalletSeed` no longer implements `Default`** — callers that relied on `WalletSeed::default()` must now provide an explicit seed value. - **Transaction TTL now uses `global_ttl` from ledger parameters** — toolkit consumers that depended on the hardcoded 10-minute TTL should verify their timeout assumptions. ## Fixed Defects | Defect | Summary | Priority | | ------ | ------- | -------- | | [PM-19901](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19901) | NextCardanoPosition missing monotonicity guards (audit) | High | | [PM-20204](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204) | Genesis state decode panics on malformed chain spec | High | | [PM-19905](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905) | Race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx (audit) | High | | [PM-22040](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040) | Diamond dependency on shared ledger crates | Medium | ## Links and References - [GitHub Release](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.0-rc.4) - [Previous RC: node-0.22.0-rc.3](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.22.0-rc.3) - PRs: [#711](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711), [#763](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/763), [#766](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766), [#767](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767), [#770](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770), [#786](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786), [#791](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791), [#795](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795), [#797](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/797), [#802](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802), [#803](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803), [#804](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804), [#808](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/808), [#811](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811), [#816](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816) - JIRA: [PM-21204](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21204), [PM-11244](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244), [PM-22075](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22075), [PM-19901](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19901), [PM-20204](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204), [PM-19905](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905), [PM-22040](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040), [PM-21976](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21976) ## Full Change Details The following is the verbatim auto-generated content from the GitHub release (all entries, not just incremental): ### Docker Images #### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.4 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.4 ``` ### Added
Binary verification tooling (#635, SRE-1798) (#security, #operations) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases: - `scripts/verify-binary.sh`: Wrapper script for cosign verify-blob - `docs/security/binary-verification.md`: Documentation with prerequisites, examples, and troubleshooting PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798
Add ephemeral env configuration for govnet (#619) Allow running govnet in local-environment PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619
Finer grained ledger error codes (#745, PM-21798) (#node) Map all known MalformedTransaction and TransactionInvalid variants to specific error codes instead of falling through to UnknownError. Fixes the u8 collision between MalformedError::UnknownError and SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Additional logging for ledger (PM-21954, #727) (#ledger) Added additional logging for operations performed on the ledger with additional tracking of time we spent on each of the steps. Issue: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21954 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Per-account signed transaction throttling (#770, PM-21204) (#runtime) Adds a new `pallet-throttle` with a `CheckThrottle` transaction extension that limits per-account byte usage within a rolling block window. Each account is allowed up to 10 MB of transaction data per day (14400 blocks at 6s/block). Usage resets automatically once the window expires. - New pallet at `pallets/throttle/` with `AccountUsage` storage tracking `(bytes_used, window_start_block)` per account - `CheckThrottle` implements `TransactionExtension`: `validate()` rejects transactions exceeding the limit, `prepare()` persists updated usage - Unsigned/inherent transactions bypass the throttle - 25 unit tests covering accumulation, window expiry, boundary conditions, multi-account isolation, and overflow safety PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/770 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21204
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add srtool WASM build workflow for releases (#795, PM-22075) (#ci) New `srtool Build` GitHub Actions workflow that builds deterministic runtime WASM artifacts and uploads them to GitHub releases. Can be triggered standalone to backfill past releases, or runs automatically as part of the `Create Release` workflow. Artifacts attached to releases: `midnight_node_runtime.wasm`, `.compact.wasm`, `.compact.compressed.wasm`, `srtool-digest.json`, checksums, and Cosign signatures. A new `node-only` option on the `Create Release` workflow skips the srtool build for node-only releases that don't include runtime changes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/795 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22075
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Every time the toolkit.db is fetched, it uses by default 20 workers for fetching and MAX for computing. When the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications this leads to resource competition and wrong behavior. We propose to limit the number of threads used for computing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
Add support for multiple ledger versions (#711, PM-11244) (#toolkit) The toolkit can now sync with both Ledger 7 and Ledger 8 chains PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/711 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11244
### Changed
Use take instead of get (#317, PM-19770) (#audit) Remove `UtxoOwners` key after spending PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770
Update Ledger to 7.0.2 (#739) (#client, #ledger) Bump core ledger versions to 7.0.2. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739
Bump ledger 7 to 7.0.3-rc.1 and ledger 8 to 8.0.0-rc.5 (#816, PM-22040) (#client, #ledger) Bump ledger 7 from 7.0.2 (crates.io) to 7.0.3-rc.1 (git tag) and ledger 8 from 8.0.0-rc.4 to 8.0.0-rc.5. Fixes diamond dependency on shared crates (base-crypto, coin-structure, etc.) by giving each ledger version its own dependency tree. Concretizes fork module generics with concrete Db7/Db8 types. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/816 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Bump yamux to 0.13.8 to prevent panics (#755) (#node) Backport of a fix from polkadot-sdk stable2509-3 (paritytech/polkadot-sdk#10479). Updates yamux from 0.13.6 to 0.13.8 to avoid panics when tungstenite websocket connections are used with yamux in the p2p networking layer. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755
Clean up verbose logging (#802) (#node, #toolkit) Remove unnecessary println and dbg! calls from toolkit and ledger helpers. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/802
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Update npm version to prevent npm audit failure in CI. (#797) (#ci) Updates the version to stable 11.11.0 because npm audit complained at 10.9.4 which comes by default with node 22. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/797
Fix order of CNGD ownership insertion order (#757, PM-20218) Ensures we insert cngd utxos after successful event creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/757 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Ensure Terms and Conditions values at genesis (#646) Ensures we do not allow creating a genesis without both Terms and Conditions values PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646
Replace genesis state decode panics with error propagation (#766, PM-20204) (#node, #security) The node panicked on startup when the chain spec contained a missing, non-string, or invalid-hex `genesis_state` property. This replaces three `unwrap()` calls in `run_node` with a `decode_genesis_state` helper that returns descriptive errors via `sc_cli::Error::Input`, matching the existing error handling pattern used for seed file loading. Adds a 256 MiB size guard against adversarial chain specs. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/766 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20204
Fix governance update command in ephemeral environments (#517, PM-21136) Fixes parsing of large WASM files when attempting the upgrade. Remove hard-coded threshold for proposal calls from ephemeral env script. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/517 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Moves the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. Prevents broken state after rollbacks. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
Add guards to NextCardanoPosition updates (#763, PM-19901) (#audit) Enforce monotonicity and window-bound validation on `NextCardanoPosition` in `process_tokens`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/763 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19901
Fix motion cleanup and member ordering in governance pallets (#803) (#runtime) Ensure motions are removed from storage on close even when dispatch fails. Sort authority pairs before unzipping to keep member associations aligned. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/803
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.4 (#765, PM-22040) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.4/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040
Migrate image signing from Cosign/Sigstore to GitHub native attestations (#786) (#ci) Replace Cosign keyless signing with GitHub's `actions/attest-build-provenance`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/786
Fix minimatch high severity vulnerability in local-environment (#808) Update minimatch override from 10.2.1 to 10.2.4 to resolve ReDoS vulnerabilities (GHSA-7r86-cg39-jmmj, GHSA-23c5-xmqv-rm74). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/808
Remove unused SyncStatusExt and sync-status-monitor (#811) (#node) Remove the SyncStatusExt runtime extension, the sync-status-monitor background task, and associated is_syncing plumbing. This code was never read by any consumer. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/811
Remove Default impl for WalletSeed (#804) (#node, #toolkit) Remove the Default trait implementation for WalletSeed. Callers should provide an explicit seed value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/804
Fix race condition in LedgerContext::update_from_tx (#767, PM-19905) (#toolkit, #security) Hold the ledger_state mutex for the full read-modify-write cycle in update_from_tx, preventing potential lost updates under concurrent access. Addresses audit finding Issue AJ. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/767 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19905
When building transactions use global_ttl from the ledger parameters instead of hardcoded 10 minutes (#791, PM-21976) (#toolkit) Changes the toolkit to use ledger_parameters.global_ttl to compute transaction ttl instead of hardcoded 10 minutes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/791 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21976
Update Compact version to 0.29.0 (#728, PM-21765) (#toolkit) Starting with this version, we're pulling releases from a public github repository, so we can remove usage of `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765
Fix `NotNormalized` error when dust spends and registrations are empty (#758, PM-21958) (#toolkit) Fixes the toolkit to omit `DustActions` in a transaction if it's a No-op. Resolves `NotNormalized` errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958

name: node-0.22.0-rc.3
body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.3 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-02-26 **Git tag:** [`node-0.22.0-rc.3`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.3) **Environment:** All public networks. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/relnotes/overview). ## Docker Images ```shell docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.3 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.3 ``` ## Summary This release candidate introduces Ledger 8 (rc.4) with governance system transaction gating and reserve contract observation, deterministic WASM builds via srtool, binary verification tooling for SPOs, finer-grained ledger error codes, and several critical fixes including UtxoOwner state growth remediation, CNGD insertion ordering, and duplicate inherent execution prevention. The toolkit gains concurrency controls and cached transaction support. ## Audience This release is relevant to: - [x] Node operators - [x] DApp developers - [x] Indexer operators ## What Changed | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Remove UtxoOwners key after spending (audit) | Runtime | [#317](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317) | | Fix CNGD ownership insertion order | Runtime | [#757](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/757) | | Ensure Terms and Conditions values at genesis | Runtime | [#646](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646) | | Prevent duplicate inherent execution | Runtime | [#575](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575) | | Update Ledger to 8.0.0-rc.4 | Runtime | [#765](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765) | | Finer grained ledger error codes | Node | [#745](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745) | | Additional logging for ledger | Node | [#727](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727) | | Update Ledger to 7.0.2 | Node | [#739](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739) | | Bump yamux to 0.13.8 to prevent panics | Node | [#755](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755) | | Switch to deterministic iteration in tx processing | Node | [#678](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678) | | Rename is_spend | Node | [#710](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710) | | Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast | Node | [#668](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668) | | UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks | Node | [#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716) | | Remove costly gc() call until optimised | Node | [#750](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/750) | | Add TTL to soft transaction validation cache | Node | [#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737) | | Fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit | Toolkit | [#675](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675) | | Cached transactions option for toolkit | Toolkit | [#682](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682) | | Fix NotNormalized error when dust spends are empty | Toolkit | [#758](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758) | | Update Compact version to 0.29.0 | Toolkit | [#728](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728) | | Binary verification tooling | Infrastructure | [#635](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635) | | Ephemeral env configuration for govnet | Infrastructure | [#619](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619) | | srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds | Infrastructure | [#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681) | | Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image for genesis | Infrastructure | [#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676) | | Fix governance update command in ephemeral environments | Infrastructure | [#517](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/517) | ## New Features ### Binary verification tooling (Infrastructure) Added scripts and documentation for SPOs and operators to verify signed binary releases using cosign. Includes `scripts/verify-binary.sh` wrapper script and documentation at `docs/security/binary-verification.md`. PR: [#635](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/635) | JIRA: [SRE-1798](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1798) ### Finer grained ledger error codes (Node upgrade) Maps all known `MalformedTransaction` and `TransactionInvalid` variants to specific error codes instead of falling through to `UnknownError`. Fixes the u8 collision between `MalformedError::UnknownError` and `SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout` (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: [#745](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745) | JIRA: [PM-21798](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798) ### Additional logging for ledger (Node upgrade) Added detailed logging for operations performed on the ledger with tracking of time spent on each step, aiding performance analysis and debugging. PR: [#727](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727) | JIRA: [PM-21954](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21954) ### Fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (Toolkit) Adds `--fetch-compute-concurrency` option to limit the number of threads used for computing when the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications, preventing resource competition. PR: [#675](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675) | JIRA: [PM-21786](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786) ### Cached transactions option for toolkit (Toolkit) Allows users to reduce toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached locally. PR: [#682](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682) | JIRA: [PM-21788](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788) ### Deterministic runtime WASM builds via srtool (Infrastructure) Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using [srtool](https://github.com/paritytech/srtool). New Earthly targets `+srtool-build`, `+srtool-info`, and `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic` are available. The genesis generation script now prompts whether to use a deterministic build and generates a `chain-spec-hash.json` for verification. PR: [#681](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681) | JIRA: [PM-21907](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907) ## Improvements - **Update Ledger to 8.0.0-rc.4** (Runtime): Latest Ledger 8 release candidate. See [changelog](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.4/CHANGELOG.md#800). ([#765](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/765), [PM-22040](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-22040)) - **Update Ledger to 7.0.2** (Node): Patch release for the current production ledger version. ([#739](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739)) - **Bump yamux to 0.13.8** (Node): Backport from polkadot-sdk stable2509-3 to prevent panics in p2p websocket connections. ([#755](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755)) - **Add TTL to soft transaction validation cache** (Node): 60-second TTL evicts stale entries on relay nodes where transactions lingered in the mempool indefinitely. ([#737](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/737), [PM-21787](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787)) - **UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks** (Node): Per-network override data for qanet, preview, and preprod enabling sync past blocks produced with non-deterministic order. Includes tooling to generate override data from an indexer database. ([#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716), [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823)) - **Update Compact version to 0.29.0** (Toolkit): Pulls releases from a public GitHub repository, removing the need for `GITHUB_TOKEN` in several places. ([#728](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/728), [PM-21765](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765)) - **Rename is_spend** (Node): Fixes naming of the `is_spend` method. ([#710](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710), [PM-21789](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21789)) - **Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image** (Infrastructure): Genesis generation no longer requires `GITHUB_TOKEN` when test transactions are not being generated. ([#676](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676), [PM-21902](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21902)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions > **Runtime upgrade:** This release includes changes to pallet logic (UtxoOwner cleanup, CNGD insertion order fix, T&C genesis enforcement, duplicate inherent prevention) and updates to Ledger 8.0.0-rc.4. Networks upgrading to this runtime version will require a coordinated upgrade. - **UtxoOwner state cleanup** ([#317](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317)): The `cnight-observation` pallet now removes `UtxoOwners` keys after spending, addressing unbounded state growth identified in the audit ([PM-19770](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770)). - **CNGD ownership insertion order** ([#757](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/757)): Ensures CNGD UTXOs are inserted after successful event creation, fixing incorrect ordering ([PM-20218](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218)). - **Terms and Conditions required at genesis** ([#646](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646)): Genesis creation now rejects chain specs missing both Terms and Conditions values. - **Duplicate inherent prevention** ([#575](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575)): Adds `InherentExecutedThisBlock` guards to `cnight-observation` and `federated-authority-observation` pallets ([PM-21649](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649)). - **Deterministic iteration** ([#678](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678)): Replaces `HashMap` with a deterministic-iteration collection in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution ([PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823)). ## Fixed Defects | Defect | Summary | Priority | | --------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | | [PM-19770](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770) | UtxoOwner state growth: remove keys after spending | High | | [PM-20218](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218) | CNGD ownership insertion order was incorrect | High | | [PM-20208](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208) | Unsafe usize-to-u32 cast in utxos_info_from_output | High | | [PM-21649](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649) | Duplicate inherent execution within same block | High | | [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823) | Non-deterministic iteration in transaction processing | High | | [PM-21958](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958) | NotNormalized error when dust spends and registrations are empty | High | | [PM-21969](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21969) | gc() call too costly, removed until optimised | Medium | | [PM-21136](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136) | Governance update command failed parsing large WASM in ephemeral envs | Medium | ## Known Issues **Ledger division-by-zero panic:** The ledger contains an unpatched division-by-zero panic that can halt block production under certain conditions. A fix is expected in a subsequent release. ## Links and References ### Pull Requests - [#317](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317) - Use take instead of get (UtxoOwners) - [#517](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/517) - Ledger 8.0.0-rc.4 ## Full Change Details The following is the verbatim content from the auto-generated release notes. ### Added

Fixes the u8 collision between MalformedError::UnknownError and SystemTransactionError::IllegalPayout (both previously mapped to 139). Adds a test to prevent future collisions. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/745 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21798
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. New CLI Commands: verify-ledger-state-genesis, verify-cardano-tip-finalized, verify-auth-script, and related verification commands. Interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` performs 5 verification steps including Cardano tip finalization check, config file regeneration, LedgerState verification, Dparameter verification, and authorization script verification. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only OverwriteParameters (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Additional logging for ledger (PM-21954, #727) (#ledger) Added additional logging for operations performed on the ledger with additional tracking of time we spent on each of the steps. Issue: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21954 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/727
Add network_peerReputations and network_peerReputation RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe network_unbanPeer RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless --unsafe-rpc-external is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses LedgerState::with_genesis_settings() to set locked_pool from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add a fetch-compute-concurrency option for toolkit (#675, PM-21786) (#toolkit) Limits the number of threads used for computing when the toolkit is used in multi-threaded applications. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/675 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21786
Add an option to use only cached transactions when using toolkit (#682, PM-21788) (#toolkit) Allows a user to reduce the toolkit start-up time by skipping fetching from RPC if the chain is already cached. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/682 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21788
### Changed
Use take instead of get (#317, PM-19770) (#audit) Remove UtxoOwners key after spending PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/317 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-19770
Update Ledger to 7.0.2 (#739) (#client, #ledger) Bump core ledger versions to 7.0.2. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/739
Bump yamux to 0.13.8 to prevent panics (#755) (#node) Backport of a fix from polkadot-sdk stable2509-3. Updates yamux from 0.13.6 to 0.13.8 to avoid panics when tungstenite websocket connections are used with yamux in the p2p networking layer. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/755
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Fix order of CNGD ownership insertion order (#757, PM-20218) Ensures we insert cngd utxos after successful event creation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/757 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20218
Ensure Terms and Conditions values at genesis (#646) Ensures we do not allow creating a genesis without both Terms and Conditions values. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646
Fix governance update command in ephemeral environments (#517, PM-21136) Fixes parsing of large WASM files when attempting the upgrade. Remove hard-coded threshold for proposal calls. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/517 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Moves ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block, running only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. Fix NotNormalized error when dust spends and registrations are empty (#758, PM-21958) (#toolkit) Fixes the toolkit to omit DustActions in a transaction if it's a No-op. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/758 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21958
Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block (#575, PM-21649) (#node) Adds InherentExecutedThisBlock guard to cnight-observation and federated-authority-observation pallets. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649
Rename is_spend (#710, PM-21789) (#client) Fixes the naming of is_spend. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/710 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21789
Replace unsafe usize-to-u32 cast in utxos_info_from_output (#668, PM-20208) Fix for unsafe cast. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/668 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20208
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) Reduces the memory leak rate by ~50% by adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db(). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
