name: node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.1
body:
Git tag: [node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-mainnet-test.1) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-mainnet-test.1 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-mainnet-test.1 ``` ## Added
Add ephemeral env configuration for govnet (#619) Allow running govnet in local-environment PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/619
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
## Changed
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Ensure Terms and Conditions values at genesis (#646) Ensures we do not allow creating a genesis without both Terms and Conditions values PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/646
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block (#575, PM-21649) (#node) Add InherentExecutedThisBlock guard to cnight-observation and federated-authority-observation pallets to ensure inherents can only execute once per block. This prevents potential issues from multiple inherent calls being processed in a single block. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Add srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds (#681, PM-21907) (#node, #genesis) Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using [srtool](https://github.com/paritytech/srtool): - New `+srtool-build` target: Builds the runtime WASM deterministically using the srtool Docker image - New `+srtool-info` target: Displays information about srtool configuration - New `DETERMINISTIC` flag for `+rebuild-chainspec`: When `true`, uses srtool-built WASM - New `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic` convenience target Usage: ```bash # Build deterministic runtime WASM only earthly +srtool-build # Build chainspec with deterministic WASM earthly +rebuild-chainspec --NETWORK=mainnet --DETERMINISTIC=true # Or use the convenience target earthly +rebuild-chainspec-deterministic --NETWORK=mainnet ``` The srtool digest (containing WASM hash and build info) is saved alongside the chain-spec for verification. The genesis construction script (`scripts/genesis/genesis-construction.sh`) now prompts the user during Step 3 (Chain Spec Generation) whether to use a deterministic srtool build. When selected, it passes `--DETERMINISTIC=true` to the `+rebuild-chainspec` Earthly target. After generation, the script also creates a `chain-spec-hash.json` file containing the SHA-256 hash of `chain-spec-raw.json`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907
Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image for genesis generation (#676, PM-21902) (#node, #genesis) When `GENERATE_TEST_TXS=false`, the toolkit-image no longer requires `toolkit-js-prep` to be built. This allows genesis generation to proceed without needing GITHUB_TOKEN when test transactions are not being generated, since `fetch-compactc` (which downloads from a private GitHub repository) is only needed for test contract compilation. Added `INCLUDE_TOOLKIT_JS` argument to `toolkit-image` target that defaults to `true` but can be set to `false` to skip including toolkit-js artifacts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/676 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21902
Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache (#659, PM-21787) (#client, #node, #performance) Added a Time-To-Idle for the transaction validation cache to prevent entries lingering in the cache indefinitely. Also tuned the limits of the two caches. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787

This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
#ledger ## Added
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
## Changed
Switch to collection with deterministic iteration (#678, PM-21823) (#ledger) Replace HashMap usage with a collection that has deterministic iteration order in transaction processing, preventing potential non-determinism in block execution. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/678 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
#networking ## Added
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896

Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
## Changed
Prevent duplicate inherent execution within same block (#575, PM-21649) (#node) Add InherentExecutedThisBlock guard to cnight-observation and federated-authority-observation pallets to ensure inherents can only execute once per block. This prevents potential issues from multiple inherent calls being processed in a single block. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/575 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21649
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Add srtool for deterministic runtime WASM builds (#681, PM-21907) (#node, #genesis) Added support for deterministic runtime WASM builds using [srtool](https://github.com/paritytech/srtool): - New `+srtool-build` target: Builds the runtime WASM deterministically using the srtool Docker image - New `+srtool-info` target: Displays information about srtool configuration - New `DETERMINISTIC` flag for `+rebuild-chainspec`: When `true`, uses srtool-built WASM - New `+rebuild-chainspec-deterministic` convenience target Usage: ```bash # Build deterministic runtime WASM only earthly +srtool-build # Build chainspec with deterministic WASM earthly +rebuild-chainspec --NETWORK=mainnet --DETERMINISTIC=true # Or use the convenience target earthly +rebuild-chainspec-deterministic --NETWORK=mainnet ``` The srtool digest (containing WASM hash and build info) is saved alongside the chain-spec for verification. The genesis construction script (`scripts/genesis/genesis-construction.sh`) now prompts the user during Step 3 (Chain Spec Generation) whether to use a deterministic srtool build. When selected, it passes `--DETERMINISTIC=true` to the `+rebuild-chainspec` Earthly target. After generation, the script also creates a `chain-spec-hash.json` file containing the SHA-256 hash of `chain-spec-raw.json`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/681 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21907
Make toolkit-js optional in toolkit-image for genesis generation (#676, PM-21902) (#node, #genesis) When `GENERATE_TEST_TXS=false`, the toolkit-image no longer requires `toolkit-js-prep` to be built. This allows genesis generation to proceed without needing GITHUB_TOKEN when test transactions are not being generated, since `fetch-compactc` (which downloads from a private GitHub repository) is only needed for test contract compilation. Added `INCLUDE_TOOLKIT_JS` argument to `toolkit-image` target that defaults to `true` but can be set to `false` to skip including toolkit-js artifacts. name: node-0.21.0
body:
# Midnight Node 0.21.0 Release Notes **Release date:** 2026-02-24 **Git tag:** [`node-0.21.0`](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.21.0) **Environment:** All public networks. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/next/relnotes/overview). ## Docker Images ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.21.0 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.21.0 ``` ## Summary This release adds transaction validation caching for improved mempool performance, interactive genesis generation tooling, wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay in the toolkit, and several runtime fixes including correct block fullness reporting and tolerance for duplicate governance members. It also completes the non-determinism fix from 0.20.2 by adding UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks across all networks. ## Audience This release is relevant to: - [x] Node operators - [x] DApp developers - [x] Indexer operators ## What Changed | Change | Upgrade Type | PR | | ------ | ------------ | -- | | Accept duplicate members in Federated Authority observation | Runtime upgrade | [#606](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/606) | | Fix overfilled blocks report max fullness instead of 0 | Runtime upgrade + Toolkit | [#559](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559) | | Remove unused transaction details and gas cost calculation | Runtime upgrade | [#599](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599) | | Remove explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation | Runtime upgrade | [#576](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/576) | | Add transaction validation caching | Node upgrade | [#608](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608) | | Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks | Node upgrade | [#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716) | | Added interactive genesis generation tool | Node upgrade | [#582](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/582) | | Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics | Node upgrade | [#554](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554) | | Parallelize cnight queries | Node upgrade | [#603](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603) | | Set Substrate storage Trie cache back to default values | Node upgrade | [#601](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/601) | | Add ledger parameters config to genesis generation | Toolkit | [#542](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542) | | Add `deregister-dust-address` command to toolkit | Toolkit | [#482](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/482) | | Add wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay | Toolkit | [#483](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483) | | Improve toolkit error logging when sending transactions | Toolkit | [#560](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/560) | | Fix effects detection in intent | Toolkit | [#573](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/573) | | Update Compact to 0.29.0 | Toolkit | [#736](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/736) | | Fix ephemeral env connection timeouts | Infrastructure | [#583](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583) | | Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal | Infrastructure | [#495](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495) | ## New Features ### Transaction validation caching (Node upgrade) Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work, improving mempool performance. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. PR: [#608](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608) | JIRA: [PM-21592](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592) ### Interactive genesis generation tool (Node upgrade) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through chain specification generation. The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and walks through ledger state generation, genesis config generation, and chain spec generation. Also adds `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand, `--pc-config` and `--ics-config` CLI arguments, and the `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate. PR: [#582](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/582) | JIRA: [PM-20830](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20830) ### Wallet state caching (Toolkit) Persists LedgerContext and Wallet state across toolkit sessions. Subsequent sessions restore cached state and only replay new blocks since the checkpoint, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. PR: [#483](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483) | JIRA: [PM-21139](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21139) ### Deregister DUST address command (Toolkit) New `deregister-dust-address` subcommand under `generate-txs` allows users to remove their DUST address mapping, enabling migration to a new address, cleaning up test registrations, or revoking access before rotating wallet keys. PR: [#482](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/482) | JIRA: [PM-20855](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20855) ### Ledger parameters config at genesis (Toolkit) Adds `--ledger-parameters-config` option to `generate-genesis`, allowing custom ledger parameters to be set at genesis instead of using defaults. Config files with default values are available in `res//ledger-parameters-config.json`. PR: [#542](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542) | JIRA: [PM-20852](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20852) ### Features Requiring Configuration Updates - **Prometheus remote write metrics** now include auto-discovered node identification labels (peer_id, node_name, hostname, ip). No additional setup required, but dashboards filtering on metric labels may need updating. ([#554](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554)) ## Improvements - **Parallelize cnight queries** — Improves node sync speed by parallelizing Cardano bridge queries. ([#603](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603) | [PM-21652](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21652)) - **Restore Substrate Trie cache to default values** — Re-enables the Substrate storage trie cache (previously zeroed to work around a since-fixed single-storage-item limitation), improving storage read performance. ([#601](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/601) | [PM-16976](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16976)) - **Improve toolkit error logging** — Fix log flushing on exit and return non-zero exit code on send failure. ([#560](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/560)) - **Remove unused gas cost calculation** — Removes dead code calculating transaction details and gas cost in the runtime. ([#599](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599) | [PM-21711](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21711)) - **Remove explicit redemption contract tracking** — Simplifies cnight-observation by removing redundant redemption queries; standard asset queries already catch redemption UTxOs via policy ID. ([#576](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/576)) - **Update Compact to 0.29.0** in toolkit. ([#736](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/736) | [PM-21765](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765)) - **Switch to AL2023 minimal base images** — Reduces Docker image size. ([#495](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495) | [SRE-1635](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635)) ## Breaking Changes or Required Actions > **:warning: This release includes a runtime upgrade.** Once the runtime upgrade is enacted on-chain, nodes running older versions will no longer be able to produce blocks or sync the chain. All node operators must upgrade to this version BEFORE the runtime upgrade is enacted. - **Overfilled blocks fullness reporting** (Runtime upgrade): Overfilled blocks now correctly report 100% fullness instead of 0%. This fixes fee adjustment calculations going forward. **Toolkit impact:** If historical overfilled blocks exist, the toolkit's replayed ledger state will diverge from on-chain state for blocks before the runtime upgrade. ([#559](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559) | [PM-20839](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20839)) - **Accept duplicate governance members** (Runtime upgrade): The federated authority observation pallet now logs an error but continues processing when duplicate members are detected, instead of rejecting the update entirely. ([#606](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/606) | [PM-20680](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20680)) ## Known Issues ### Memory leak under normal operation (introduced 0.20.0) **Description:** Node memory usage grows over time during normal block production and validation. On preprod, memory increased close to limits over ~6 days of normal operation. An ungraceful OOM termination can trigger [PM-21603](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21603), requiring a PVC wipe to rejoin the network. **Ticket:** [PM-21792](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21792) (mainnet-blocker) **Workaround:** Restart the node periodically (gracefully) to reclaim memory before it reaches limits. ### Increased memory leak during sync (introduced 0.20.0) **Description:** Memory usage grows at an accelerated rate while syncing from genesis. With 16Gi RAM, the node typically crashes ungracefully after ~2 hours. Combined with slow sync speed (~16 blocks/sec), operators must monitor closely. **Ticket:** [PM-21764](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764) **Workaround:** Monitor memory usage during sync and restart the node gracefully before OOM. Ungraceful termination may require wiping storage and restarting sync. ## Fixed Defects | Defect | Summary | Priority | | ------ | ------- | -------- | | [PM-20680](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20680) | Federated authority observation rejects governance updates when duplicate members exist on-chain | — | | [PM-20839](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20839) | Overfilled blocks report 0% fullness instead of 100%, breaking fee adjustment | — | | [PM-21711](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21711) | Unused transaction details and gas cost calculation in runtime | — | | [PM-20404](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20404) | Effects detection in intent returns only last effect, breaking multi-call transactions | — | | [PM-21588](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21588) | Ephemeral env port forwarding connections timing out | — | ## Links and References **PRs:** - [#482](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/482) — Deregister DUST address command - [#483](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483) — Wallet state caching - [#495](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495) — AL2023 minimal base images - [#542](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542) — Ledger parameters config - [#554](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554) — Prometheus node identification labels - [#559](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559) — Fix overfilled blocks fullness - Config files with default values are available in `res//ledger-parameters-config.json`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20852
Added interactive genesis generation tool (#582, PM-20830) (#node) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through three main steps: 1. **Ledger State Generation** - Creates initial ledger state files (genesis_block, genesis_state) using Earthly 2. **Genesis Config Generation** - Generates config files from smart contract addresses on Cardano (cnight-config.json, ics-config.json, federated-authority-config.json, permissioned-candidates-config.json) 3. **Chain Spec Generation** - Creates the final chain specification files using Earthly The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and allows users to selectively run each step. For networks that use cNight genesis (like qanet), it handles the dependency where cnight-config.json must be generated before ledger state generation. Also added: - `--pc-config` CLI argument to `generate-permissioned-candidates-genesis` and `generate-genesis-config` commands to allow reading `security_parameter` from `pc-chain-config.json` when `CARDANO_SECURITY_PARAMETER` env var is not set. - `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand to query db-sync for cNIGHT tokens locked at the ICS (Illiquid Circulation Supply) forever contract and generate `ics-config.json` for treasury funding at genesis. - `--ics-config` argument to `generate-genesis` toolkit command to fund the treasury from ICS observations. - `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate for shared ICS types between node and toolkit. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/582 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20830
Add `deregister-dust-address` command to toolkit (#482, PM-20855) (#toolkit) Adds a new `deregister-dust-address` subcommand under `generate-txs` that allows users to remove their DUST address mapping from the Midnight network. This enables users to: - Migrate to a new DUST address - Clean up test registrations - Revoke access before rotating wallet keys PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/482 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20855
Add wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay (#483, PM-21139) (#toolkit) Implement a wallet state caching mechanism to persist LedgerContext and Wallet state across toolkit sessions. Subsequent sessions restore cached state and only replay new blocks since the checkpoint, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21139
Add transaction validation caching (#608, PM-21592) (#node) Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work. Build to ensure invalid transactions never make it to the block, whilst improving performance of the mempool. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592
### Changed
Accept duplicate members in Federated Authority observation (#606, PM-20680) (#runtime) Previously, the federated authority observation pallet would reject and skip processing when duplicate Midnight members were detected in the Council or Technical Committee. This caused the node to fail to update governance membership when duplicates existed on-chain. Now, the pallet logs an error but continues processing, allowing the node to accept governance updates even when duplicate members are present. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/606 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20680
Fix overfilled blocks report max fullness instead of 0 (#559, PM-20839) (#runtime, #toolkit) Overfilled blocks now report 100% fullness instead of 0%, fixing fee adjustment calculations. **Toolkit:** If historical overfilled blocks exist, the toolkit's replayed ledger state will diverge from on-chain state for blocks before the runtime upgrade. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20839
Fix ephemeral env connection timeouts (#583, PM-21588) Ephemeral env port forwarding connections were timing out. This adds a "watchdog" that reconnects them when disconnected. This requires running the relevant "stop" command for the given environment, so that these are removed once done testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21588
Fix unused transaction details and gas cost calculation (#599, PM-21711) (#performance, #runtime) Removes an unused calculation to calculate transaction details and gas cost. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21711
Add UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks (#716, PM-21823) (#ledger) Provide per-network UTXO ordering override data for qanet, preview, and preprod so that nodes can sync past blocks that were originally produced with non-deterministic UTXO consumption order. Includes tooling to generate the override data from an indexer database. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Improve toolkit error logging when sending transactions (#560) (#toolkit) - Fix issue where toolkit would fail to flush logs on exit, causing logs to get lost - Return exit code non-zero when a send failure occurs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/560
Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#554, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
Parallelize cnight queries (#603, PM-21652) (#client) Try improving node sync speed by parallelizing cnight queries PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21652
Remove explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation (#576) (#cnight-observation) Redemption UTxOs already have the correct stake credentials in their address, so the dedicated redemption queries (which decode datums) are unnecessary. The standard asset_create/asset_spend queries catch redemption UTxOs via their cNIGHT policy ID. Analysing the mainnet data as of 30/01/2025, all of the redemption utxos where the user address has a stake part (>98% of all redemption utxos) also has a stake part == user's stake on the utxo itself. This property is guaranteed by all redemption contracts generated by the Redemption supply contract. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/576
Set Substrate storage Trie cache back to default values (#601, PM-16976) (#client) When we were storing the entire ledger state as a single substrate storage item, we had to set the trie_cache_size to zero to workaround memory usage issues (Substrate was rightly never designed to store lots of data as one storage item). We've since fixed this restriction, so we can set the trie_cache_size back to a sensible value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/601 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16976
Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal (#495, SRE-1635) (#changed, #infra) Use Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base images and align package installs to reduce image size and avoid minimal image conflicts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
Fix effects detection in intent (#573, PM-20404) (#toolkit) `find_effects` method was returning the last found effect ignoring the others. This leads to transactions with multiple contract calls stored in one intent to fail. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/573 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20404
Update Compact to 0.29.0 (#736, PM-21765) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/736 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21765

Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. #node ## Added
Added interactive genesis generation tool (#582, PM-20830) (#node) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through three main steps: 1. **Ledger State Generation** - Creates initial ledger state files (genesis_block, genesis_state) using Earthly 2. **Genesis Config Generation** - Generates config files from smart contract addresses on Cardano (cnight-config.json, ics-config.json, federated-authority-config.json, permissioned-candidates-config.json) 3. **Chain Spec Generation** - Creates the final chain specification files using Earthly The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and allows users to selectively run each step. For networks that use cNight genesis (like qanet), it handles the dependency where cnight-config.json must be generated before ledger state generation. Also added: - `--pc-config` CLI argument to `generate-permissioned-candidates-genesis` and `generate-genesis-config` commands to allow reading `security_parameter` from `pc-chain-config.json` when `CARDANO_SECURITY_PARAMETER` env var is not set. - `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand to query db-sync for cNIGHT tokens locked at the ICS (Illiquid Circulation Supply) forever contract and generate `ics-config.json` for treasury funding at genesis. - `--ics-config` argument to `generate-genesis` toolkit command to fund the treasury from ICS observations. - `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate for shared ICS types between node and toolkit. Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add transaction validation caching (#608, PM-21592) (#node) Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work. Build to ensure invalid transactions never make it to the block, whilst improving performance of the mempool. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592

Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#554, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Until we patch the chain, we need to allow nodes to sync to tip. This change preserves the non-deterministic behaviour of syncing, while ensuring new blocks are produced deterministically. Accept duplicate members in Federated Authority observation (#606, PM-20680) (#runtime) Previously, the federated authority observation pallet would reject and skip processing when duplicate Midnight members were detected in the Council or Technical Committee. This caused the node to fail to update governance membership when duplicates existed on-chain. Now, the pallet logs an error but continues processing, allowing the node to accept governance updates even when duplicate members are present. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21139

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21588

Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615

These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/554 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
Parallelize cnight queries (#603, PM-21652) (#client) Try improving node sync speed by parallelizing cnight queries PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21652
Remove explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation (#576) (#cnight-observation) Redemption UTxOs already have the correct stake credentials in their address, so the dedicated redemption queries (which decode datums) are unnecessary. The standard asset_create/asset_spend queries catch redemption UTxOs via their cNIGHT policy ID. Analysing the mainnet data as of 30/01/2025, all of the redemption utxos where the user address has a stake part (>98% of all redemption utxos) also has a stake part == user's stake on the utxo itself. This property is guaranteed by all redemption contracts generated by the Redemption supply contract. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/576
Set Substrate storage Trie cache back to default values (#601, PM-16976) (#client) When we were storing the entire ledger state as a single substrate storage item, we had to set the trie_cache_size to zero to workaround memory usage issues (Substrate was rightly never designed to store lots of data as one storage item). We've since fixed this restriction, so we can set the trie_cache_size back to a sensible value. body:
# Midnight Node v0.21.0-rc.4 * **Date**: 2026-02-20 * **Environment**: All public networks at time of release. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/next/relnotes/overview). ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.21.0-rc.4 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.21.0-rc.4 ``` ## High-level summary This release introduces transaction validation caching, interactive genesis generation tooling, and UTXO ordering overrides for historical block sync. It also includes several fixes for block fullness reporting, governance membership updates, and toolkit reliability. ## Audience This release note is critical for developers who: - Run a Midnight node on qanet, preview, or preprod. - Use the toolkit for transaction generation or genesis workflows. - Maintain node infrastructure and monitor performance metrics. ## What changed - Added transaction validation caching to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification. - Added interactive genesis generation tool for chain specification creation. - Added wallet state caching to the toolkit, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. - Added `deregister-dust-address` command to the toolkit. - Added ledger parameters config option for genesis generation. - Added UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks on qanet, preview, and preprod. - Fixed overfilled blocks reporting 0% fullness instead of 100%. - Fixed governance membership updates failing when duplicate members exist on-chain. - Fixed effects detection in multi-contract-call intents. - Improved cnight query performance via parallelization. - Improved toolkit error logging and exit codes. - Restored Substrate storage Trie cache to default values for better performance. - Removed unnecessary redundant transaction details and gas cost calculation. - Removed explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation. ## New features ### Transaction validation caching **Description**: Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work. This ensures invalid transactions never make it to the block, whilst improving performance of the mempool. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. ### Interactive genesis generation tool **Description**: Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through ledger state generation, genesis config generation, and chain spec generation, collecting common inputs upfront and allowing users to selectively run each step. Also adds `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand, `--pc-config` and `--ics-config` CLI arguments, and the `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate. ## Improvements **Improvement**: Restored Substrate storage Trie cache defaults **Description**: The trie_cache_size was previously set to zero to workaround memory usage issues when the entire ledger state was stored as a single Substrate storage item. Now that this restriction has been fixed, the trie_cache_size is set back to a sensible default value. --- **Improvement**: UTXO ordering overrides for historical blocks **Description**: Provides per-network UTXO ordering override data for qanet, preview, and preprod so that nodes can sync past blocks that were originally produced with non-deterministic UTXO consumption order. Includes tooling to generate the override data from an indexer database. --- **Improvement**: Parallelized cnight queries **Description**: Improves node sync speed by parallelizing cnight queries to the Cardano mainchain. --- **Improvement**: Removed unused transaction details and gas cost calculation **Description**: Removes an unused calculation for transaction details and gas cost, improving runtime performance. --- **Improvement**: Removed explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation **Description**: Redemption UTxOs already have the correct stake credentials in their address, making the dedicated redemption queries (which decode datums) unnecessary. The standard asset_create/asset_spend queries catch redemption UTxOs via their cNIGHT policy ID. ## Breaking changes ### Overfilled blocks fullness reporting **What changed**: Overfilled blocks now report 100% fullness instead of 0%, fixing fee adjustment calculations. **What breaks**: If historical overfilled blocks exist, the toolkit's replayed ledger state will diverge from on-chain state for blocks before the runtime upgrade. **Required actions**: - Update the toolkit to v0.21.0 to match the new runtime behavior. - Be aware that toolkit replay of blocks prior to the upgrade may diverge if overfilled blocks existed on the network. ## Known issues The following issues are known at the time of release: ### Memory leak under normal operation **Description**: Node memory usage grows over time during normal block production and validation. **Ticket**: [PM-21792](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21792) **Workaround**: Restart the node periodically to reclaim memory. ### Increased memory leak during sync **Description**: Memory usage grows at an accelerated rate while the node is syncing to tip, beyond what is expected from normal operation. **Ticket**: [PM-21764](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764) **Workaround**: Monitor memory usage during sync and restart the node if necessary. ## Links and references - **PRs**: See individual change entries below for PR links. - **Engineering docs**: [Genesis Generation Guide](docs/genesis/README.md) ## Fixed defect list The following defects were fixed in v0.21.0-rc.4. | **Defect number** | **Description** | | --- | --- | | [#559](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559) | Overfilled blocks reported 0% fullness instead of 100% | | [#573](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/573) | `find_effects` returned only the last effect, breaking multi-contract-call intents | | [#583](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583) | Ephemeral environment port forwarding connections timing out | | [#599](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599) | Unused transaction details and gas cost calculation | | [#606](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/606) | Federated Authority observation rejected governance updates with duplicate members | | [#716](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/716) | Nodes unable to sync past historical blocks with non-deterministic UTXO ordering | --- # Full changelog The following is the complete unedited changelog from which these release notes were derived. ## Added
Add ledger parameters config to genesis generation (#542, PM-20852) (#toolkit) Adds `--ledger-parameters-config` option to `generate-genesis` command, allowing custom ledger parameters to be set at genesis instead of using the default `INITIAL_PARAMETERS`. Config files with default values are available in `res//ledger-parameters-config.json`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20852
Added interactive genesis generation tool (#582, PM-20830) (#node) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through three main steps: 1. **Ledger State Generation** - Creates initial ledger state files (genesis_block, genesis_state) using Earthly 2. **Genesis Config Generation** - Generates config files from smart contract addresses on Cardano (cnight-config.json, ics-config.json, federated-authority-config.json, permissioned-candidates-config.json) 3. **Chain Spec Generation** - Creates the final chain specification files using Earthly The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and allows users to selectively run each step. For networks that use cNight genesis (like qanet), it handles the dependency where cnight-config.json must be generated before ledger state generation. Also added: - `--pc-config` CLI argument to `generate-permissioned-candidates-genesis` and `generate-genesis-config` commands to allow reading `security_parameter` from `pc-chain-config.json` when `CARDANO_SECURITY_PARAMETER` env var is not set. - `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand to query db-sync for cNIGHT tokens locked at the ICS (Illiquid Circulation Supply) forever contract and generate `ics-config.json` for treasury funding at genesis. - `--ics-config` argument to `generate-genesis` toolkit command to fund the treasury from ICS observations. - `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate for shared ICS types between node and toolkit. Subsequent sessions restore cached state and only replay new blocks since the checkpoint, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592

name: node-0.20.2
body:
# Midnight Node 0.20.2 * **Date**: 2026-02-19 * **Environment**: All public networks at time of release. For the full compatibility matrix, see the [release notes overview](https://docs.midnight.network/next/relnotes/overview). ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.20.2 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.20.2 ``` ## High-level summary This release fixes a critical non-determinism bug in the chain, adds new networking RPC endpoints for peer reputation inspection and unbanning, fixes a genesis mismatch bug during sync, and resolves an out-of-memory issue caused by unbounded ledger storage cache. ## Audience This release note is critical for developers who: - Run a Midnight node on any public network. - Rely on node RPC endpoints for monitoring or tooling. - Have experienced node OOM crashes or sync issues. - Use the midnight-node-toolkit image. ## What changed - Fixed a critical non-determinism bug caused by HashMap iteration order in unshielded transactions with multiple inputs. - Added non-deterministic sync mode so nodes can sync past affected historical blocks while still producing new blocks deterministically. - Added `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints for peer debugging. - Added unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint for node operators. - Fixed genesis mismatch on sync when client version differs from genesis runtime version. - Fixed unbounded ledger storage cache causing OOM during sync. - Updated Node.js to 22.22.0 in the toolkit image. ## New features ### Peer reputation RPC endpoints **Description**: Two new JSON-RPC endpoints expose peer reputation and ban status, enabling node operators to debug peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status, while `network_peerReputation` returns the same information for a single peer by ID. ### Peer unban RPC endpoint **Description**: A new unsafe RPC endpoint `network_unbanPeer` allows node operators to unban a peer via JSON-RPC. This endpoint is disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set, providing a controlled mechanism for operators to recover peer connections without restarting the node. ## Bug fixes ### Critical non-determinism in unshielded transactions ([#679](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/679)) Unshielded transactions with more than one input were using a HashMap, causing non-deterministic iteration order. With two HashMaps and two entries each, there were 4 possible orderings, meaning nodes would panic approximately 75% of the time when syncing past affected blocks (first observed at block ~634 on preview). Replaced with deterministic ordering to ensure consistent block execution across all nodes. A separate change ([#685](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685)) preserves non-deterministic sync behaviour for these historical blocks while ensuring new blocks are always produced deterministically. ### Genesis mismatch on sync ([#615](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615)) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in `spec_version`, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Both `state_version` and `spec_version` are now resolved from the chainspec WASM blob, preventing mismatches when the node client version differs from the genesis runtime version. ### Unbounded ledger storage cache causing OOM ([#579](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579)) The ledger storage cache was previously unbounded, which could cause out-of-memory crashes during sync and normal operations. The cache size is now set to the default bounded value, significantly reducing memory usage. ## Improvements ### Node.js updated to 22.22.0 The toolkit image now uses Node.js 22.22.0. ## Breaking changes None in this release. ## Known issues The following issues are known at the time of release: ### Memory leak under normal operation **Description**: Node memory usage grows over time during normal block production and validation. **Ticket**: [PM-21792](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21792) **Workaround**: Restart the node periodically to reclaim memory. ### Increased memory leak during sync **Description**: Memory usage grows at an accelerated rate while the node is syncing to tip, beyond what is expected from normal operation. **Ticket**: [PM-21764](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764) **Workaround**: Monitor memory usage during sync and restart the node if necessary. ### Panics during sync and banning nodes **Description**: Nodes may panic during sync and subsequently ban peers, disrupting network connectivity. **Ticket**: [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823) **Workaround**: To be fixed in 0.20.3. Use the `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint to unban affected peers. ## Links and references - **PRs**: - [#679 - Fix critical non-determinism](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/679) - [#649 - Peer reputation RPC endpoints](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649) - [#666 - Unban peer RPC endpoint](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666) - [#615 - Fix genesis mismatch](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615) - [#579 - Fix unbounded ledger storage cache](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579) - [#685 - Non-deterministic sync](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685) - [#629 - Update Node.js](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/629) ## Fixed defect list The following defects were fixed in 0.20.2. | **Defect number** | **Description** | | --- | --- | | [PM-21823](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823) | Critical non-determinism bug in the chain caused by HashMap iteration order in unshielded transactions with more than one input. Replaced with deterministic ordering to ensure consistent block execution across nodes. | | [PM-21720](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720) | Genesis mismatch on sync when node client version differs from genesis runtime version. The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in spec_version instead of the chainspec's WASM runtime version. | | [#579](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579) | Unbounded ledger storage cache causing OOM crashes during sync and normal operations. | --- ## Full change details ### Added
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
### Changed
Fix critical non-determinism in unshielded transactions (PM-21823, #679) (#node, #client) Unshielded transactions with more than one input were using a HashMap, causing non-deterministic iteration order. Replaced with deterministic ordering to ensure consistent block execution across nodes. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/679 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Fix genesis mismatch on sync when node client version != genesis runtime version (PM-21720, #615) (#client) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in midnight_node_runtime::VERSION.spec_version, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Replace resolve_state_version_from_wasm with a local resolve_runtime_version_from_wasm that returns the full RuntimeVersion, so both state_version and spec_version come from the chainspec WASM blob. Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615
Fixes unbounded ledger storage cache size causing OOM on sync (#579) Previously, the ledger storage cache was unbounded. Now, Ledger storage cache size is now set to the default value - we should expect far less memory usage during sync and during normal operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Until we patch the chain, we need to allow nodes to sync to tip. This change preserves the non-deterministic behaviour of syncing, while ensuring new blocks are produced deterministically. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823

body:
Git tag: [node-0.20.3-rc.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.20.3-rc.1) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.20.3-rc.1 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.20.3-rc.1 ```
Big speedup for cNight queries (1000x for mainnet data) (#525, PM-18343, PM-16882) (#cnight-observation, #performance) Optimized PostgreSQL queries in the mainchain follower to use the `idx_block_block_no` index instead of sequential scans. This improves cNight genesis generation performance from 1m25s to 141ms when processing 10 blocks of mainnet data. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/525 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-18343 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16882
Fix contract-compiler docker volume path to be project-local (#497, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the contract-compiler service volume mount default from an external relative path to a project-local path, improving portability across developer environments. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/497 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
## Added
Add Governance upgrade command to ephemeral env (#448, PM-21136) Adds a command to the ephemeral env to upgrade the current environment through governance. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/448 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649

Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add `--no-watch-progress` CLI option (#472, PM-21220) (#toolkit) Adds a `--no-watch-progress` CLI flag to the toolkit to skip waiting for transaction finalization when sending transactions. This can speed up batch sending when finalization confirmation is not needed. Note: Using this option when sending batches may cause transaction errors, as subsequent transactions may be submitted before their dependencies are finalized. The existing `MN_DONT_WATCH_PROGRESS` environment variable is preserved as a fallback. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21220
## Changed
Add block limit params to `update-ledger-parameters` command (#531) (#toolkit) Allows developers to tweak ledger block limits for performance testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/531
Bump Compact.js to 2.4.0-rc.10 (#514, PM-21454) (#toolkit) Update Node Toolkit Compact.js dependencies from 2.4.0-rc.0 to 2.4.0-rc.10. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/514 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21454
Fix governance UTXO query by removing spend check (#529, PM-21534) The query now gets the latest gov utxo before the block num. provided. The previous query checked if that utxo had been spent, including in blocks that are not yet stable, leading to unexpected behaviour and a potential vulnerability. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/529 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21534
Fix Sqlx postgresql ssl connection settings (#528) (#client) Revert to previous known working configuration PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/528
Fix genesis mismatch on sync when node client version != genesis runtime version (PM-21720, #615) (#client) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in midnight_node_runtime::VERSION.spec_version, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Replace resolve_state_version_from_wasm with a local resolve_runtime_version_from_wasm that returns the full RuntimeVersion, so both state_version and spec_version come from the chainspec WASM blob. Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615
Fix ledger root-hash mismatch on system transactions (#515, PM-21484, PM-21483) (#toolkit) Fixes regression introduced in 6644fce causing the toolkit to apply system transactions out-of-order. **Note:** Fetch caches will have to be removed if this bug was encountered (i.e. delete `toolkit.db`) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/515 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21484 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21483
Fixes unbounded ledger storage cache size causing OOM on sync (#579) Previously, the ledger storage cache was unbounded. Now, Ledger storage cache size is now set to the default value - we should expect far less memory usage during sync and during normal operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-paramaters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
Bump ledger to `7.0.0-rc.2` (PM-21558, #540) Fixes a blocking non-determinism bug: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21558 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/540
Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/566 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
Use sibling directory for midnight-reserve-contracts path (#510, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the MIDNIGHT_RESERVE_CONTRACTS_PATH environment variable to reference the contracts repository as a sibling directory rather than a child directory. This aligns with typical developer workspace layouts and matches the CI configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/510 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
Point bug report location to GitHub (#329, PM-11968) (#runtime, #audit) Tell people the right place to raise an issue. Ticket is an example of how it used to look. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/329 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11968
Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal (#495, SRE-1635) (#changed, #infra) Use Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base images and align package installs to reduce image size and avoid minimal image conflicts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
Update qanet and govnet chain configs (#490, SRE-1653) Updates chain-spec and configuration files for qanet and govnet environments with newly generated chain configs. Removes deprecated governancetesting directory (renamed to govnet). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/490 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1653
Updates nodejs to 22.22.0 (#629) (#toolkit) Updates nodejs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/629
Fix multiple `--dest-url` not respecting `--rate` correctly (#472, PM-21231) (#toolkit) When using multiple `--dest-url` arguments, the toolkit would send to each destination at `--rate`. It should instead send the txs at `--rate`, but each tx sent should go to a different `--dest-url` (cycling through the list) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21231
Fix hang when using multiple destination URLs (#472) (#toolkit) Fixes an issue where the toolkit would hang indefinitely when using multiple `--dest-url` arguments. The hang occurred because tx progress subscriptions were being dropped before finalization was complete, causing the async tasks to never resolve. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472

PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
#local-environment
Fix contract-compiler docker volume path to be project-local (#497, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the contract-compiler service volume mount default from an external relative path to a project-local path, improving portability across developer environments. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/497 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
## Changed
Use sibling directory for midnight-reserve-contracts path (#510, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the MIDNIGHT_RESERVE_CONTRACTS_PATH environment variable to reference the contracts repository as a sibling directory rather than a child directory. This aligns with typical developer workspace layouts and matches the CI configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/510 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
#networking ## Added
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
#node ## Added
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
## Changed
Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/566 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
#performance
Big speedup for cNight queries (1000x for mainnet data) (#525, PM-18343, PM-16882) (#cnight-observation, #performance) Optimized PostgreSQL queries in the mainchain follower to use the `idx_block_block_no` index instead of sequential scans. This improves cNight genesis generation performance from 1m25s to 141ms when processing 10 blocks of mainnet data. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/525 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-18343 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16882
#rpc ## Added
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649

Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
#runtime ## Changed
Point bug report location to GitHub (#329, PM-11968) (#runtime, #audit) Tell people the right place to raise an issue. Ticket is an example of how it used to look. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/329 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11968
#toolkit ## Added
Add `--no-watch-progress` CLI option (#472, PM-21220) (#toolkit) Adds a `--no-watch-progress` CLI flag to the toolkit to skip waiting for transaction finalization when sending transactions. This can speed up batch sending when finalization confirmation is not needed. Note: Using this option when sending batches may cause transaction errors, as subsequent transactions may be submitted before their dependencies are finalized. The existing `MN_DONT_WATCH_PROGRESS` environment variable is preserved as a fallback. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21220
## Changed
Add block limit params to `update-ledger-parameters` command (#531) (#toolkit) Allows developers to tweak ledger block limits for performance testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/531
Bump Compact.js to 2.4.0-rc.10 (#514, PM-21454) (#toolkit) Update Node Toolkit Compact.js dependencies from 2.4.0-rc.0 to 2.4.0-rc.10. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/514 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21454
Fix ledger root-hash mismatch on system transactions (#515, PM-21484, PM-21483) (#toolkit) Fixes regression introduced in 6644fce causing the toolkit to apply system transactions out-of-order. **Note:** Fetch caches will have to be removed if this bug was encountered (i.e. delete `toolkit.db`) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/515 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21484 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21483
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-paramaters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
Updates nodejs to 22.22.0 (#629) (#toolkit) Updates nodejs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/629
Fix multiple `--dest-url` not respecting `--rate` correctly (#472, PM-21231) (#toolkit) When using multiple `--dest-url` arguments, the toolkit would send to each destination at `--rate`. It should instead send the txs at `--rate`, but each tx sent should go to a different `--dest-url` (cycling through the list) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21231
Fix hang when using multiple destination URLs (#472) (#toolkit) Fixes an issue where the toolkit would hang indefinitely when using multiple `--dest-url` arguments. The hang occurred because tx progress subscriptions were being dropped before finalization was complete, causing the async tasks to never resolve. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472
