Removes deprecated governancetesting directory (renamed to govnet). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/490 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1653
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Until we patch the chain, we need to allow nodes to sync to tip. Fix ledger root-hash mismatch on system transactions (#515, PM-21484, PM-21483) (#toolkit) Fixes regression introduced in 6644fce causing the toolkit to apply system transactions out-of-order. **Note:** Fetch caches will have to be removed if this bug was encountered (i.e. delete `toolkit.db`) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/515 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21484 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21483
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-paramaters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
Updates nodejs to 22.22.0 (#629) (#toolkit) Updates nodejs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/629
Fix multiple `--dest-url` not respecting `--rate` correctly (#472, PM-21231) (#toolkit) When using multiple `--dest-url` arguments, the toolkit would send to each destination at `--rate`. It should instead send the txs at `--rate`, but each tx sent should go to a different `--dest-url` (cycling through the list) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21231
Fix hang when using multiple destination URLs (#472) (#toolkit) Fixes an issue where the toolkit would hang indefinitely when using multiple `--dest-url` arguments. The hang occurred because tx progress subscriptions were being dropped before finalization was complete, causing the async tasks to never resolve. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472

name: node-0.22.0-rc.2
body:
Git tag: [node-0.22.0-rc.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.2) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.2 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.2 ``` ## Added
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
## Changed
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.2 (#658, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Until we patch the chain, we need to allow nodes to sync to tip. This change preserves the non-deterministic behaviour of syncing, while ensuring new blocks are produced deterministically. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823

Also tuned the limits of the two caches. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787

Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831

name: node-0.20.2-rc.3.1
body:

Big speedup for cNight queries (1000x for mainnet data) (#525, PM-18343, PM-16882) (#cnight-observation, #performance) Optimized PostgreSQL queries in the mainchain follower to use the `idx_block_block_no` index instead of sequential scans. This improves cNight genesis generation performance from 1m25s to 141ms when processing 10 blocks of mainnet data. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/525 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-18343 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16882
Fix contract-compiler docker volume path to be project-local (#497, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the contract-compiler service volume mount default from an external relative path to a project-local path, improving portability across developer environments. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/497 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
## Added
Add Governance upgrade command to ephemeral env (#448, PM-21136) Adds a command to the ephemeral env to upgrade the current environment through governance. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/448 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
Add `network_peerReputations` and `network_peerReputation` RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add unsafe `network_unbanPeer` RPC endpoint (#666, PM-21896) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Allows a node operator to unban a peer. Disabled for non-local requests unless `--unsafe-rpc-external` is set. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/666 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21896
Add `--no-watch-progress` CLI option (#472, PM-21220) (#toolkit) Adds a `--no-watch-progress` CLI flag to the toolkit to skip waiting for transaction finalization when sending transactions. This can speed up batch sending when finalization confirmation is not needed. Note: Using this option when sending batches may cause transaction errors, as subsequent transactions may be submitted before their dependencies are finalized. The existing `MN_DONT_WATCH_PROGRESS` environment variable is preserved as a fallback. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21220
## Changed
Add block limit params to `update-ledger-parameters` command (#531) (#toolkit) Allows developers to tweak ledger block limits for performance testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/531
Bump Compact.js to 2.4.0-rc.10 (#514, PM-21454) (#toolkit) Update Node Toolkit Compact.js dependencies from 2.4.0-rc.0 to 2.4.0-rc.10. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/514 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21454
Fix governance UTXO query by removing spend check (#529, PM-21534) The query now gets the latest gov utxo before the block num. provided. The previous query checked if that utxo had been spent, including in blocks that are not yet stable, leading to unexpected behaviour and a potential vulnerability. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/529 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21534
Fix Sqlx postgresql ssl connection settings (#528) (#client) Revert to previous known working configuration PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/528
Fix genesis mismatch on sync when node client version != genesis runtime version (PM-21720, #615) (#client) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in midnight_node_runtime::VERSION.spec_version, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Replace resolve_state_version_from_wasm with a local resolve_runtime_version_from_wasm that returns the full RuntimeVersion, so both state_version and spec_version come from the chainspec WASM blob. Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615
Fix ledger root-hash mismatch on system transactions (#515, PM-21484, PM-21483) (#toolkit) Fixes regression introduced in 6644fce causing the toolkit to apply system transactions out-of-order. **Note:** Fetch caches will have to be removed if this bug was encountered (i.e. delete `toolkit.db`) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/515 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21484 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21483
Fixes unbounded ledger storage cache size causing OOM on sync (#579) Previously, the ledger storage cache was unbounded. Now, Ledger storage cache size is now set to the default value - we should expect far less memory usage during sync and during normal operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-paramaters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
Bump ledger to `7.0.0-rc.2` (PM-21558, #540) Fixes a blocking non-determinism bug: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21558 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/540
Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/566 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
Use sibling directory for midnight-reserve-contracts path (#510, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the MIDNIGHT_RESERVE_CONTRACTS_PATH environment variable to reference the contracts repository as a sibling directory rather than a child directory. This aligns with typical developer workspace layouts and matches the CI configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/510 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
Point bug report location to GitHub (#329, PM-11968) (#runtime, #audit) Tell people the right place to raise an issue. Ticket is an example of how it used to look. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/329 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11968
Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal (#495, SRE-1635) (#changed, #infra) Use Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base images and align package installs to reduce image size and avoid minimal image conflicts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
Update qanet and govnet chain configs (#490, SRE-1653) Updates chain-spec and configuration files for qanet and govnet environments with newly generated chain configs. Removes deprecated governancetesting directory (renamed to govnet). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/490 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1653
Sync with non-determinism, produce blocks with determinism (#685, PM-21823) (#node, #client) Until we patch the chain, we need to allow nodes to sync to tip. This change preserves the non-deterministic behaviour of syncing, while ensuring new blocks are produced deterministically. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/685 Related ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21823
Updates nodejs to 22.22.0 (#629) (#toolkit) Updates nodejs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/629
Fix multiple `--dest-url` not respecting `--rate` correctly (#472, PM-21231) (#toolkit) When using multiple `--dest-url` arguments, the toolkit would send to each destination at `--rate`. It should instead send the txs at `--rate`, but each tx sent should go to a different `--dest-url` (cycling through the list) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21231
Fix hang when using multiple destination URLs (#472) (#toolkit) Fixes an issue where the toolkit would hang indefinitely when using multiple `--dest-url` arguments. The hang occurred because tx progress subscriptions were being dropped before finalization was complete, causing the async tasks to never resolve. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472

body:
# Midnight Node 0.22.0-rc.1 Release Notes **Git Tag:** [node-0.22.0-rc.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.22.0-rc.1) **Ledger Version:** [8.0.0-rc.2](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/releases/tag/ledger-8.0.0-rc.2) ## Docker Images ```bash docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.22.0-rc.1 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.22.0-rc.1 ``` ## Highlights Node 0.22.0 builds on 0.21.x with genesis tooling, stability fixes, and a new Ledger version. **Key Headlines:** - Genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch - Governance system transaction gating - only ledger parameter updates permitted - Peer reputation RPC endpoints for network debugging - Reserve contract observation for genesis locked_pool initialization - Memory management improvements (ledger storage GC, cache TTI) - Ledger 8.0.0-rc.2 upgrade --- ## Node Changes ### New Features
Genesis verification tool (#654, PM-20831) (#node, #genesis, #tooling) Added a comprehensive genesis verification tool for validating chain specifications before network launch. ## New CLI Commands ### Genesis Verification - `verify-ledger-state-genesis` - Verifies genesis state from chain-spec-raw.json (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - `verify-cardano-tip-finalized` - Verifies a Cardano block has enough confirmations based on security_parameter - `verify-auth-script` - Verifies all upgradable contracts use the expected authorization script - `verify-federated-authority-auth-script` - Verifies federated authority contract auth scripts - `verify-ics-auth-script` - Verifies ICS validator contract auth scripts - `verify-permissioned-candidates-auth-script` - Verifies permissioned candidates contract auth scripts ## Interactive Verification Script New interactive script `scripts/genesis/genesis-verification.sh` that performs 5 verification steps: - Step 0: Cardano tip finalization check - Step 1: Config file regeneration and comparison - Step 2: LedgerState verification (DustState, supply invariant, parameters) - Step 3: Dparameter verification - Step 4: Authorization script verification for upgradable contracts ## Additional Changes - Both genesis scripts now prefill the Cardano tip prompt from `res//cardano-tip.json` if available - Reorganized genesis code into `node/src/genesis/creation/` and `node/src/genesis/verification/` modules - Added comprehensive documentation in `docs/genesis/verification.md` PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/654 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20831
Add governance system transaction gating (#658, PM-21785) (#node, #runtime, #ledger) Governance (federated-authority pallet) can currently dispatch any system transaction via `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction`. This change adds a new ledger runtime interface method that checks whether a given system transaction is allowed for governance execution — only `OverwriteParameters` (i.e. ledger parameter updates) is permitted. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
Add network_peerReputations and network_peerReputation RPC endpoints (PM-21710, #649) (#client, #node, #rpc, #networking) Exposes peer reputation and ban status via JSON-RPC, enabling debugging of peer connectivity issues without custom tooling. - `network_peerReputations` returns all connected peers enriched with reputation score and ban status - `network_peerReputation` returns the same info for a single peer by ID Can help in diagnosing issues related to peer-banning e.g: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21710 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/649
Add reserve contract observation and use result to initialize genesis (#658, PM-21785) (#client, #node, #runtime, #ledger) Genesis generation now uses `LedgerState::with_genesis_settings()` to set `locked_pool` from the reserve config, representing cNIGHT circulating on Cardano. The remaining supply is allocated to `reserve_pool`. When no reserve config is provided, behaviour is unchanged (locked_pool=0, reserve_pool=MAX_SUPPLY). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/658 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21785
### Performance Improvements
Call gc() after flushing ledger storage to reclaim arena memory (#657, PM-21764) (#node, #ledger, #client) During block sync, post_block_update materializes trie nodes that accumulate in the arena and are never freed, causing linear heap growth. Adding backend.gc() after flush_all_changes_to_db() allows the arena to reclaim unreachable nodes each block, reducing the memory leak rate by ~50% and changing heap behavior from unbounded linear growth to active reclamation. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/657 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21764
Add TimeToIdle for transaction validation cache (#659, PM-21787) (#client, #node, #performance) Added a Time-To-Idle for the transaction validation cache to prevent entries lingering in the cache indefinitely. Also tuned the limits of the two caches. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/659 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21787
### Bug Fixes
Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. This works as long as the block does not rollback - in the case of a rollback, substrate would restore the storage root at the time before migration, but would not reverse the ledger storage de-init & init calls - this would put the nodes into a broken state, fixed by a restart. This change move the ledger storage (re)initialization to the beginning of each block - and runs it only if the initialized ledger storage version != the requested one. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/586 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21682

Update Ledger version to 8.0.0-rc.1 (#636, PM-21769) (#client, #runtime, #ledger) Changelog for Ledger: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-8.0.0-rc.1/CHANGELOG.md#800 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/636 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21769

Fix storage initialization in the case of a rollback (#586, PM-21682) (#ledger, #hardfork) Before, our storage de-init & init is performed during storage migration when updating to a new ledger version. name: node-0.21.0-rc.2
body:
## What's Changed in RC.2: * [Backport][Genesis] Feat: add `mainnet` and adjust `preprod` & `preview` (#631) by @NachoPal in https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/648 ## Docker Images ```bash docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.21.0-rc.2 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.21.0-rc.2 ``` ## What's Changed in RC.1: ## Highlights Node 0.21.0 builds on 0.20.x with performance improvements, stability fixes, and new toolkit capabilities. **Key Headlines:** - Transaction validation caching for improved mempool performance - Interactive genesis generation tool - Wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay in the toolkit - Multiple node sync and memory usage improvements - DUST address deregistration support --- ## Node Changes ### New Features
Added interactive genesis generation tool (#582, PM-20830) (#node) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through three main steps: 1. **Ledger State Generation** - Creates initial ledger state files (genesis_block, genesis_state) using Earthly 2. **Genesis Config Generation** - Generates config files from smart contract addresses on Cardano (cnight-config.json, ics-config.json, federated-authority-config.json, permissioned-candidates-config.json) 3. **Chain Spec Generation** - Creates the final chain specification files using Earthly The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and allows users to selectively run each step. For networks that use cNight genesis (like qanet), it handles the dependency where cnight-config.json must be generated before ledger state generation. Also added: - `--pc-config` CLI argument to `generate-permissioned-candidates-genesis` and `generate-genesis-config` commands to allow reading `security_parameter` from `pc-chain-config.json` when `CARDANO_SECURITY_PARAMETER` env var is not set. - `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand to query db-sync for cNIGHT tokens locked at the ICS (Illiquid Circulation Supply) forever contract and generate `ics-config.json` for treasury funding at genesis. - `--ics-config` argument to `generate-genesis` toolkit command to fund the treasury from ICS observations. - `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate for shared ICS types between node and toolkit. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/582 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20830
Add transaction validation caching (#608, PM-21592) (#node) Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work. Build to ensure invalid transactions never make it to the block, whilst improving performance of the mempool. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592
### Performance Improvements
Parallelize cnight queries (#603, PM-21652) (#client) Try improving node sync speed by parallelizing cnight queries PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21652
Fix unused transaction details and gas cost calculation (#599, PM-21711) (#performance, #runtime) Removes an unused calculation to calculate transaction details and gas cost. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21711
Set Substrate storage Trie cache back to default values (#601, PM-16976) (#client) When we were storing the entire ledger state as a single substrate storage item, we had to set the trie_cache_size to zero to workaround memory usage issues (Substrate was rightly never designed to store lots of data as one storage item). We've since fixed this restriction, so we can set the trie_cache_size back to a sensible value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/601 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16976
### Bug Fixes
Accept duplicate members in Federated Authority observation (#606, PM-20680) (#runtime) Previously, the federated authority observation pallet would reject and skip processing when duplicate Midnight members were detected in the Council or Technical Committee. This caused the node to fail to update governance membership when duplicates existed on-chain. Now, the pallet logs an error but continues processing, allowing the node to accept governance updates even when duplicate members are present. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/606 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20680?focusedCommentId=58225
Fix overfilled blocks report max fullness instead of 0 (#559, PM-20839) (#runtime, #toolkit) Overfilled blocks now report 100% fullness instead of 0%, fixing fee adjustment calculations. **Toolkit:** If historical overfilled blocks exist, the toolkit's replayed ledger state will diverge from on-chain state for blocks before the runtime upgrade. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20839
Fix genesis mismatch on sync when node client version != genesis runtime version (PM-21720, #615) (#client) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in midnight_node_runtime::VERSION.spec_version, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Replace resolve_state_version_from_wasm with a local resolve_runtime_version_from_wasm that returns the full RuntimeVersion, so both state_version and spec_version come from the chainspec WASM blob. Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615
Fixes unbounded ledger storage cache size causing OOM on sync (#579) Previously, the ledger storage cache was unbounded. Now, Ledger storage cache size is now set to the default value - we should expect far less memory usage during sync and during normal operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579
Remove explicit redemption contract tracking from cnight-observation (#576) (#cnight-observation) Redemption UTxOs already have the correct stake credentials in their address, so the dedicated redemption queries (which decode datums) are unnecessary. The standard asset_create/asset_spend queries catch redemption UTxOs via their cNIGHT policy ID. Analysing the mainnet data as of 30/01/2025, all of the redemption utxos where the user address has a stake part (>98% of all redemption utxos) also has a stake part == user's stake on the utxo itself. This property is guaranteed by all redemption contracts generated by the Redemption supply contract. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/576
--- ## Toolkit Changes ### New Features
Add ledger parameters config to genesis generation (#542, PM-20852) (#toolkit) Adds `--ledger-parameters-config` option to `generate-genesis` command, allowing custom ledger parameters to be set at genesis instead of using the default `INITIAL_PARAMETERS`. Config files with default values are available in `res//ledger-parameters-config.json`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/542 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20852
Add `deregister-dust-address` command to toolkit (#482, PM-20855) (#toolkit) Adds a new `deregister-dust-address` subcommand under `generate-txs` that allows users to remove their DUST address mapping from the Midnight network. This enables users to: - Migrate to a new DUST address - Clean up test registrations - Revoke access before rotating wallet keys PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/482 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20855
Add wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay (#483, PM-21139) (#toolkit) Implement a wallet state caching mechanism to persist LedgerContext and Wallet state across toolkit sessions. Subsequent sessions restore cached state and only replay new blocks since the checkpoint, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21139
### Bug Fixes
Improve toolkit error logging when sending transactions (#560) (#toolkit) - Fix issue where toolkit would fail to flush logs on exit, causing logs to get lost - Return exit code non-zero when a send failure occurs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/560
Fix effects detection in intent (#573, PM-20404) (#toolkit) `find_effects` method was returning the last found effect ignoring the others. This leads to transactions with multiple contract calls stored in one intent to fail. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/573 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20404
--- ## Other Changes
Fix ephemeral env connection timeouts (#583, PM-21588) Ephemeral env port forwarding connections were timing out. This adds a "watchdog" that reconnects them when disconnected. This requires running the relevant "stop" command for the given environment, so that these are removed once done testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21588

# Midnight Node 0.21.0-rc.1 Release Notes **Release Date:** February 6, 2026 **Git Tag:** [node-0.21.0-rc.1](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.21.0-rc.1) **Based on:** [Partner Chains v1.8.1](https://github.com/input-output-hk/partner-chains/releases/tag/v1.8.1) **Ledger Version:** [7.0.0](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-7.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) ## Docker Images ```bash docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.21.0-rc.1 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.21.0-rc.1 ``` ## Highlights Node 0.21.0 builds on 0.20.x with performance improvements, stability fixes, and new toolkit capabilities. **Key Headlines:** - Transaction validation caching for improved mempool performance - Interactive genesis generation tool - Wallet state caching to eliminate genesis replay in the toolkit - Multiple node sync and memory usage improvements - DUST address deregistration support --- ## Node Changes ### New Features
Added interactive genesis generation tool (#582, PM-20830) (#node) Added `scripts/genesis/genesis-generation.sh`, an interactive shell script that guides users through the chain specification generation process. The tool walks through three main steps: 1. **Ledger State Generation** - Creates initial ledger state files (genesis_block, genesis_state) using Earthly 2. **Genesis Config Generation** - Generates config files from smart contract addresses on Cardano (cnight-config.json, ics-config.json, federated-authority-config.json, permissioned-candidates-config.json) 3. **Chain Spec Generation** - Creates the final chain specification files using Earthly The tool collects common inputs upfront (DB connection string, Cardano tip, RNG seed) and allows users to selectively run each step. For networks that use cNight genesis (like qanet), it handles the dependency where cnight-config.json must be generated before ledger state generation. Also added: - `--pc-config` CLI argument to `generate-permissioned-candidates-genesis` and `generate-genesis-config` commands to allow reading `security_parameter` from `pc-chain-config.json` when `CARDANO_SECURITY_PARAMETER` env var is not set. - `generate-ics-genesis` subcommand to query db-sync for cNIGHT tokens locked at the ICS (Illiquid Circulation Supply) forever contract and generate `ics-config.json` for treasury funding at genesis. - `--ics-config` argument to `generate-genesis` toolkit command to fund the treasury from ICS observations. - `midnight-primitives-ics-observation` crate for shared ICS types between node and toolkit. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/582 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20830
Add transaction validation caching (#608, PM-21592) (#node) Introduces a two-tier caching mechanism for transaction validation to eliminate redundant cryptographic verification work. Build to ensure invalid transactions never make it to the block, whilst improving performance of the mempool. Includes Prometheus metrics (`midnight_ledger_tx_*_cache_hits/misses`) and debug logging for monitoring cache effectiveness. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/608 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21592
### Performance Improvements
Parallelize cnight queries (#603, PM-21652) (#client) Try improving node sync speed by parallelizing cnight queries PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/603 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21652
Fix unused transaction details and gas cost calculation (#599, PM-21711) (#performance, #runtime) Removes an unused calculation to calculate transaction details and gas cost. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/599 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21711
Set Substrate storage Trie cache back to default values (#601, PM-16976) (#client) When we were storing the entire ledger state as a single substrate storage item, we had to set the trie_cache_size to zero to workaround memory usage issues (Substrate was rightly never designed to store lots of data as one storage item). We've since fixed this restriction, so we can set the trie_cache_size back to a sensible value. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/601 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16976
### Bug Fixes
Accept duplicate members in Federated Authority observation (#606, PM-20680) (#runtime) Previously, the federated authority observation pallet would reject and skip processing when duplicate Midnight members were detected in the Council or Technical Committee. This caused the node to fail to update governance membership when duplicates existed on-chain. Now, the pallet logs an error but continues processing, allowing the node to accept governance updates even when duplicate members are present. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/559 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20839
Fix genesis mismatch on sync when node client version != genesis runtime version (PM-21720, #615) (#client) The genesis block version digest was using the compiled-in midnight_node_runtime::VERSION.spec_version, which could differ from the chainspec's WASM runtime. Replace resolve_state_version_from_wasm with a local resolve_runtime_version_from_wasm that returns the full RuntimeVersion, so both state_version and spec_version come from the chainspec WASM blob. Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21720 PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/615
Fixes unbounded ledger storage cache size causing OOM on sync (#579) Previously, the ledger storage cache was unbounded. Now, Ledger storage cache size is now set to the default value - we should expect far less memory usage during sync and during normal operations. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/579

The standard asset_create/asset_spend queries catch redemption UTxOs via their cNIGHT policy ID. Analysing the mainnet data as of 30/01/2025, all of the redemption utxos where the user address has a stake part (>98% of all redemption utxos) also has a stake part == user's stake on the utxo itself. Subsequent sessions restore cached state and only replay new blocks since the checkpoint, dramatically improving startup time on long-running networks. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/483 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21139
### Bug Fixes
Improve toolkit error logging when sending transactions (#560) (#toolkit) - Fix issue where toolkit would fail to flush logs on exit, causing logs to get lost - Return exit code non-zero when a send failure occurs PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/560
Fix effects detection in intent (#573, PM-20404) (#toolkit) `find_effects` method was returning the last found effect ignoring the others. This leads to transactions with multiple contract calls stored in one intent to fail. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/573 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20404
--- ## Other Changes
Fix ephemeral env connection timeouts (#583, PM-21588) Ephemeral env port forwarding connections were timing out. This adds a "watchdog" that reconnects them when disconnected. This requires running the relevant "stop" command for the given environment, so that these are removed once done testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/583 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21588

Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/566 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
--- ## Toolkit Changes ### Bug Fixes
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-parameters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
--- ## Infrastructure Changes
Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal (#495, SRE-1635) (#infra) Use Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base images and align package installs to reduce image size and avoid minimal image conflicts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
--- ## Infrastructure & Dependencies | Component | Version | |-----------|---------| | Partner Chains SDK | v1.8.1 | | Midnight Ledger | 7.0.0 | | Compact.js | 2.4.0-rc.10 | --- ## Links - [GitHub Release](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.20.1-rc.1) - [Previous Release (0.20.0)](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.20.0) --- # Tagged Changes
#infra ## Changed
Switch node/toolkit images to AL2023 minimal (#495, SRE-1635) (#infra) Use Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base images and align package installs to reduce image size and avoid minimal image conflicts. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/495 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1635
#node ## Added
Add node identification labels to Prometheus remote write metrics (#566, PM-21604) (#node) Add labels to pushed metrics that uniquely identify each node: peer_id, node_name, hostname, and ip. These labels are auto-discovered from the node's configuration and network identity, requiring no additional setup. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/566 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21604
#toolkit ## Fixed
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-parameters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541

# Midnight Node 0.20.0 Release Notes **Release Date:** January 28, 2026 **Git Tag:** [node-0.20.0](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.20.0) **Based on:** [Partner Chains v1.8.1](https://github.com/input-output-hk/partner-chains/releases/tag/v1.8.1) **Ledger Version:** [7.0.0](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-7.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) ## Docker Images ```bash docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.20.0 docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.20.0 ``` ## Highlights Node 0.20.0 is a major release that delivers governance decentralization, security hardening, and significant performance improvements. This release includes **stability guarantees** - upgrade paths that do not require chain resets. **Key Headlines:** - Removal of sudo privileges from the runtime (decentralization milestone) - Migration to Aiken-based governance smart contracts - Midnight SRS - New independent cryptographic foundation with midnight-zk 1.0 - *Least Authority* ledger audit complete - All 16 findings resolved - 1000x performance improvement for cNIGHT mainchain queries - Full DUST token generation from cNIGHT integration - Wallet transaction history API for shielded transactions **Note:** A separate node audit (44 issues) is pending verification review. --- ## Breaking Changes ### Runtime
Remove pallet_sudo and add root-call toolkit command (#455, PM-9164) (#runtime, #toolkit) Removes `pallet_sudo` from the runtime and adds a new `root-call` command to the toolkit that executes calls with Root origin through the federated authority governance mechanism (Council + Technical Committee approval). Now no single key has root power over a network. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/455 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-9164
Migrate to Aiken-based Permissioned Candidates Contracts (#454, PM-20994) (#node, #breaking) All Midnight contracts are now Aiken-based instead of a mixture of Aiken and Plutus. **Policy ID Updates:** - node-dev-01: `51f812332ccc276d1dfa9da923c2235b91a5150ff275b633a5fa1bdb` - qanet: `6c327f1fe5e3b2619c62ca642892146c7326a91dc47f6006f6cdf690` - preview: `4057188de00d74c6679263989745309f02bf55f8806061943124489b` - preprod: `369ee95be4c68a2984733a8c727ecd28df3039a3e5f1e80290b08eec` **Breaking Change**: Nodes must use the updated policy IDs to correctly read permissioned candidates from Cardano. The Aiken contracts use a different data format: - `sidechainPublicKey`: hex string - `keys`: object with `aura` and `gran` keys - `isValid`: boolean PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/454 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20994
Reduce block size limit to 1 MB (#477, PM-20476) (#node) Reduces the maximum block length from 5 MB to a more conservative 1 MB to improve network stability and block propagation times. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/477 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20476
### API
D Parameter RPC endpoint and pallet-midnight call index update (#378, PM-20993) 1. **New RPC endpoint:** `systemParameters_getAriadneParameters` returns permissioned candidates from Cardano with D Parameter sourced from on-chain `pallet-system-parameters` storage. 2. **RPC deprecation:** `sidechain_getAriadneParameters` is deprecated (still functional). Integrators should migrate to the new endpoint. 3. **pallet-midnight update:** Renumbered `set_tx_size_weight` from `call_index(2)` to `call_index(1)`. **Breaking change:** Pre-encoded transactions referencing `call_index(2)` for `set_tx_size_weight` will fail. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/378 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20993
### Ledger (7.0.0) See the detailed **Ledger 7.0.0** section below. Key breaking changes: - **New SRS**: Switch from Filecoin SRS to Midnight SRS - all proofs use new parameters - **midnight-zk 1.0**: New proving library with breaking proof-system changes - **Treasury disabled**: System transactions cannot access treasury until governance is ready - **Domain separators**: Improved domain separation across cryptographic operations (audit fix) --- ## New Features ### Governance System Overhaul
Add System Parameters pallet (#387, PM-20991) (#runtime, #client) Adds the system parameters pallet for managing on-chain governance parameters. Stores Terms and Conditions (hash + URL) and D-Parameter values, initialized at genesis from JSON config files. Provides extrinsics to update values with Root origin, runtime APIs, and RPC endpoints for querying current values. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/387 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20991
Improved Federated Authority Observation inherent (#441, PM-20680) (#runtime, #governance) Improve the `pallet_federated_authority_observation` inherent mechanism by: - Rejecting duplicated Midnight (sr25519) members. This was a security issue, as duplicated members cannot vote multiple times. Having too many duplicated members could potentially make it impossible to reach the required authority body motion thresholds. - Fixing the `check_inherent` function to verify that the queried members match those set in the inherent `call`. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/441 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20680
Add Governance upgrade command to ephemeral env (#448, PM-21136) Adds a command to the ephemeral env to upgrade the current environment through governance. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/448 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21136
### Node Infrastructure
Add Prometheus Remote Write support (#436, SRE-1623) (#node) Adds the ability to push metrics via Prometheus Remote Write protocol for environments where pull-based scraping is not feasible. Supports Thanos Receive, Cortex, Mimir, and other remote write compatible endpoints. New environment variables: - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_ENDPOINT` - Remote write URL (e.g., https://thanos.example.com/api/v1/receive) - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_INTERVAL_SECS` - Push interval in seconds (default: 15) - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_JOB_NAME` - Job name label (default: midnight-node) Uses protobuf encoding with snappy compression as per the Prometheus Remote Write specification. Requires `--prometheus-port` to be enabled for metrics collection. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/436 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1623
Add configuration guide documentation (#445) (#docs) Adds a comprehensive configuration guide for SREs covering: - Configuration sources and precedence - Environment variable naming conventions - Chainspec formats (raw vs non-raw) - Validator key configuration - Troubleshooting common issues PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/445
### Ledger Changes
Bump ledger to 7.0.0 (#540, PM-21558, PM-21185) Updated midnight-ledger to version 7.0.0 which includes stability guarantees and fixes a blocking non-determinism bug. PRs: - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/540 - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/461 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21558 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21185
Remove block reward coin minting functionality (#451, PM-21159) (#ledger) Removed the `mint_coins` functionality from the ledger bridge API and the midnight pallet's block reward minting logic. This will later be reworked as no NIGHT is being minted when block rewards are paid out. Changes include: - Removed `mint_coins` method from `LedgerBridge` trait - Removed block reward minting logic from midnight pallet's `on_finalize` hook PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/451 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21159
--- ## Security Improvements ### Runtime Security
Prevent DDoS via feeless blockspace consumption (#367, PM-20944) (#runtime, #security) Add pre-dispatch validation to reject transactions whose guaranteed part would fail before they are included in blocks. This prevents a DDoS attack vector where attackers could fill blocks with transactions that fail the guaranteed phase (before fees are extracted), consuming blockspace without paying fees. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/367 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20944
Fix governance UTXO query by removing spend check (#529, PM-21534) The query now gets the latest gov utxo before the block num. provided. The previous query checked if that utxo had been spent, including in blocks that are not yet stable, leading to unexpected behaviour and a potential vulnerability. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/529 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21534
### Ledger Security (Least Authority Final Audit) The ledger underwent a comprehensive security audit by Least Authority with **all 16 issues resolved**. See the **Ledger 7.0.0** section below for details. Key fixes: - Constant-time comparisons to prevent timing leakage - Key material zeroization (`ZeroizeOnDrop` for witnesses and secret keys) - Cryptographic correctness (identity ciphertext rejection, modulus reduction, identity point) - VM specification compliance and stack height enforcement - Domain separator hardening - Storage invariant fixes ### Node Security (Least Authority Initial Audit) The node underwent a security audit identifying 44 issues across consensus safety, crash paths, and operational areas. **This is an Initial Report (October 24, 2025) - verification review has not been completed.** The issues remain open pending formal remediation and verification by Least Authority. Critical and High severity issues identified include: - Weight benchmarking gaps in the Midnight pallet - UTXO pagination logic that may skip events - Connection pool exhaustion affecting consensus - Insecure randomness in `mint_coins` - Various panic paths and input validation gaps Users should be aware that node-level audit remediation is ongoing. --- ## Performance Improvements
Big speedup for cNight queries (1000x for mainnet data) (#525, PM-18343, PM-16882) (#cnight-observation, #performance) Optimized PostgreSQL queries in the mainchain follower to use the `idx_block_block_no` index instead of sequential scans. This improves cNight genesis generation performance from 1m25s to 141ms when processing 10 blocks of mainnet data. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/525 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-18343 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-16882
Additional performance improvements in Ledger 6.2.0 (included in this release): - **Enum memory optimization**: Large enum variants (`DustSpendError`, `ZswapPreimageEvidence`, `EventDetails`, `ContractAction`) now heap-allocate their data - **Transcript partitioning**: Zswap components use addCalls for transcript partitioning --- ## Toolkit Improvements ### New Features
Add `--no-watch-progress` CLI option (#472, PM-21220) (#toolkit) Adds a `--no-watch-progress` CLI flag to the toolkit to skip waiting for transaction finalization when sending transactions. This can speed up batch sending when finalization confirmation is not needed. Note: Using this option when sending batches may cause transaction errors, as subsequent transactions may be submitted before their dependencies are finalized. The existing `MN_DONT_WATCH_PROGRESS` environment variable is preserved as a fallback. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21220
Add `--dust-grace-period` option to ledger parameter commands (#464, PM-21144) (#toolkit) Adds the ability to configure `LedgerParameters::dust.dust_grace_period` via the `show-ledger-parameters` and `update-ledger-parameters` toolkit commands. This allows users to customize the dust grace period (default 3 hours) so that a batch of transactions can be reused on new test runs with fresh chains. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/464 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21144
Add block limit params to `update-ledger-parameters` command (#531) (#toolkit) Allows developers to tweak ledger block limits for performance testing. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/531
Add `capacity` field to `dust-balance` output (#335, PM-20849) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/335 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20849
Add `--funding-seed` option to `single-tx` command (#449, PM-21171) (#toolkit) This option allows toolkit users to fund their single-tx transaction using a different wallet to the unshielded/shielded token source wallet. Useful for performance testing, where the pre-funded wallets contain enough DUST to fund all transactions on the network. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/449 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21171
### Bug Fixes
Fix toolkit not processing governance-wrapped system transactions (#484, PM-21246) (#toolkit) The toolkit now extracts system transactions from all `SystemTransactionApplied` events in a block, rather than only from direct extrinsic calls or `CNightObservation` events. This makes the toolkit resilient to system transactions wrapped in any call type, including governance motions (`FederatedAuthority::motion_dispatch`), batch calls, proxy calls, or any future wrapper patterns. Previously, when a system transaction (like `update-ledger-parameters`) was executed through governance, the toolkit would miss it because it only looked for direct `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction` extrinsics or events from `CNightObservation` calls. This caused the toolkit's ledger state to diverge from the chain, resulting in "Ledger state root mismatch" errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/484 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21246
Fix ledger root-hash mismatch on system transactions (#515, PM-21484, PM-21483) (#toolkit) Fixes regression introduced in 6644fce causing the toolkit to apply system transactions out-of-order. **Note:** Fetch caches will have to be removed if this bug was encountered (i.e. delete `toolkit.db`) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/515 Tickets: - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21484 - https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21483
Fix multiple `--dest-url` not respecting `--rate` correctly (#472, PM-21231) (#toolkit) When using multiple `--dest-url` arguments, the toolkit would send to each destination at `--rate`. It should instead send the txs at `--rate`, but each tx sent should go to a different `--dest-url` (cycling through the list). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21231
Fix hang when using multiple destination URLs (#472) (#toolkit) Fixes an issue where the toolkit would hang indefinitely when using multiple `--dest-url` arguments. The hang occurred because tx progress subscriptions were being dropped before finalization was complete, causing the async tasks to never resolve. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/472
Fix panic when using `--parameters` on `update-ledger-paramaters` (#541) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/541
Fix MN_FETCH_CACHE directory mounting in toolkit entrypoint (#473) (#toolkit) Updates the toolkit entrypoint.sh to properly mount the MN_FETCH_CACHE directory when using file-based caching (redb: prefix). This ensures the cache directory is created with correct ownership before running the toolkit. Also removes unused MN_SYNC_CACHE handling. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/473
Fix remote proof server option in toolkit (#431, #434) (#toolkit) By default, the toolkit will prove transactions in-process. This change fixes the existing `--proof-server` option for remote-proving. PRs: - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/431 - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/434
### Dependency Updates
Bump Compact.js to 2.4.0-rc.10 (#514, PM-21454) (#toolkit) Update Node Toolkit Compact.js dependencies from 2.4.0-rc.0 to 2.4.0-rc.10. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/514 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21454
--- ## Other Changes ### Configuration & Environment
Update qanet and govnet chain configs (#490, SRE-1653) Updates chain-spec and configuration files for qanet and govnet environments with newly generated chain configs. Removes deprecated governancetesting directory (renamed to govnet). PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/490 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/SRE-1653
Update tcNight and cNight mapping contracts (#391, #439, PM-21028) (#cnight-generates-dust) Updated tcNight policy id and cNight mapping validator to latest versions. PRs: - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/391 - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/439 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21028
Point bug report location to GitHub (#329, PM-11968) (#runtime, #audit) Tell people the right place to raise an issue. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/329 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-11968
### Local Environment
Use sibling directory for midnight-reserve-contracts path (#510, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the MIDNIGHT_RESERVE_CONTRACTS_PATH environment variable to reference the contracts repository as a sibling directory rather than a child directory. This aligns with typical developer workspace layouts and matches the CI configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/510 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
Fix contract-compiler docker volume path to be project-local (#497, PM-21404) (#local-environment) Change the contract-compiler service volume mount default from an external relative path to a project-local path, improving portability across developer environments. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/497 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21404
### Bug Fixes
Fix WASM trap in transaction validation when cost exceeds block limits (#489, PM-21219) (#node) Fixed a panic in `get_tx_weight` that caused WASM traps during transaction validation. When `get_transaction_cost` failed (e.g., due to `BlockLimitExceededError`), the `.expect()` call would panic in `get_dispatch_info` before the transaction reached `validate_unsigned` where the error would be properly handled. The fix replaces `.expect()` with `EXTRA_WEIGHT_TX_SIZE`, allowing the transaction to proceed to validation where `BlockLimitExceededError` is properly returned as an `InvalidTransaction` error. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/489 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21219
Fix Sqlx postgresql ssl connection settings (#528) (#client) Revert to previous known working configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/528
Fix regression in `wizards generate-keys` command (#187, #365) Fixed panic with `called Option::unwrap() on a None value` when running `wizards generate-keys` without any configuration. Now supports all usage patterns: - `./midnight-node wizards generate-keys` (defaults to dev) - `CFG_PRESET=qanet ./midnight-node wizards generate-keys` - `CHAIN=local ./midnight-node wizards generate-keys` - `CHAIN=path/to/chain-spec.json ./midnight-node wizards generate-keys` PRs: - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/187 - https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/365
Fix one seed used in a local undeployed environment (#363) Undeployed configuration is supposed to assign some initial tokens to a wallet initialized from a mnemonic, but the seed used in configuration was invalid, leading to assignments to wrong addresses. Now this is fixed. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/363
Do not panic if extrinsic count and ledger cost do not align (#386, PM-20842) (#runtime) Protect against panics in the less likely case that block limit is exceeded based on ledger limits. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/386 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20842
--- ## Ledger 7.0.0 - Major Cryptographic Infrastructure Upgrade Ledger 7.0.0 represents a significant cryptographic infrastructure upgrade with 409 commits since 6.1.0-alpha.6. This release includes a third-party security audit, new proving infrastructure, and wallet API improvements. ### Midnight SRS & midnight-zk 1.0 **The most significant change in ledger 7.0.0 is the switch to Midnight's own Structured Reference String (SRS).** Previously, the ledger used Filecoin's BLS SRS (`bls_filecoin_2p14`). This release switches to Midnight's own SRS (`bls_midnight_2p14`) along with the new `midnight-zk 1.0` proving library. This is a foundational change to the cryptographic infrastructure that: - Establishes Midnight's independent cryptographic foundation - Enables future protocol-specific optimizations - Removes dependency on external ceremony parameters ### Least Authority Security Audits Two comprehensive security audits were conducted by **Least Authority**: #### Ledger Audit (Final Report - December 19, 2025) The ledger audit covered ZSwap, DUST, ZKIR, coin-structure, onchain-vm, and storage modules. **All 16 issues resolved** (Issues A-P) plus 5 suggestions addressed. | Category | Issues | Fixes | |----------|--------|-------| | Timing/Side-Channel | Issue A | Constant-time equality for `HashOutput` via `subtle::ConstantTimeEq` | | VM Correctness | Issues B, C | Specification compliance fixes; stack height limit enforcement | | Transaction Verification | Issue D | Bidirectional check for claimed unshielded spends | | Key Material Zeroization | Issues E, H | `ZeroizeOnDrop` for witnesses, `SecretKey`, and `ProofPreimage` | | Cryptographic Correctness | Issues F, N | Identity ciphertext rejection; modulus reduction fix (p = 0 mod p) | | ZKIR | Issue G | Fixed sliding-window reverse index producing duplicates | | Storage/State | Issues I-L | Ref count overflow fix; Branch/Extension invariant fixes; Merkle tree depth validation | | Serialization | Issue M | Correct binary length in `TokenType` implementation | | Traversal | Issue O | Cursor advancement fix in `repr_traverse` | | Dependencies | Issue P | Upgraded `tracing-subscriber`; replaced unmaintained `paste` with `pastey` | | Domain Separation | Suggestions 4-5 | Prefix-based domain separators for coin commitments and nullifiers | #### Node Audit (Initial Report - October 24, 2025) The node audit covered the Substrate node, pallets (Midnight, NTO), runtime, and toolkit. **44 issues identified** (A-AR) covering consensus safety, crash paths, and operational weaknesses. **Verification review has not been completed - issues remain open.** | Severity | Count | Key Areas | |----------|-------|-----------| | Critical | 3 | Weight benchmarks (A), UTXO pagination (B), connection pool exhaustion (C) | | High | 11 | Insecure randomness (D), event emission (E), transaction ordering (F), state growth (G), inherent handling (H-N) | | Medium | 16 | Input validation (O-Q), timestamp sources (S), panic paths (T), consensus divergence (V, Z, AH) | | Low | 13 | Registration caps (AE), logging (AF), file handling (AI, AP), wallet updates (AK, AO) | ### Treasury Access Disabled System transactions can no longer access the treasury. This change ensures the treasury is preserved until proper treasury governance is implemented. While technically a breaking change, using this feature was considered a bug in consuming components. ### Wallet Transaction History API New API enables wallets to provide shielded transaction history by returning inputs/outputs for dust/zswap state during event replay. This addresses a gap where there was no efficient way for wallets to reconstruct shielded transaction history. ### Token Vault Contract Example New reference implementation demonstrating how contracts can handle both shielded and unshielded tokens: - **Shielded tokens**: Private transfers using ZSwap with hidden amounts and balances - **Unshielded tokens**: Regular UTXO transfers with visible amounts - **Operations**: Deposit and withdraw with balance tracking ### Additional Ledger 7.0.0 Changes | Change | Description | |--------|-------------| | Non-determinism fix | Critical fix ensuring deterministic transaction processing (blocking issue for rc.2) | | ClaimRewardsTransaction fixes | Various bug fixes for reward claiming | | Merkle tree rehashing | Correct rehashing on cNgD processing | | Pricing structure | Updated with overall cost and dimension weightings | | Memory optimization | Large enum variants heap-allocate their data | ### Ledger 6.2.0 (included in this release) The upgrade path from node 0.18.0 (ledger 6.1.0-alpha.6) also includes ledger 6.2.0 changes: - `midnight-zk` updated to 5.0.2 - Transcript partitioning with zswap components via addCalls - Removed special-casing of validation on `test-utilities` feature --- ## Infrastructure & Dependencies | Component | Version | |-----------|---------| | Partner Chains SDK | v1.8.1 | | Midnight Ledger | 7.0.0 | | Rust | 1.92 | | Compact.js | 2.4.0-rc.10 | --- ## Upgrade Notes ### Stability Guarantees Starting with this release, Midnight provides stability guarantees for upgrades. There should always be an upgrade path that does not require a chain reset. ### Toolkit Cache If you encounter ledger root-hash mismatches after upgrading, delete your toolkit cache: ```bash rm toolkit.db ``` ### Environment Variables New environment variables for Prometheus Remote Write: - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_ENDPOINT` - Remote write URL - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_INTERVAL_SECS` - Push interval (default: 15) - `PROMETHEUS_PUSH_JOB_NAME` - Job name label (default: midnight-node) --- ## Migration from 0.18.x This release skips version 0.19.0. Key migration considerations: 1. **Governance**: Sudo is removed. Ensure your deployment uses the federated governance system. 2. **Call indices**: `pallet-midnight` call indices have changed. Update any hardcoded extrinsic calls. 3. **Ledger upgrade**: Major ledger version bump (6.1.x → 7.0.0) with breaking serialization changes. 4. **Chain ID format**: Now uses `midnight_` prefix per Polkadot convention. --- ## Contributors 219 commits from the Midnight team. ## Links - [GitHub Release](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/releases/tag/node-0.20.0) - [Ledger 7.0.0 Changelog](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-ledger/blob/ledger-7.0.0/CHANGELOG.md) - [Partner Chains v1.8.1](https://github.com/input-output-hk/partner-chains/releases/tag/v1.8.1) - [Least Authority Audits](https://leastauthority.com/security-consulting/audits/) - Ledger Final Audit Report (December 19, 2025) - Node Initial Audit Report (October 24, 2025) - verification pending --- # Tagged Changes

name: node-0.20.0-rc.3
body:
Git tag: [node-0.20.0-rc.3](https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/tree/node-0.20.0-rc.3) ## Docker Images ### DockerHub - [midnight-node](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node/) - [midnight-node-toolkit](https://hub.docker.com/r/midnightnetwork/midnight-node-toolkit/) ```shell $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node:0.20.0-rc.3 $ docker pull midnightntwrk/midnight-node-toolkit:0.20.0-rc.3 ``` ## Added
Add `--dust-grace-period` option to ledger parameter commands (#464, PM-21144) (#toolkit) Adds the ability to configure `LedgerParameters::dust.dust_grace_period` via the `show-ledger-parameters` and `update-ledger-parameters` toolkit commands. This allows users to customize the dust grace period (default 3 hours) so that a batch of transactions can be reused on new test runs with fresh chains. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/464 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21144
## Changed
Re-enable Aiken E2E Tests (PM-21229, #471) ## Summary Re-enable all Aiken E2E tests by fixing the policy ID mismatch between partner-chains contracts and Aiken governance contracts. Key fixes: - Remove SKIP_GOVERNANCE_DEPLOY flag from Earthfile, docker-compose.yml, and entrypoint.sh - Governance contracts are now always deployed by midnight-setup during local-env startup - **Critical fix**: Chain-spec now uses Aiken council_forever policy ID instead of partner-chains PermissionedCandidates policy ID. This ensures nodes look for permissioned candidates at the correct contract address. - compile-contracts.sh now writes policy IDs to runtime-values files - entrypoint.sh reads and uses Aiken policy IDs when generating chain-spec - Convert `deploy_governance_contracts_and_validate_membership_reset` to verify already-deployed contracts - Convert `deploy_federated_ops_contract_and_validate_membership` to verify already-deployed contract - Add `query_utxos` method to CardanoClient for contract verification - Re-enable 14 tests that were previously ignored due to chain observation issues ## Issue Fixes [PM-21229](https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21229) ## PR https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/471 ## Type Bug Fix
Fix MN_FETCH_CACHE directory mounting in toolkit entrypoint (#473) (#toolkit) Updates the toolkit entrypoint.sh to properly mount the MN_FETCH_CACHE directory when using file-based caching (redb: prefix). This ensures the cache directory is created with correct ownership before running the toolkit. Also removes unused MN_SYNC_CACHE handling. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/473
Fix WASM trap in transaction validation when cost exceeds block limits (#489, PM-21219) (#node) Fixed a panic in `get_tx_weight` that caused WASM traps during transaction validation. When `get_transaction_cost` failed (e.g., due to `BlockLimitExceededError`), the `.expect()` call would panic in `get_dispatch_info` before the transaction reached `validate_unsigned` where the error would be properly handled. The fix replaces `.expect()` with `EXTRA_WEIGHT_TX_SIZE`, allowing the transaction to proceed to validation where `BlockLimitExceededError` is properly returned as an `InvalidTransaction` error. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/489 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21219
Reduce block size limit to 1 MB (#477, PM-20476) (#node) Reduces the maximum block length from 5 MB to a more conservative 1 MB to improve network stability and block propagation times. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/477 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20476
Re-enable cNIGHT observation E2E tests in local environment (#480, PM-21247) (#local-env, #e2e-tests) Re-enable 12 cNIGHT/DUST observation E2E tests that were disabled as collateral damage during the Aiken governance contract migration (PR #454). The cNIGHT tests use static pre-compiled contracts that match the static cnight-genesis.json configuration. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/480 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21247
Add `capacity` field to `dust-balance` output (#335, PM-20849) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/335 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20849
Fix toolkit not processing governance-wrapped system transactions (#484, PM-21246) (#toolkit) The toolkit now extracts system transactions from all `SystemTransactionApplied` events in a block, rather than only from direct extrinsic calls or `CNightObservation` events. This makes the toolkit resilient to system transactions wrapped in any call type, including governance motions (`FederatedAuthority::motion_dispatch`), batch calls, proxy calls, or any future wrapper patterns. Previously, when a system transaction (like `update-ledger-parameters`) was executed through governance, the toolkit would miss it because it only looked for direct `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction` extrinsics or events from `CNightObservation` calls. This caused the toolkit's ledger state to diverge from the chain, resulting in "Ledger state root mismatch" errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/484 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21246
Update toolkit for compatibility with compact 0.28.0-rc.0 (#468, PM-21174) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/468 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21174
# Tagged Changes

Fix WASM trap in transaction validation when cost exceeds block limits (#489, PM-21219) (#node) Fixed a panic in `get_tx_weight` that caused WASM traps during transaction validation. When `get_transaction_cost` failed (e.g., due to `BlockLimitExceededError`), the `.expect()` call would panic in `get_dispatch_info` before the transaction reached `validate_unsigned` where the error would be properly handled. The fix replaces `.expect()` with `EXTRA_WEIGHT_TX_SIZE`, allowing the transaction to proceed to validation where `BlockLimitExceededError` is properly returned as an `InvalidTransaction` error. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/489 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21219

This allows users to customize the dust grace period (default 3 hours) so that a batch of transactions can be reused on new test runs with fresh chains. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/464 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21144
## Changed
Fix MN_FETCH_CACHE directory mounting in toolkit entrypoint (#473) (#toolkit) Updates the toolkit entrypoint.sh to properly mount the MN_FETCH_CACHE directory when using file-based caching (redb: prefix). This ensures the cache directory is created with correct ownership before running the toolkit. Also removes unused MN_SYNC_CACHE handling. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/473
Add `capacity` field to `dust-balance` output (#335, PM-20849) (#toolkit) PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/335 Ticket: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-20849
Fix toolkit not processing governance-wrapped system transactions (#484, PM-21246) (#toolkit) The toolkit now extracts system transactions from all `SystemTransactionApplied` events in a block, rather than only from direct extrinsic calls or `CNightObservation` events. This makes the toolkit resilient to system transactions wrapped in any call type, including governance motions (`FederatedAuthority::motion_dispatch`), batch calls, proxy calls, or any future wrapper patterns. Previously, when a system transaction (like `update-ledger-parameters`) was executed through governance, the toolkit would miss it because it only looked for direct `MidnightSystem::send_mn_system_transaction` extrinsics or events from `CNightObservation` calls. This caused the toolkit's ledger state to diverge from the chain, resulting in "Ledger state root mismatch" errors. PR: https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-node/pull/484 JIRA: https://shielded.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21246
